name: Curves
desc: A collection of common animation curves.

name: bounceIn
desc: An oscillating curve that grows in magnitude.

name: bounceInOut
desc: An oscillating curve that first grows and then shrink in magnitude.

name: bounceOut
desc: An oscillating curve that first grows and then shrink in magnitude.

name: decelerate
desc:
A curve where the rate of change starts out quickly and then decelerates; an
upside-down f(t) = t² parabola.

name: ease
desc: A cubic animation curve that speeds up quickly and ends slowly.

name: easeIn
desc: A cubic animation curve that starts slowly and ends quickly.

name: easeInBack
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts slowly and ends quickly. This curve
is similar to Curves.elasticIn in that it overshoots its bounds before
reaching its end. Instead of repeated swinging motions before ascending,
though, this curve overshoots once, then continues to ascend.

name: easeInCirc
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts slowly and ends quickly. This curve is
effectively the bottom-right quarter of a circle.

name: easeInCubic
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts slowly and ends quickly. This curve is
based on a cubic equation where f(t) = t³. The result is a safe sweet
spot when choosing a curve for widgets animating off the viewport.

name: easeInExpo
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts slowly and ends quickly. This curve is
based on an exponential equation where f(t) = 2¹⁰⁽ᵗ⁻¹⁾.

name: easeInOut
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts slowly, speeds up, and then ends
slowly.

name: easeInOutBack
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts slowly, speeds up, and then ends
slowly. This curve can be imagined as Curves.easeInBack as the first
half, and Curves.easeOutBack as the second.

name: easeInOutCirc
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts slowly, speeds up, and then ends
slowly. This curve can be imagined as Curves.easeInCirc as the first
half, and Curves.easeOutCirc as the second.

name: easeInOutCubic
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts slowly, speeds up, and then ends
slowly. This curve can be imagined as Curves.easeInCubic as the first
half, and Curves.easeOutCubic as the second.

name: easeInOutCubicEmphasized
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts slowly, speeds up shortly thereafter,
and then ends slowly. This curve can be imagined as a steeper version of
easeInOutCubic.

name: easeInOutExpo
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts slowly, speeds up, and then ends
slowly.

name: easeInOutQuad
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts slowly, speeds up, and then ends
slowly. This curve can be imagined as Curves.easeInQuad as the first
half, and Curves.easeOutQuad as the second.

name: easeInOutQuart
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts slowly, speeds up, and then ends
slowly. This curve can be imagined as Curves.easeInQuart as the first
half, and Curves.easeOutQuart as the second.

name: easeInOutQuint
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts slowly, speeds up, and then ends
slowly. This curve can be imagined as Curves.easeInQuint as the first
half, and Curves.easeOutQuint as the second.

name: easeInOutSine
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts slowly, speeds up, and then ends
slowly. This is similar to Curves.easeInOut, but with sinusoidal easing
for a slightly less abrupt beginning and end.

name: easeInQuad
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts slowly and ends quickly. Based on a
quadratic equation where f(t) = t², this is effectively the inverse of
Curves.decelerate.

name: easeInQuart
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts slowly and ends quickly. This curve is
based on a quartic equation where f(t) = t⁴.

name: easeInQuint
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts slowly and ends quickly. This curve is
based on a quintic equation where f(t) = t⁵.

name: easeInSine
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts slowly and ends quickly. This is
similar to Curves.easeIn, but with sinusoidal easing for a slightly less
abrupt beginning and end. Nonetheless, the result is quite gentle and is
hard to distinguish from Curves.linear at a glance.

name: easeInToLinear
desc: A cubic animation curve that starts slowly and ends linearly.

name: easeOut
desc: A cubic animation curve that starts quickly and ends slowly.

name: easeOutBack
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts quickly and ends slowly. This curve is
similar to Curves.elasticOut in that it overshoots its bounds before
reaching its end. Instead of repeated swinging motions after ascending,
though, this curve only overshoots once.

name: easeOutCirc
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts quickly and ends slowly. This curve is
effectively the top-left quarter of a circle.

name: easeOutCubic
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts quickly and ends slowly. This curve is
a flipped version of Curves.easeInCubic.

name: easeOutExpo
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts quickly and ends slowly. This curve is
a flipped version of Curves.easeInExpo. Using this curve can give your
animations extra flare, but a longer duration may need to be used to
compensate for the steepness of the curve.

name: easeOutQuad
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts quickly and ends slowly. This is
effectively the same as Curves.decelerate, only simulated using a cubic
bezier function.

name: easeOutQuart
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts quickly and ends slowly. This curve is
a flipped version of Curves.easeInQuart.

name: easeOutQuint
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts quickly and ends slowly. This curve is
a flipped version of Curves.easeInQuint.

name: easeOutSine
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts quickly and ends slowly. This is
similar to Curves.easeOut, but with sinusoidal easing for a slightly
less abrupt beginning and end. Nonetheless, the result is quite gentle and
is hard to distinguish from Curves.linear at a glance.

name: elasticIn
desc: An oscillating curve that grows in magnitude while overshooting its bounds.

name: elasticInOut
desc: An oscillating curve that grows and then shrinks in magnitude while overshooting its bounds.

name: elasticOut
desc: An oscillating curve that shrinks in magnitude while overshooting its bounds.

name: fastEaseInToSlowEaseOut
desc: A curve that starts slowly, speeds up very quickly, and then ends slowly.

name: fastLinearToSlowEaseIn
desc:
A curve that is very steep and linear at the beginning, but quickly flattens out
and very slowly eases in.

name: fastOutSlowIn
desc: A curve that starts quickly and eases into its final position.

name: linear
desc: A linear animation curve.

name: linearToEaseOut
desc: A cubic animation curve that starts linearly and ends slowly.

name: slowMiddle
desc:
A cubic animation curve that starts quickly, slows down, and then ends
quickly.

name: CupertinoListSection

desc:

information. However, instead of being displayed below title, it is
displayed on the right, before trailing. Usually a Text widget.

name: backgroundColor
desc:
The backgroundColor of the tile in normal state. Once the tile is
tapped, the background color switches to backgroundColorActivated. It is
set to match the iOS look by default.

name: backgroundColorActivated

The backgroundColorActivated is the background color of the tile after
the tile was tapped. It is set to match the iOS look by default.

A widget displayed at the start of the CupertinoListTile. This is

desc:
The leadingSize is used to constrain the width and height of leading
widget.

name: leadingToTitle
desc: The horizontal space between leading widget and title.

The onTap function is called when a user taps on CupertinoListTile. If
left null, the CupertinoListTile will not react on taps. If this is a
Future<void> Function(), then the CupertinoListTile remains activated
until the returned future is awaited. This is according to iOS behavior.
However, if this function is a void Function(), then the tile is active
only for the duration of invocation.

name: padding
desc: Padding of the content inside CupertinoListTile.

name: subtitle
desc:
A subtitle is used to display additional information. It is located
below title. Usually a Text widget.

name: title
desc: A title is used to convey the central information. Usually a Text.

name: trailing
desc:
A widget displayed at the end of the CupertinoListTile. This is usually
a right chevron icon (e.g. CupertinoListTileChevron), or an Icon.

Set and get the deadline for the response. The deadline is timed from the
time it's set. Setting a new deadline will override any previous deadline.

HttpServer is closed, the HttpServer will just detach itself,
closing current connections but not closing serverSocket.

name: bindSecure
desc:
The address can either be a String or an
InternetAddress. If address is a String, bind will
perform a InternetAddress.lookup and use the first value in the
list. To listen on the loopback adapter, which will allow only
incoming connections from the local host, use the value
InternetAddress.loopbackIPv4 or
InternetAddress.loopbackIPv6. To allow for incoming
connection from the network use either one of the values
InternetAddress.anyIPv4 or InternetAddress.anyIPv6 to
bind to all interfaces or the IP address of a specific interface.

name: close
desc:
Permanently stops this HttpServer from listening for new
connections.  This closes the Stream of HttpRequests with a
done event. The returned future completes when the server is
stopped. For a server started using bind or bindSecure this
means that the port listened on no longer in use.

name: ByteData
desc:
A fixed-length, random-access sequence of bytes that also provides random
and unaligned access to the fixed-width integers and floating point
numbers represented by those bytes.

name: ByteData.new
desc:
Creates a ByteData of the specified length (in elements), all of
whose bytes are initially zero.

name: ByteData.sublistView
desc: Creates a ByteData view on a range of elements of data.

name: ByteData.view
desc: Creates an ByteData view of the specified region in buffer.

name: asUnmodifiableView
desc: A read-only view of this ByteData.

name: getFloat32
desc:
The floating point number represented by the four bytes at
the specified byteOffset in this object, in IEEE 754
single-precision binary floating-point format (binary32).

name: getFloat64
desc:
The floating point number represented by the eight bytes at
the specified byteOffset in this object, in IEEE 754
double-precision binary floating-point format (binary64).

name: getInt8
desc:
The (possibly negative) integer represented by the byte at the
specified byteOffset in this object, in two's complement binary
representation.

name: getInt16
desc:
The (possibly negative) integer represented by the two bytes at
the specified byteOffset in this object, in two's complement binary
form.

name: getInt32
desc:
The (possibly negative) integer represented by the four bytes at
the specified byteOffset in this object, in two's complement binary
form.

name: getInt64
desc:
The (possibly negative) integer represented by the eight bytes at
the specified byteOffset in this object, in two's complement binary
form.

name: getUint8
desc:
The positive integer represented by the byte at the specified
byteOffset in this object, in unsigned binary form.

name: getUint16
desc:
The positive integer represented by the two bytes starting
at the specified byteOffset in this object, in unsigned binary
form.

name: getUint32
desc:
The positive integer represented by the four bytes starting
at the specified byteOffset in this object, in unsigned binary
form.

name: getUint64
desc:
The positive integer represented by the eight bytes starting
at the specified byteOffset in this object, in unsigned binary
form.

name: setFloat32
desc:
Sets the four bytes starting at the specified byteOffset in this
object to the IEEE 754 single-precision binary floating-point
(binary32) representation of the specified value.

name: setFloat64
desc:
Sets the eight bytes starting at the specified byteOffset in this
object to the IEEE 754 double-precision binary floating-point
(binary64) representation of the specified value.

name: setInt8
desc:
Sets the byte at the specified byteOffset in this object to the
two's complement binary representation of the specified value, which
must fit in a single byte.

name: setInt16
desc:
Sets the two bytes starting at the specified byteOffset in this
object to the two's complement binary representation of the specified
value, which must fit in two bytes.

name: setInt32
desc:
Sets the four bytes starting at the specified byteOffset in this
object to the two's complement binary representation of the specified
value, which must fit in four bytes.

name: setInt64
desc:
Sets the eight bytes starting at the specified byteOffset in this
object to the two's complement binary representation of the specified
value, which must fit in eight bytes.

name: setUint8
desc:
Sets the byte at the specified byteOffset in this object to the
unsigned binary representation of the specified value, which must fit
in a single byte.

name: setUint16
desc:
Sets the two bytes starting at the specified byteOffset in this object
to the unsigned binary representation of the specified value,
which must fit in two bytes.

name: setUint32
desc:
Sets the four bytes starting at the specified byteOffset in this object
to the unsigned binary representation of the specified value,
which must fit in four bytes.

name: setUint64
desc:
Sets the eight bytes starting at the specified byteOffset in this object
to the unsigned binary representation of the specified value,
which must fit in eight bytes.

name: BytesBuilder
desc:
Builds a list of bytes, allowing bytes and lists of bytes to be added at the
end.

name: BytesBuilder.new
desc: Construct a new empty BytesBuilder.

name: add
desc: Appends bytes to the current contents of this builder.

name: addByte
desc: Appends byte to the current contents of this builder.

name: clear
desc: Clears the contents of this builder.

name: isEmpty
desc: Whether the buffer is empty.

name: isNotEmpty
desc: Whether the buffer is non-empty.

name: length
desc: The number of bytes in this builder.

name: takeBytes
desc: Returns the bytes currently contained in this builder and clears it.

name: toBytes
desc: Returns a copy of the current byte contents of this builder.

name: Endian
desc: Endianness of number representation.

name: Float32List

name: Canvas
desc: An interface for recording graphical operations.

name: Canvas.new
desc:
Creates a canvas for recording graphical operations into the
given picture recorder.

name: clipPath
desc:
Reduces the clip region to the intersection of the current clip and the
given Path.

name: clipRRect
desc:
Reduces the clip region to the intersection of the current clip and the
given rounded rectangle.

name: clipRSuperellipse
desc:
Reduces the clip region to the intersection of the current clip and the
given rounded superellipse.

name: clipRect
desc:
Reduces the clip region to the intersection of the current clip and the
given rectangle.

name: drawArc
desc: Draw an arc scaled to fit inside the given rectangle.

name: drawAtlas
desc: Draws many parts of an image - the atlas - onto the canvas.

name: drawCircle
desc:
Draws a circle centered at the point given by the first argument and
that has the radius given by the second argument, with the Paint given in
the third argument. Whether the circle is filled or stroked (or both) is
controlled by Paint.style.

name: drawColor
desc:
Paints the given Color onto the canvas, applying the given
BlendMode, with the given color being the source and the background
being the destination.

name: drawDRRect
desc:
Draws a shape consisting of the difference between two rounded rectangles
with the given Paint. Whether this shape is filled or stroked (or both)
is controlled by Paint.style.

name: drawImage
desc:
Draws the given Image into the canvas with its top-left corner at the
given Offset. The image is composited into the canvas using the given Paint.

name: drawImageNine
desc: Draws the given Image into the canvas using the given Paint.

name: drawImageRect
desc:
Draws the subset of the given image described by the src argument into
the canvas in the axis-aligned rectangle given by the dst argument.

name: drawLine
desc:
Draws a line between the given points using the given paint. The line is
stroked, the value of the Paint.style is ignored for this call.

name: drawOval
desc:
Draws an axis-aligned oval that fills the given axis-aligned rectangle
with the given Paint. Whether the oval is filled or stroked (or both) is
controlled by Paint.style.

name: drawPaint
desc: Fills the canvas with the given Paint.

name: drawParagraph
desc:
Draws the text in the given Paragraph into this canvas at the given
Offset.

name: drawPath
desc: Draws the given Path with the given Paint.

name: drawPicture
desc:
Draw the given picture onto the canvas. To create a picture, see
PictureRecorder.

name: drawPoints
desc: Draws a sequence of points according to the given PointMode.

name: drawRRect
desc:
Draws a rounded rectangle with the given Paint. Whether the rectangle is
filled or stroked (or both) is controlled by Paint.style.

name: drawRSuperellipse
desc:
Draws a rounded superellipse with the given Paint. The shape is filled,
and the value of the Paint.style is ignored for this call.

name: drawRawAtlas
desc: Draws many parts of an image - the atlas - onto the canvas.

name: drawRawPoints
desc: Draws a sequence of points according to the given PointMode.

name: drawRect
desc:
Draws a rectangle with the given Paint. Whether the rectangle is filled
or stroked (or both) is controlled by Paint.style.

name: drawShadow
desc: Draws a shadow for a Path representing the given material elevation.

name: drawVertices
desc: Draws a set of Vertices onto the canvas as one or more triangles.

name: getDestinationClipBounds
desc:
Returns the conservative bounds of the combined result of all clip methods
executed within the current save stack of this Canvas object, as measured
in the destination coordinate space in which the Picture will be rendered.

name: getLocalClipBounds
desc:
Returns the conservative bounds of the combined result of all clip methods
executed within the current save stack of this Canvas object, as measured
in the local coordinate space under which rendering operations are currently
performed.

name: getSaveCount
desc:
Returns the number of items on the save stack, including the
initial state. This means it returns 1 for a clean canvas, and
that each call to save and saveLayer increments it, and that
each matching call to restore decrements it.

name: getTransform
desc:
Returns the current transform including the combined result of all transform
methods executed since the creation of this Canvas object, and respecting the
save/restore history.

name: restore
desc:
Pops the current save stack, if there is anything to pop.
Otherwise, does nothing.

name: restoreToCount
desc:
Restores the save stack to a previous level as might be obtained from getSaveCount.
If count is less than 1, the stack is restored to its initial state.
If count is greater than the current getSaveCount then nothing happens.

name: rotate
desc: Add a rotation to the current transform. The argument is in radians clockwise.

name: save
desc: Saves a copy of the current transform and clip on the save stack.

name: saveLayer
desc:
Saves a copy of the current transform and clip on the save stack, and then
creates a new group which subsequent calls will become a part of. When the
save stack is later popped, the group will be flattened into a layer and
have the given paint's Paint.colorFilter and Paint.blendMode
applied.

name: scale
desc:
Add an axis-aligned scale to the current transform, scaling by the first
argument in the horizontal direction and the second in the vertical
direction.

name: skew
desc:
Add an axis-aligned skew to the current transform, with the first argument
being the horizontal skew in rise over run units clockwise around the
origin, and the second argument being the vertical skew in rise over run
units clockwise around the origin.

name: transform
desc:
Multiply the current transform by the specified 4⨉4 transformation matrix
specified as a list of values in column-major order.

name: translate
desc:
Add a translation to the current transform, shifting the coordinate space
horizontally by the first argument and vertically by the second argument.

entire layer is merged with the destination.

Base class for Size and Offset, which are both ways to describe
a distance as a two-dimensional axis-aligned vector.

name: OffsetBase.new
desc:
Abstract const constructor. This constructor enables subclasses to provide
const constructors so that they can be used in const expressions.

name: hashCode
desc: The hash code for this object.

name: isFinite
desc: Whether both components are finite (neither infinite nor NaN).

name: isInfinite
desc:
Returns true if either component is double.infinity, and false if both
are finite (or negative infinity, or NaN).

name: operator <
desc:
Less-than operator. Compares an Offset or Size to another Offset or
Size, and returns true if both the horizontal and vertical values of the
left-hand-side operand are smaller than the horizontal and vertical values
of the right-hand-side operand respectively. Returns false otherwise.

name: operator <=
desc:
Less-than-or-equal-to operator. Compares an Offset or Size to another
Offset or Size, and returns true if both the horizontal and vertical
values of the left-hand-side operand are smaller than or equal to the
horizontal and vertical values of the right-hand-side operand
respectively. Returns false otherwise.

name: operator ==
desc:
Equality operator. Compares an Offset or Size to another Offset or
Size, and returns true if the horizontal and vertical values of the
left-hand-side operand are equal to the horizontal and vertical values of
the right-hand-side operand respectively. Returns false otherwise.

name: operator >
desc:
Greater-than operator. Compares an Offset or Size to another Offset
or Size, and returns true if both the horizontal and vertical values of
the left-hand-side operand are bigger than the horizontal and vertical
values of the right-hand-side operand respectively. Returns false
otherwise.

name: operator >=
desc:
Greater-than-or-equal-to operator. Compares an Offset or Size to
another Offset or Size, and returns true if both the horizontal and
vertical values of the left-hand-side operand are bigger than or equal to
the horizontal and vertical values of the right-hand-side operand
respectively. Returns false otherwise.

name: strokeMiterLimit

The limit for miters to be drawn on segments when the join is set to

name: Path
desc: A complex, one-dimensional subset of a plane.

name: Path.from
desc: Creates a copy of another Path.

name: addArc
desc:
Adds a new sub-path with one arc segment that consists of the arc
that follows the edge of the oval bounded by the given
rectangle, from startAngle radians around the oval up to
startAngle + sweepAngle radians around the oval, with zero
radians being the point on the right hand side of the oval that
crosses the horizontal line that intersects the center of the
rectangle and with positive angles going clockwise around the
oval.

name: addOval
desc:
Adds a new sub-path that consists of a curve that forms the
ellipse that fills the given rectangle.

name: addPath
desc: Adds the sub-paths of path, offset by offset, to this path.

name: addPolygon
desc:
Adds a new sub-path with a sequence of line segments that connect the given
points.

name: addRRect
desc:
Adds a new sub-path that consists of the straight lines and
curves needed to form the rounded rectangle described by the
argument.

name: addRSuperellipse
desc:
Adds a new sub-path that consists of curves needed to form the rounded
superellipse described by the argument.

name: addRect
desc:
Adds a new sub-path that consists of four lines that outline the
given rectangle.

name: arcTo
desc:
If the forceMoveTo argument is false, adds a straight line
segment and an arc segment.

name: arcToPoint
desc:
Appends up to four conic curves weighted to describe an oval of radius
and rotated by rotation (measured in degrees and clockwise).

name: close
desc:
Closes the last sub-path, as if a straight line had been drawn
from the current point to the first point of the sub-path.

name: combine
desc:
Combines the two paths according to the manner specified by the given
operation.

name: computeMetrics
desc:
Creates a PathMetrics object for this path, which can describe various
properties about the contours of the path.

name: conicTo
desc:
Adds a bezier segment that curves from the current point to the
given point (x2,y2), using the control points (x1,y1) and the
weight w. If the weight is greater than 1, then the curve is a
hyperbola; if the weight equals 1, it's a parabola; and if it is
less than 1, it is an ellipse.

name: contains
desc:
Tests to see if the given point is within the path. (That is, whether the
point would be in the visible portion of the path if the path was used
with Canvas.clipPath.)

name: cubicTo
desc:
Adds a cubic bezier segment that curves from the current point
to the given point (x3,y3), using the control points (x1,y1) and
(x2,y2).

name: extendWithPath
desc:
Adds the sub-paths of path, offset by offset, to this path.
The current sub-path is extended with the first sub-path
of path, connecting them with a lineTo if necessary.

name: fillType
desc: Determines how the interior of this path is calculated.

name: getBounds
desc: Computes the bounding rectangle for this path.

name: lineTo
desc:
Adds a straight line segment from the current point to the given
point.

name: moveTo
desc: Starts a new sub-path at the given coordinate.

name: quadraticBezierTo
desc:
Adds a quadratic bezier segment that curves from the current
point to the given point (x2,y2), using the control point
(x1,y1).

name: relativeArcToPoint
desc:
Appends up to four conic curves weighted to describe an oval of radius
and rotated by rotation (measured in degrees and clockwise).

name: relativeConicTo
desc:
Adds a bezier segment that curves from the current point to the
point at the offset (x2,y2) from the current point, using the
control point at the offset (x1,y1) from the current point and
the weight w. If the weight is greater than 1, then the curve is
a hyperbola; if the weight equals 1, it's a parabola; and if it
is less than 1, it is an ellipse.

name: relativeCubicTo
desc:
Adds a cubic bezier segment that curves from the current point
to the point at the offset (x3,y3) from the current point, using
the control points at the offsets (x1,y1) and (x2,y2) from the
current point.

name: relativeLineTo
desc:
Adds a straight line segment from the current point to the point
at the given offset from the current point.

name: relativeMoveTo
desc: Starts a new sub-path at the given offset from the current point.

name: relativeQuadraticBezierTo
desc:
Adds a quadratic bezier segment that curves from the current
point to the point at the offset (x2,y2) from the current point,
using the control point at the offset (x1,y1) from the current
point.

name: reset
desc:
Clears the Path object of all sub-paths, returning it to the
same state it had when it was created. The current point is
reset to the origin.

name: shift
desc:
Returns a copy of the path with all the segments of every
sub-path translated by the given offset.

name: transform
desc:
Returns a copy of the path with all the segments of every
sub-path transformed by the given matrix.

name: PathFillType
desc:
Determines the winding rule that decides how the interior of a Path is
calculated.

Test-only. Reloads this library from assetName's bytes while keeping
this library's identity and registry key. Production hot reload always
re-fetches the original asset path via reinitialize; this hook lets
tests simulate an edited bundle by swapping in a different fixture.

name: fromAsset
desc:
Loads the shader bundle at assetName and returns its ShaderLibrary,
or null if the bundle could not be parsed.

name: fromBytes
desc:
Loads a ShaderLibrary directly from a shader bundle's bytes (the
contents of a .shaderbundle compiled by impellerc), rather than from a
bundled asset. This suits shader bundles produced or fetched at runtime,
which have no entry in the asset manifest that fromAsset resolves.

name: reinitialize
desc:
Re-fetches assetKey through the asset manager and reparses it into
the cached ShaderLibrary for that key, marking each shader dirty so
the next pipeline build evicts and re-registers it. The primary caller
is the ext.ui.gpu.reinitializeShaderLibrary service extension driving
hot reload from flutter_tools; tests may also call this directly.
No-ops if no library has been loaded for assetKey.

name: reinitializeFromBytes
desc:
Reparses bytes into this library in place, preserving its identity so
any Shaders already handed out keep working (they are mutated and
marked dirty so the next pipeline build re-registers them). The
counterpart to reinitialize for a fromBytes library, which has no
asset path to re-fetch. Use it to swap in a recompiled shader bundle.

name: VertexAttribute
desc:
Describes a single vertex attribute: which shader input it feeds (by name),
its byte offset within the owning vertex buffer's element, and its format.

name: VertexAttribute.new
desc:
Creates a vertex attribute description bound to the shader-side input
named name, reading its data in the given format starting at byte
offsetInBytes into each element of the owning vertex buffer.

name: format
desc: Format of each attribute element.

name: name
desc: Name of the shader-side input this attribute feeds (e.g. position).

name: offsetInBytes
desc:
Byte offset of this attribute from the start of each element in the
owning vertex buffer. Must satisfy
offsetInBytes + format.bytesPerElement <= VertexBuffer.strideInBytes.

name: VertexBuffer
desc:
Describes one vertex buffer slot: its per-element stride, step mode, and
the attributes that are read from it.

name: VertexBuffer.new
desc:
Creates a vertex buffer slot description with the given per-element
strideInBytes and the list of attributes that the vertex shader
reads from this buffer.

name: attributes
desc: Attributes read from this vertex buffer by the vertex shader.

name: stepMode
desc: How this vertex buffer advances while drawing.

name: strideInBytes
desc:
Byte distance from the start of one element to the start of the next
element in this vertex buffer (not the gap between an element's end and
the next element's start). Equivalent to the size of a single vertex
element plus any trailing padding before the next element begins. For a
tightly packed structure-of-arrays buffer carrying a single attribute,
this is the same as attributes[0].format.bytesPerElement.

name: VertexFormat
desc: The format of a single vertex attribute.

name: bytesPerElement
desc: Total size in bytes of a single attribute element of this format.

name: componentCount
desc: Number of scalar components in a single attribute element.

name: flutter_test
desc: Testing library for flutter, built on top of package:test.

name: AccessibilityGuideline
desc:
An accessibility guideline describes a recommendation an application should
meet to be considered accessible.

name: AccessibilityGuideline.new
desc: A const constructor allows subclasses to be const.

name: description
desc: A description of the policy restrictions and criteria.

name: evaluate
desc: Evaluate whether the current state of the tester conforms to the rule.

name: AllMessagesHandler
desc:
A function which takes the name of the method channel, it's handler,
platform message and asynchronously returns an encoded response.

name: AnimationSheetBuilder
desc:
Records the frames of an animating widget, and later displays the frames as a
grid in an animation sheet.

name: AnimationSheetBuilder.new
desc: Starts a session of building an animation sheet.

name: allLayers
desc:
Whether the captured image comes from the entire tree, or only the
subtree of record.

name: collate
desc: Returns an result image by putting all frames together in a table.

name: dispose
desc: Dispose all recorded frames and result images.

name: frameSize
desc: The size of the child to be recorded.

name: record
desc: Returns a widget that renders a widget in a box that can be recorded.

name: AnyDistanceFunction
desc:
The type of a union of instances of DistanceFunction<T> for various types
T.

name: AutomatedTestWidgetsFlutterBinding
desc:
A variant of TestWidgetsFlutterBinding for executing tests typically
the flutter test environment, unless it is an integration test.

name: allowFirstFrame
desc:
Called after deferFirstFrame to tell the framework that it is ok to
send the first frame to the engine now.

name: asyncBarrier
desc:
This is called during test execution before and after the body has been
executed.

name: clock
desc: The current time.

name: debugPrintOverride
desc: The value to set debugPrint to while tests are running.

name: defaultTestTimeout
desc:
The value of defaultTestTimeout can be set to None to enable debugging
flutter tests where we would not want to timeout the test. This is
expected to be used by test tooling which can detect debug mode.

name: deferFirstFrame
desc:
Tell the framework to not send the first frames to the engine until there
is a corresponding call to allowFirstFrame.

name: delayed
desc: Delay for duration of time.

name: disableShadows
desc: The value to set debugDisableShadows to while tests are running.

name: drawFrame
desc: Pump the rendering pipeline to generate a frame.

name: elapseBlocking
desc:
Simulates the synchronous passage of time, resulting from blocking or
expensive calls.

name: ensureFrameCallbacksRegistered
desc:
Ensures callbacks for PlatformDispatcher.onBeginFrame and
PlatformDispatcher.onDrawFrame are registered.

name: ensureInitialized
desc:
Returns an instance of the binding that implements
AutomatedTestWidgetsFlutterBinding. If no binding has yet been
initialized, the a new instance is created.

name: idle
desc: Acts as if the application went idle.

name: inTest
desc: Whether there is currently a test executing.

name: initInstances
desc: The initialization method.

name: instance
desc: The current AutomatedTestWidgetsFlutterBinding, if one has been created.

name: microtaskCount
desc: The number of outstanding microtasks in the queue.

name: postTest
desc: Called by the testWidgets function after a test is executed.

name: pump
desc:
Triggers a frame sequence (build/layout/paint/etc),
then flushes microtasks.

name: resetFirstFrameSent
desc: Call this to pretend that no frames have been sent to the engine yet.

name: runAsync
desc: Runs a callback that performs real asynchronous work.

name: runTest
desc:
Call the testBody inside a FakeAsync scope on which pump can
advance time.

name: scheduleAttachRootWidget
desc: Schedules a Timer for attaching the root widget.

name: scheduleWarmUpFrame
desc:
Schedule a frame to run as soon as possible, rather than waiting for
the engine to request a frame in response to a system "Vsync" signal.

name: sendFramesToEngine
desc: Whether frames produced by drawFrame are sent to the engine.

name: CapturedAccessibilityAnnouncement
desc: Accessibility announcement data passed to SemanticsService.sendAnnouncement captured in a test.

name: assertiveness
desc: Determines the assertiveness level of the accessibility announcement.

name: message
desc: The accessibility message announced by the framework.

name: textDirection
desc: The direction in which the text of the message flows.

name: viewId
desc: The ID of the view that the announcement was sent to.

name: ChainedFinder
desc: Applies additional filtering against a parent widget finder.

name: ChainedFinder.new
desc: Create a Finder chained against the candidates of another parent Finder.

name: parent
desc: Another finder whose results will be further filtered.

name: ChainedFinderMixin
desc: A mixin that applies additional filtering to the results of a parent Finder.

name: allCandidates
desc: Returns all of the items that will be considered by this finder.

name: at
desc:
Returns a variant of this finder that only matches the item at the
given index found by this finder.

name: describeMatch
desc:
Describes zero, one, or more candidates that match the requirements of a
finder.

name: evaluate
desc:
Searches a set of candidates for those that meet the requirements set by
this finder and returns the result of that search.

name: filter
desc:
Return another Iterable when given an Iterable of candidates from a
parent FinderBase.

name: findInCandidates
desc:
Returns all the items in the given list that match this
finder's requirements.

name: first
desc:
Returns a variant of this finder that only matches the first item
found by this finder.

name: found
desc: The results of the latest evaluate or tryEvaluate call.

name: hasFound
desc: Whether or not this finder has any results in found.

name: hashCode
desc: The hash code for this object.

name: last
desc:
Returns a variant of this finder that only matches the last item
found by this finder.

name: noSuchMethod
desc: Invoked when a nonexistent method or property is accessed.

name: operator ==
desc: The equality operator.

name: parent
desc: Another finder whose results will be further filtered.

name: reset
desc: Resets all state of this FinderBase.

name: runCached
desc: Runs the given callback using cached results.

name: runtimeType
desc: A representation of the runtime type of the object.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this finder or its results.

name: tryEvaluate
desc:
Searches a set of candidates for those that meet the requirements set by
this finder and returns whether the search found any matching candidates.

name: CommonFinders
desc:
Provides lightweight syntax for getting frequently used Finders and

name: ancestor
desc:
Finds widgets that are ancestors of the of parameter and that match

name: backButton

name: byElementPredicate
desc: Finds widgets using an element predicate.

name: byElementType
desc: Finds widgets by searching for elements with a particular type.

name: byIcon
desc:
Finds Icon widgets containing icon data equal to the icon

name: byKey

The number of physical pixels on each side of the display rectangle into
which the view can render, but where the operating system will consume
input gestures for the sake of system navigation.

name: systemGestureInsetsTestValue
desc:
Hides the real system gesture insets and reports the given
systemGestureInsetsTestValue instead.

name: textScaleFactor
desc: The system-reported text scale.

name: updateSemantics
desc: Change the retained semantics data about this FlutterView.

name: viewId
desc: The opaque ID for this view.

name: viewInsets
desc:
The number of physical pixels on each side of the display rectangle into
which the view can render, but over which the operating system will likely
place system UI, such as the keyboard, that fully obscures any content.

name: viewInsetsTestValue
desc:
Hides the real view insets and reports the given viewInsetsTestValue
instead.

name: viewPadding
desc:
The number of physical pixels on each side of the display rectangle into
which the view can render, but which may be partially obscured by system
UI (such as the system notification area), or physical intrusions in
the display (e.g. overscan regions on television screens or phone sensor
housings).

name: viewPaddingTestValue
desc:
Hides the real view padding and reports the given paddingTestValue
instead.

name: TextEditingValue
desc: The current text, selection, and composing state for editing a run of text.

name: TextEditingValue.fromJSON
desc: Creates an instance of this class from a JSON object.

name: TextEditingValue.new
desc: Creates information for editing a run of text.

name: composing
desc: The range of text that is still being composed.

name: copyWith
desc: Creates a copy of this value but with the given fields replaced with the new values.

name: empty
desc: A value that corresponds to the empty string with no selection and no composing range.

name: hashCode
desc: The hash code for this object.

name: isComposingRangeValid
desc: Whether the composing range is a valid range within text.

name: operator ==
desc: The equality operator.

name: replaced
desc:
Returns a new TextEditingValue, which is this TextEditingValue with
its text partially replaced by the replacementString.

name: selection
desc: The range of text that is currently selected.

name: text
desc: The current text being edited.

name: toJSON
desc: Returns a representation of this object as a JSON object.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: TextInputAction
desc: An action the user has requested the text input control to perform.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: TextRangeContext
desc:
The CandidateType of finders that search for and filter substrings,
within static text rendered by RenderParagraphs.

name: renderObject
desc: The RenderObject that contains the static text.

name: textRange
desc: The TextRange of the substring within renderObject's text.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: view
desc: The View containing the static text.

name: Throws
desc: Use the throwsA function instead.

name: describe
desc: Builds a textual description of the matcher.

name: describeMismatch
desc: Builds a textual description of a specific mismatch.

name: matchAsync
desc:
Returns null if this matches item, or a String description of the
failure if it doesn't match.

name: matches
desc: Does the matching of the actual vs expected values.

name: TransitionDurationObserver
desc: Tracks the duration of the most recent page transition.

name: didPop
desc: The Navigator popped route.

name: didPush
desc: The Navigator pushed route.

name: didReplace
desc: The Navigator replaced oldRoute with newRoute.

name: pumpPastTransition
desc:
Pumps the minimum number of frames required for the current page
transition to run from start to finish.

name: transitionDuration
desc: The total duration of the most recent page transition.

name: TrivialComparator
desc:
Placeholder comparator that is set as the value of goldenFileComparator
when the initialization that happens in the test bootstrap either has not
yet happened or has been bypassed.

name: compare
desc:
Compares the pixels of decoded png imageBytes against the golden file
identified by golden.

name: getTestUri
desc:
Returns a new golden file Uri to incorporate any version number with
the key.

name: update
desc: Updates the golden file identified by golden with imageBytes.

name: ValueVariant
desc: A TestVariant that runs separate tests with each of the given values.

name: ValueVariant.new
desc: Creates a ValueVariant that tests the given values.

name: currentValue
desc: Returns the value currently under test.

name: describeValue
desc:
Returns the string that will be used to both add to the test description, and
be printed when a test fails for this variation.

name: setUp
desc:
A function that will be called before each value is tested, with the
value that will be tested.

name: tearDown
desc:
A function that is guaranteed to be called after a value is tested, even
if it throws an exception.

name: values
desc: Returns an iterable of the variations that this test dimension represents.

name: WidgetController
desc: Class that programmatically interacts with widgets.

name: WidgetController.new
desc: Creates a widget controller that uses the given binding.

name: allElements
desc: All elements currently in the widget tree (lazy pre-order traversal).

name: allRenderObjects
desc:
Render objects of all the widgets currently in the widget tree
(lazy pre-order traversal).

name: allStates
desc: All states currently in the widget tree (lazy pre-order traversal).

name: allWidgets
desc: All widgets currently in the widget tree (lazy pre-order traversal).

name: any
desc: Checks if finder exists in the tree.

name: binding
desc: A reference to the current instance of the binding.

name: createGesture
desc:
Creates gesture and returns the TestGesture object which you can use
to continue the gesture using calls on the TestGesture object.

name: drag
desc:
Attempts to drag the given widget by the given offset, by
starting a drag in the middle of the widget.

name: dragFrom
desc:
Attempts a drag gesture consisting of a pointer down, a move by
the given offset, and a pointer up.

name: dragUntilVisible
desc: Repeatedly drags view by moveStep until finder is visible.

name: element
desc: The matching element in the widget tree.

name: elementList
desc: The matching elements in the widget tree.

name: ensureSemantics
desc: Enable semantics in a test by creating a SemanticsHandle.

name: ensureVisible
desc:
Given a widget W specified by finder and a Scrollable widget S in
its ancestry tree, this scrolls S so as to make W visible.

name: firstElement
desc:
The first matching element according to a depth-first pre-order
traversal of the widget tree.

name: firstRenderObject
desc:
The render object of the first matching widget according to a
depth-first pre-order traversal of the widget tree.

name: firstState
desc:
The first matching state according to a depth-first pre-order
traversal of the widget tree.

name: firstWidget
desc:
The first matching widget according to a depth-first pre-order
traversal of the widget tree.

name: fling
desc:
Attempts a fling gesture starting from the center of the given
widget, moving the given distance, reaching the given speed.

name: flingFrom
desc:
Attempts a fling gesture starting from the given location, moving the
given distance, reaching the given speed.

name: getBottomLeft
desc:
Returns the point at the bottom left of the given widget. This
point is not inside the object's hit test area.

name: getBottomRight
desc:
Returns the point at the bottom right of the given widget. This
point is not inside the object's hit test area.

name: getCenter
desc: Returns the point at the center of the given widget.

name: getRect
desc:
Returns the rect of the given widget. This is only valid once
the widget's render object has been laid out at least once.

name: getSemantics
desc: Attempts to find the SemanticsNode of first result from finder.

name: getSize
desc:
Returns the size of the given widget. This is only valid once
the widget's render object has been laid out at least once.

name: getTopLeft
desc: Returns the point at the top left of the given widget.

name: getTopRight
desc:
Returns the point at the top right of the given widget. This
point is not inside the object's hit test area.

name: handlePointerEventRecord
desc:
A simulator of how the framework handles a series of PointerEvents
received from the Flutter engine.

name: hitTestOnBinding
desc: Forwards the given location to the binding's hitTest logic.

name: hitTestWarningShouldBeFatal
desc:
Whether warnings relating to hit tests not hitting their mark should be
fatal (cause the test to fail).

name: layerListOf
desc: Find all layers that are children of the provided finder.

name: layers
desc: Returns a list of all the Layer objects in the rendering.

name: longPress
desc:
Dispatch a pointer down / pointer up sequence (with a delay of
kLongPressTimeout + kPressTimeout between the two events) at the
center of the given widget, assuming it is exposed.

name: longPressAt
desc:
Dispatch a pointer down / pointer up sequence at the given location with
a delay of kLongPressTimeout + kPressTimeout between the two events.

name: nextPointer
desc: The next available pointer identifier.

name: platformDispatcher
desc: The TestPlatformDispatcher that is being used in this test.

name: press
desc:
Dispatch a pointer down at the center of the given widget, assuming it is
exposed.

name: printToConsole
desc: Calls debugPrint with the given message.

name: pump
desc:
Called to indicate that there should be a new frame after an optional
delay.

name: pumpAndSettle
desc:
Repeatedly calls pump with the given duration until there are no
longer any frames scheduled. This will call pump at least once, even if
no frames are scheduled when the function is called, to flush any pending
microtasks which may themselves schedule a frame.

name: renderObject
desc: The render object of the matching widget in the widget tree.

name: renderObjectList
desc: The render objects of the matching widgets in the widget tree.

name: scrollUntilVisible
desc:
Repeatedly scrolls a Scrollable by delta in the
Scrollable.axisDirection direction until a widget matching finder is
visible.

name: semantics
desc:
Provides access to a SemanticsController for testing anything related to
the Semantics tree.

name: sendEventToBinding
desc: Forwards the given pointer event to the binding.

name: sendKeyDownEvent
desc: Simulates sending a physical key down event.

name: sendKeyEvent
desc: Simulates sending physical key down and up events.

name: sendKeyRepeatEvent
desc: Simulates sending a key repeat event from a physical keyboard.

name: sendKeyUpEvent
desc: Simulates sending a physical key up event through the system channel.

name: simulateStatusBarTap
desc:
Sends a 'handleScrollToTop' message to the test application via the
SystemChannels.statusBar channel, to simulate an iOS status bar tap
event.

name: startGesture
desc:
Creates a gesture with an initial appropriate starting gesture at a
particular point, and returns the TestGesture object which you can use
to continue the gesture. Usually, the starting gesture will be a down event,
but if kind is set to PointerDeviceKind.trackpad, the gesture will start
with a panZoomStart gesture.

name: state
desc: The matching state in the widget tree.

name: stateList
desc: The matching states in the widget tree.

name: tap
desc:
Dispatch a pointer down / pointer up sequence at the center of
the given widget, assuming it is exposed.

name: tapAt
desc: Dispatch a pointer down / pointer up sequence at the given location.

name: tapOnText
desc:
Dispatch a pointer down / pointer up sequence at a hit-testable
InlineSpan (typically a TextSpan) within the given text range.

name: timedDrag
desc:
Attempts to drag the given widget by the given offset in the duration
time, starting in the middle of the widget.

name: timedDragFrom
desc:
Attempts a series of PointerEvents to simulate a drag operation in the
duration time.

name: trackpadFling
desc:
Attempts a trackpad fling gesture starting from the center of the given
widget, moving the given distance, reaching the given speed. A trackpad
fling sends PointerPanZoom events instead of a sequence of touch events.

name: trackpadFlingFrom
desc:
Attempts a fling gesture starting from the given location, moving the
given distance, reaching the given speed. A trackpad fling sends
PointerPanZoom events instead of a sequence of touch events.

name: view
desc:
The TestFlutterView provided by default when testing with
WidgetTester.pumpWidget.

name: viewOf
desc:
Finds the TestFlutterView that is the closest ancestor of the widget
found by finder.

name: widget
desc: The matching widget in the widget tree.

name: widgetList
desc: The matching widgets in the widget tree.

name: WidgetPredicate
desc: Signature for CommonFinders.byWidgetPredicate.

name: WidgetTester
desc: Class that programmatically interacts with widgets and the test environment.

name: binding
desc: The binding instance used by the testing framework.

name: createTicker
desc: Creates a ticker with the given callback.

name: dispatchEvent
desc: Handler for device events caught by the binding in live test mode.

name: enterText
desc:
Give the text input widget specified by finder the focus and replace its
content with text, as if it had been provided by the onscreen keyboard.

name: getRestorationData
desc: Retrieves the current restoration data from the RestorationManager.

name: handlePointerEventRecord
desc:
A simulator of how the framework handles a series of PointerEvents
received from the Flutter engine.

name: hasRunningAnimations
desc: Whether there are any transient callbacks scheduled.

name: hitTestOnBinding
desc: Forwards the given location to the binding's hitTest logic.

name: idle
desc: Acts as if the application went idle.

name: pageBack
desc:
Makes an effort to dismiss the current page with a Material Scaffold or
a CupertinoPageScaffold.

name: printToConsole
desc: Calls debugPrint with the given message.

name: pump
desc: Triggers a frame after duration amount of time.

name: pumpAndSettle
desc:
Repeatedly calls pump with the given duration until there are no
longer any frames scheduled. This will call pump at least once, even if
no frames are scheduled when the function is called, to flush any pending
microtasks which may themselves schedule a frame.

name: pumpBenchmark
desc: Triggers a frame after duration amount of time, return as soon as the frame is drawn.

name: pumpFrames
desc:
Repeatedly pump frames that render the target widget with a fixed time
interval as many as maxDuration allows.

name: pumpWidget
desc: Renders the UI from the given widget.

name: restartAndRestore
desc:
Simulates restoring the state of the widget tree after the application
is restarted.

name: restoreFrom
desc:
Restores the widget tree under test to the state described by the
provided TestRestorationData.

name: runAsync
desc: Runs a callback that performs real asynchronous work.

name: sendEventToBinding
desc: Forwards the given pointer event to the binding.

name: showKeyboard
desc:
Give the text input widget specified by finder the focus, as if the
onscreen keyboard had appeared.

name: takeAnnouncements
desc:
Returns a list of all the accessibility announcements made by the Flutter
framework since the last time this function was called.

name: takeException
desc: Returns the exception most recently caught by the Flutter framework.

name: testDescription
desc: The description string of the test currently being run.

name: testTextInput
desc: Returns the TestTextInput singleton.

name: verifyTickersWereDisposed
desc:
Throws an exception if any tickers created by the WidgetTester are still
active when the method is called.

name: WidgetTesterCallback
desc: Signature for callback to testWidgets and benchmarkWidgets.

name: addTearDown
desc: Registers a function to be run after the current test.

name: androidTapTargetGuideline
desc:
A guideline which requires tappable semantic nodes a minimum size of
48 by 48.

name: autoUpdateGoldenFiles
desc:
Whether golden files should be automatically updated during tests rather
than compared to the image bytes recorded by the tests.

name: benchmarkWidgets
desc: Runs the callback inside the Flutter benchmark environment.

name: canCaptureImage
desc: Whether or not captureImage is supported.

name: captureImage
desc: Render the closest RepaintBoundary of the element into an image.

name: clipsWithBoundingRRect
desc:
Asserts that a Finder locates a single object whose root RenderObject
is a RenderClipRRect with no clipper set, and border radius equals to
borderRadius, or an equivalent RenderClipPath.

name: clipsWithBoundingRect
desc:
Asserts that a Finder locates a single object whose root RenderObject
is a RenderClipRect with no clipper set, or an equivalent
RenderClipPath.

name: clipsWithShapeBorder
desc:
Asserts that a Finder locates a single object whose root RenderObject
is a RenderClipPath with a ShapeBorderClipper that clips to
shape.

name: collectAllElementsFrom
desc:
Provides an iterable that efficiently returns all the Elements
rooted at the given Element. See CachingIterable for details.

name: collectAllSemanticsNodesFrom
desc:
Provides an iterable that efficiently returns all the SemanticsNodes
rooted at the given SemanticsNode. See CachingIterable for details.

name: colorEpsilon
desc: Default threshold for isSameColorAs and isSameColorSwatchAs.

name: compareLists
desc:
Returns a ComparisonResult to describe the pixel differential of the
test and master image bytes provided.

name: completion
desc:
Matches a Future that completes successfully with a value that matches
matcher.

name: containsSemantics
desc: Asserts that a SemanticsNode contains the specified information.

name: coversSameAreaAs
desc: Asserts that 2 paths cover the same area by sampling multiple points.

name: createTestImage
desc: Creates an arbitrarily sized image for testing.

name: doesNotMeetGuideline
desc: The inverse matcher of meetsGuideline.

name: emits
desc: Returns a StreamMatcher for matcher.

name: emitsAnyOf
desc:
Returns a StreamMatcher that matches the stream if at least one of
matchers matches.

name: emitsError
desc:
Returns a StreamMatcher that matches a single error event that matches
matcher.

name: emitsInAnyOrder
desc:
Returns a StreamMatcher that matches the stream if each matcher in
matchers matches, in any order.

name: emitsInOrder
desc:
Returns a StreamMatcher that matches the stream if each matcher in
matchers matches, one after another.

name: emitsThrough
desc:
Returns a StreamMatcher that matches any number of events followed by
events that match matcher.

name: equalsIgnoringHashCodes
desc:
Asserts that two Strings or Iterable<String>s are equal after
normalizing likely hash codes.

name: expect
desc: Assert that actual matches matcher.

name: expectAsync
desc:
This function is deprecated because it doesn't work well with strong mode.
Use expectAsync0, expectAsync1,
expectAsync2, expectAsync3, expectAsync4, expectAsync5, or
expectAsync6 instead.

name: expectAsync0
desc:
Informs the framework that the given callback of arity 0 is expected to be
called count number of times (by default 1).

name: expectAsync1
desc:
Informs the framework that the given callback of arity 1 is expected to be
called count number of times (by default 1).

name: expectAsync2
desc:
Informs the framework that the given callback of arity 2 is expected to be
called count number of times (by default 1).

name: expectAsync3
desc:
Informs the framework that the given callback of arity 3 is expected to be
called count number of times (by default 1).

name: expectAsync4
desc:
Informs the framework that the given callback of arity 4 is expected to be
called count number of times (by default 1).

name: expectAsync5
desc:
Informs the framework that the given callback of arity 5 is expected to be
called count number of times (by default 1).

name: expectAsync6
desc:
Informs the framework that the given callback of arity 6 is expected to be
called count number of times (by default 1).

name: expectAsyncUntil0
desc:
Informs the framework that the given callback of arity 0 is expected to be
called until isDone returns true.

name: expectAsyncUntil1
desc:
Informs the framework that the given callback of arity 1 is expected to be
called until isDone returns true.

name: expectAsyncUntil2
desc:
Informs the framework that the given callback of arity 2 is expected to be
called until isDone returns true.

name: expectAsyncUntil3
desc:
Informs the framework that the given callback of arity 3 is expected to be
called until isDone returns true.

name: expectAsyncUntil4
desc:
Informs the framework that the given callback of arity 4 is expected to be
called until isDone returns true.

name: expectAsyncUntil5
desc:
Informs the framework that the given callback of arity 5 is expected to be
called until isDone returns true.

name: expectAsyncUntil6
desc:
Informs the framework that the given callback of arity 6 is expected to be
called until isDone returns true.

name: expectLater
desc:
Just like expect, but returns a Future that completes when the matcher
has finished matching.

name: expectSync
desc: Assert that actual matches matcher.

name: fail
desc:
Convenience method for throwing a new TestFailure with the provided
message.

name: find
desc: Some frequently used Finders and SemanticsFinders.

name: findsAny
desc: Asserts that the FinderBase locates at least one matching candidate.

name: findsAtLeast
desc: Asserts that the FinderBase locates at least the given number of candidates.

name: findsAtLeastNWidgets
desc: Asserts that the FinderBase locates at least a number of widgets in the widget tree.

name: findsExactly
desc: Asserts that the FinderBase locates the specified number of candidates.

name: findsNWidgets
desc: Asserts that the FinderBase locates the specified number of widgets in the widget tree.

name: findsNothing
desc: Asserts that the FinderBase matches nothing in the available candidates.

name: findsOne
desc: Asserts that the FinderBase finds exactly one matching candidate.

name: findsOneWidget
desc: Asserts that the FinderBase locates at exactly one widget in the widget tree.

name: findsWidgets
desc: Asserts that the FinderBase locates at least one widget in the widget tree.

name: goldenFileComparator
desc: Compares pixels against those of a golden image file.

name: group
desc: Creates a group of tests.

name: hasAGoodToStringDeep
desc:
Asserts that an object's toStringDeep() is a plausible multiline
description.

name: hasNoImmediateClip
desc:
Asserts that a Finder locates a single object whose root RenderObject is
not a RenderClipRect, RenderClipRRect, RenderClipOval, or
RenderClipPath.

name: hasOneLineDescription
desc: Asserts that an object's toString() is a plausible one-line description.

name: iOSTapTargetGuideline
desc:
A guideline which requires tappable semantic nodes a minimum size of
44 by 44.

name: isAccessibilityAnnouncement
desc: Asserts that a CapturedAccessibilityAnnouncement matches the expected message.

name: isAssertionError
desc: A matcher for AssertionError.

name: isBrowser
desc: Whether the test is running in a web browser compiled to JavaScript or WebAssembly.

name: isFlutterError
desc: A matcher for FlutterError.

name: isInCard
desc:
Asserts that the Finder locates a single widget that has at
least one Card widget ancestor.

name: isInstanceOf
desc: A matcher that compares the type of the actual value to the type argument T.

name: isLinux
desc: Whether the test is running on the Linux operating system.

name: isMacOS
desc: Whether the test is running on the macOS operating system.

name: isMethodCall
desc:
A matcher for MethodCalls, asserting that it has the specified
method name and arguments.

name: isNotInCard
desc:
Asserts that the Finder locates a single widget that has no
Card widget ancestors.

name: isOffstage
desc:
Asserts that the Finder locates a single widget that has at
least one Offstage widget ancestor.

name: isOnstage
desc:
Asserts that the Finder locates a single widget that has no
Offstage widget ancestors.

name: isPathThat
desc:
Matches a Path that contains (as defined by Path.contains) the given
includes points and does not contain the given excludes points.

name: isRenderObjectAncestorOfTarget
desc:
Returns true if renderObject is equal to target or is an ancestor of
target in the render tree.

name: isSameColorAs
desc: Asserts that the object represents the same color as color when used to paint.

name: isSameColorSwatchAs
desc:
Asserts that the object represents the same color swatch as color when
used to paint.

name: isSemantics
desc: Asserts that a SemanticsNode contains the specified information.

name: isSystemTextScaler
desc:
Asserts that the object is a TextScaler that reflects the user's font
scale preferences from the platform's accessibility settings.

name: isWindows
desc: Whether the test is running on the Windows operating system.

name: kBuildBudget
desc:
The maximum amount of time considered safe to spend for a frame's build
phase. Anything past that is in the danger of missing the frame as 60FPS.

name: kDebugWarning
desc: The warning message to show when a benchmark is performed with assert on.

name: kDragSlopDefault
desc:
The default drag touch slop used to break up a large drag into multiple
smaller moves.

name: labeledTapTargetGuideline
desc:
A guideline which enforces that all nodes with a tap or long press action
also have a label.

name: markTestSkipped
desc: Marks the current test as skipped.

name: matchesGoldenFile
desc:
Asserts that a Finder, Future<ui.Image>, or ui.Image matches the
golden image file identified by key, with an optional version number.

name: matchesReferenceImage
desc:
Asserts that a Finder, Future<ui.Image>, or ui.Image matches a
reference image identified by image.

name: matchesSemantics
desc: Asserts that a SemanticsNode contains the specified information.

name: matrix3MoreOrLessEquals
desc: Asserts that two Matrix3s are equal, within some tolerated error.

name: matrixMoreOrLessEquals
desc: Asserts that two Matrix4s are equal, within some tolerated error.

name: mayEmit
desc:
Returns a StreamMatcher that allows (but doesn't require) matcher to
match the stream.

name: mayEmitMultiple
desc:
Returns a StreamMatcher that matches any number of events that match
matcher.

name: meetsGuideline
desc:
Asserts that the currently rendered widget meets the provided accessibility
guideline.

name: moreOrLessEquals
desc: Asserts that two doubles are equal, within some tolerated error.

name: neverEmits
desc:
Returns a StreamMatcher that matches a stream that never matches
matcher.

name: nonconst
desc:
This function can be used to call a const constructor in such a way as to
create a new instance rather than creating the common const instance.

name: offsetMoreOrLessEquals
desc: Asserts that two Offsets are equal, within some tolerated error.

name: paints
desc:
Matches objects or functions that paint a display list that matches the
canvas calls described by the pattern.

name: paintsAssertion
desc: Matches objects or functions that assert when they try to paint.

name: paintsExactlyCountTimes
desc:
Matches objects or functions that draw methodName exactly count number
of times.

name: paintsNothing
desc: Matches objects or functions that does not paint anything on the canvas.

name: printOnFailure
desc: Prints message if and when the current test fails.

name: prints
desc: Matches a Function that prints text that matches matcher.

name: pumpEventQueue
desc:
Returns a Future that completes after the event loop has run the given
number of times (20 by default).

name: rectMoreOrLessEquals
desc: Asserts that two Rects are equal, within some tolerated error.

name: registerException
desc: Registers an exception that was caught for the current test.

name: rendersOnPhysicalModel
desc:
Asserts that a Finder locates a single object whose root RenderObject
is a RenderPhysicalModel or a RenderPhysicalShape.

name: rendersOnPhysicalShape
desc:
Asserts that a Finder locates a single object whose root RenderObject
is RenderPhysicalShape that uses a ShapeBorderClipper that clips to
shape as its clipper.
If elevation is non null asserts that RenderPhysicalShape.elevation is
equal to elevation.

name: reportExpectCall
desc:
Report call site for expect() call. Returns the number of frames that
should be elided if a stack were to be modified to hide the expect call, or
zero if no such call was found.

name: reportTestException
desc:
A function that is called by the test framework when an unexpected error
occurred during a test.

name: setUp
desc: Registers a function to be run before tests.

name: setUpAll
desc: Registers a function to be run once before all tests.

name: simulateKeyDownEvent
desc: Simulates sending a hardware key down event through the system channel.

name: simulateKeyRepeatEvent
desc: Simulates sending a hardware key repeat event through the system channel.

name: simulateKeyUpEvent
desc: Simulates sending a hardware key up event through the system channel.

name: spawnHybridCode
desc:
Spawns a VM isolate that runs the given dartCode, which is loaded as the
contents of a Dart library.

name: spawnHybridUri
desc: Spawns a VM isolate for the given uri, which may be a Uri or a String.

name: tearDown

desc:
This library provides internationalization and localization. This includes
message formatting and replacement, date and number formatting and parsing,
and utilities for working with Bidirectional text.

name: Bidi
desc:
This provides utility methods for working with bidirectional text. All
of the methods are static, and are organized into a class primarily to
group them together for documentation and discoverability.

name: LRE
desc: Unicode "Left-To-Right Embedding" (LRE) character.

name: LRM
desc: Unicode "Left-To-Right Mark" (LRM) character.

name: PDF
desc: Unicode "Pop Directional Formatting" (PDF) character.

name: RLE
desc: Unicode "Right-To-Left Embedding" (RLE) character.

name: RLM
desc: Unicode "Right-To-Left Mark" (RLM) character.

name: detectRtlDirectionality
desc:
Check the estimated directionality of str, return true if the piece of
text should be laid out in RTL direction. If isHtml is true, the string
is HTML or HTML-escaped.

name: endsWithLtr
desc:
Determines if the exit directionality (ie, the last strongly-directional
character in text is LTR. If isHtml is true, the text is HTML or
HTML-escaped.

name: endsWithRtl
desc:
Determines if the exit directionality (ie, the last strongly-directional
character in text is RTL. If isHtml is true, the text is HTML or
HTML-escaped.

name: enforceLtrInHtml
desc:
Enforce the html snippet in LTR directionality regardless of overall
context. If the html piece was enclosed by a tag, the direction will be
applied to existing tag, otherwise a span tag will be added as wrapper.
For this reason, if html snippet start with with tag, this tag must
enclose the whole piece. If the tag already has a direction specified,
this new one will override existing one in behavior (tested on FF and IE).

name: enforceLtrInText
desc:
Enforce LTR on both end of the given text using unicode BiDi formatting
characters LRE and PDF.

name: enforceRtlInHtml
desc:
Enforce the html snippet in RTL directionality regardless of overall
context. If the html piece was enclosed by a tag, the direction will be
applied to existing tag, otherwise a span tag will be added as wrapper.
For this reason, if html snippet start with with tag, this tag must
enclose the whole piece. If the tag already has a direction specified,
this new one will override existing one in behavior (should work on
Chrome, FF, and IE since this was ported directly from the Closure
version).

name: enforceRtlInText
desc:
Enforce RTL on both end of the given text using unicode BiDi formatting
characters RLE and PDF.

name: estimateDirectionOfText
desc:
Estimates the directionality of text using the best known
general-purpose method (using relative word counts). A
TextDirection.UNKNOWN return value indicates completely neutral input.
isHtml is true if text HTML or HTML-escaped.

name: guardBracketInHtml
desc:
Apply bracket guard to str using html span tag. This is to address the
problem of messy bracket display that frequently happens in RTL layout.
If isRtlContext is true, then we explicitly want to wrap in a span of
RTL directionality, regardless of the estimated directionality.

name: guardBracketInText
desc:
Apply bracket guard to str using LRM and RLM. This is to address the
problem of messy bracket display that frequently happens in RTL layout.
This version works for both plain text and html, but in some cases is not
as good as guardBracketInHtml. If isRtlContext is true, then we
explicitly want to wrap in a span of RTL directionality, regardless of the
estimated directionality.

name: hasAnyLtr
desc:
Determines if the given text has any LTR characters in it.
If isHtml is true, the text is HTML or HTML-escaped.

name: hasAnyRtl
desc:
Determines if the given text has any RTL characters in it.
If isHtml is true, the text is HTML or HTML-escaped.

name: isRtlLanguage
desc: Check if a BCP 47 / III languageString indicates an RTL language.

name: normalizeHebrewQuote
desc:
Replace the double and single quote directly after a Hebrew character in
str with GERESH and GERSHAYIM. This is most likely the user's intention.

name: startsWithLtr
desc:
Determines if the first character in text with strong directionality is
LTR. If isHtml is true, the text is HTML or HTML-escaped.

name: startsWithRtl
desc:
Determines if the first character in text with strong directionality is
RTL. If isHtml is true, the text is HTML or HTML-escaped.

name: stripHtmlIfNeeded
desc:
Returns the input text with spaces instead of HTML tags or HTML escapes,
which is helpful for text directionality estimation.
Note: This function should not be used in other contexts.
It does not deal well with many things: comments, script,
elements, style elements, dir attribute,> in quoted attribute values,
etc. But it does handle well enough the most common use cases.
Since the worst that can happen as a result of these shortcomings is that
the wrong directionality will be estimated, we have not invested in
improving this.

name: BidiFormatter
desc:
Bidi stands for Bi-directional text.  According to
Wikipedia:
Bi-directional text is text containing text in both text directionalities,
both right-to-left (RTL) and left-to-right (LTR). It generally involves text
containing different types of alphabets, but may also refer to
boustrophedon, which is changing text directionality in each row.

name: BidiFormatter.LTR
desc:
Create a formatting object with a direction. If alwaysSpan is true we
should always use a span tag, even when the input directionality is
neutral or matches the context, so that the DOM structure of the output
does not depend on the combination of directionalities.

name: contextDirection
desc: The direction of the surrounding text (the context).

name: estimateDirection
desc:
Estimates the directionality of text using the best known
general-purpose method (using relative word counts). A
TextDirection.UNKNOWN return value indicates completely neutral input.
isHtml is true if text HTML or HTML-escaped.

name: isRTL
desc: Is true if the known context direction for this formatter is RTL.

name: wrapWithSpan
desc:
Formats a string of a given (or estimated, if not provided) direction
for use in HTML output of the context directionality, so an
opposite-directionality string is neither garbled nor garbles what follows
it.

name: wrapWithUnicode
desc:
Format text of a known (if specified) or estimated direction for use
in plain-text output of the context directionality, so an
opposite-directionality text is neither garbled nor garbles what follows
it. Unlike wrapWithSpan, this makes use of unicode BiDi formatting
characters instead of spans for wrapping. The returned string would be
RLE+text+PDF for RTL text, or LRE+text+PDF for LTR text.

Whether to exclude the gestures introduced by this widget from the
