Returns a one-line detailed description of the render object.
This description is often somewhat long.

name: toStringShort
desc: Returns a human understandable name.

name: updateCompositedLayer
desc: Update the composited layer owned by this render object.

name: visitChildren
desc: Calls visitor for each immediate child of this render object.

name: visitChildrenForSemantics
desc: Called when collecting the semantics of this node.

name: CrossAxisAlignment
desc: How the children should be placed along the cross axis in a flex layout.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: CustomClipper
desc: An interface for providing custom clips.

name: CustomClipper.new
desc: Creates a custom clipper.

name: addListener
desc: Register a closure to be notified when it is time to reclip.

name: getApproximateClipRect
desc:
Returns an approximation of the clip returned by getClip, as
an axis-aligned Rect. This is used by the semantics layer to
determine whether widgets should be excluded.

name: getClip
desc:
Returns a description of the clip given that the render object being
clipped is of the given size.

name: removeListener
desc:
Remove a previously registered closure from the list of closures that the
object notifies when it is time to reclip.

name: shouldReclip
desc:
Called whenever a new instance of the custom clipper delegate class is
provided to the clip object, or any time that a new clip object is created
with a new instance of the custom clipper delegate class (which amounts to
the same thing, because the latter is implemented in terms of the former).

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: CustomPainter
desc:
The interface used by CustomPaint (in the widgets library) and
RenderCustomPaint (in the rendering library).

name: CustomPainter.new
desc: Creates a custom painter.

name: addListener
desc: Register a closure to be notified when it is time to repaint.

name: hitTest
desc:
Called whenever a hit test is being performed on an object that is using
this custom paint delegate.

name: paint
desc:
Called whenever the object needs to paint. The given Canvas has its
coordinate space configured such that the origin is at the top left of the
box. The area of the box is the size of the size argument.

name: removeListener
desc:
Remove a previously registered closure from the list of closures that the
object notifies when it is time to repaint.

name: semanticsBuilder
desc:
Returns a function that builds semantic information for the picture drawn
by this painter.

name: shouldRebuildSemantics
desc:
Called whenever a new instance of the custom painter delegate class is
provided to the RenderCustomPaint object, or any time that a new
CustomPaint object is created with a new instance of the custom painter
delegate class (which amounts to the same thing, because the latter is
implemented in terms of the former).

name: shouldRepaint
desc:
Called whenever a new instance of the custom painter delegate class is
provided to the RenderCustomPaint object, or any time that a new
CustomPaint object is created with a new instance of the custom painter
delegate class (which amounts to the same thing, because the latter is
implemented in terms of the former).

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: CustomPainterSemantics
desc:
Contains properties describing information drawn in a rectangle contained by
the Canvas used by a CustomPaint.

name: CustomPainterSemantics.new
desc: Creates semantics information describing a rectangle on a canvas.

name: key
desc: Identifies this object in a list of siblings.

name: properties
desc:
Contains properties that are assigned to the SemanticsNode created or
updated from this object.

name: rect
desc:
The location and size of the box on the canvas where this piece of semantic
information applies.

name: tags
desc:
Tags used by the parent SemanticsNode to determine the layout of the
semantics tree.

name: transform
desc:
The transform from the canvas' coordinate system to its parent's
coordinate system.

name: DebugOverflowIndicatorMixin
desc:
An mixin indicator that is drawn when a RenderObject overflows its
container.

name: adoptChild
desc: Called by subclasses when they decide a render object is a child.

name: alwaysNeedsCompositing
desc: Whether this render object always needs compositing.

name: applyPaintTransform
desc:
Applies the transform that would be applied when painting the given child
to the given matrix.

name: assembleSemanticsNode
desc: Assemble the SemanticsNode for this RenderObject.

name: attach
desc: Mark this render object as attached to the given owner.

name: attached
desc: Whether the render tree this render object belongs to is attached to a PipelineOwner.

name: clearSemantics
desc: Removes all semantics from this render object and its descendants.

name: constraints
desc: The layout constraints most recently supplied by the parent.

name: debugAssertDoesMeetConstraints
desc:
Verify that the object's constraints are being met. Override this function
in a subclass to verify that your state matches the constraints object.
This function is only called when asserts are enabled (i.e. in debug mode)
and only when needsLayout is false. If the constraints are not met, it
should assert or throw an exception.

name: debugCanParentUseSize
desc:
Whether the parent render object is permitted to use this render object's
size.

name: debugCreator
desc: The object responsible for creating this render object.

name: debugDescribeChildren
desc:
Returns a list of DiagnosticsNode objects describing this node's
children.

name: debugDisposed
desc: Whether this has been disposed.

name: debugDoingThisLayout
desc: Whether performLayout for this render object is currently running.

name: debugDoingThisLayoutWithCallback
desc: Whether invokeLayoutCallback for this render object is currently running.

name: debugDoingThisPaint
desc: Whether paint for this render object is currently running.

name: debugDoingThisResize
desc: Whether performResize for this render object is currently running.

name: debugFillProperties
desc: Add additional properties associated with the node.

name: debugLayer
desc: In debug mode, the compositing layer that this render object uses to repaint.

name: debugLayoutParent
desc:
The RenderObject that's expected to call layout on this RenderObject
in its performLayout implementation.

name: debugNeedsCompositedLayerUpdate
desc: Whether this render object's layer information is dirty.

name: debugNeedsLayout
desc: Whether this render object's layout information is dirty.

name: debugNeedsPaint
desc: Whether this render object's paint information is dirty.

name: debugNeedsSemanticsUpdate
desc: Whether the semantics of this render object is dirty and await the update.

name: debugPaint
desc: Override this method to paint debugging information.

name: debugRegisterRepaintBoundaryPaint
desc:
Called, in debug mode, if isRepaintBoundary is true, when either the
this render object or its parent attempt to paint.

name: debugResetSize
desc:
If a subclass has a "size" (the state controlled by parentUsesSize,
whatever it is in the subclass, e.g. the actual size property of
RenderBox), and the subclass verifies that in debug mode this "size"
property isn't used when debugCanParentUseSize isn't set, then that
subclass should override debugResetSize to reapply the current values of
debugCanParentUseSize to that state.

name: debugSemantics
desc: The semantics of this render object.

name: depth
desc: The depth of this render object in the render tree.

name: describeApproximatePaintClip
desc:
Returns a rect in this object's coordinate system that describes
the approximate bounding box of the clip rect that would be
applied to the given child during the paint phase, if any.

name: describeForError
desc:
Adds a debug representation of a RenderObject optimized for including in
error messages.

name: describeSemanticsClip
desc:
Returns a rect in this object's coordinate system that describes
which SemanticsNodes produced by the child should be included in the
semantics tree. SemanticsNodes from the child that are positioned
outside of this rect will be dropped. Child SemanticsNodes that are
positioned inside this rect, but outside of describeApproximatePaintClip
will be included in the tree marked as hidden. Child SemanticsNodes
that are inside of both rect will be included in the tree as regular
nodes.

name: describeSemanticsConfiguration
desc: Report the semantics of this node, for example for accessibility purposes.

name: detach
desc: Mark this render object as detached from its PipelineOwner.

name: dispose
desc: Release any resources held by this render object.

name: dropChild
desc: Called by subclasses when they decide a render object is no longer a child.

name: getTransformTo
desc:
Applies the paint transform from this RenderObject to the target
RenderObject.

name: handleEvent
desc: Override this method to handle pointer events that hit this render object.

name: hashCode
desc: The hash code for this object.

name: invokeLayoutCallback
desc:
Allows mutations to be made to this object's child list (and any
descendants) as well as to any other dirty nodes in the render tree owned
by the same PipelineOwner as this object. The callback argument is
invoked synchronously, and the mutations are allowed only during that
callback's execution.

name: isRepaintBoundary
desc: Whether this render object repaints separately from its parent.

name: layer
desc: The compositing layer that this render object uses to repaint.

name: layout
desc: Compute the layout for this render object.

name: markNeedsCompositedLayerUpdate
desc:
Mark this render object as having changed a property on its composited
layer.

name: markNeedsCompositingBitsUpdate
desc: Mark the compositing state for this render object as dirty.

name: markNeedsLayout
desc:
Mark this render object's layout information as dirty, and either register
this object with its PipelineOwner, or defer to the parent, depending on
whether this object is a relayout boundary or not respectively.

name: markNeedsLayoutForSizedByParentChange
desc:
Mark this render object's layout information as dirty (like
markNeedsLayout), and additionally also handle any necessary work to
handle the case where sizedByParent has changed value.

name: markNeedsPaint
desc: Mark this render object as having changed its visual appearance.

name: markNeedsSemanticsUpdate
desc: Mark this node as needing an update to its semantics description.

name: markParentNeedsLayout
desc:
Mark this render object's layout information as dirty, and then defer to
the parent.

name: needsCompositing
desc: Whether we or one of our descendants has a compositing layer.

name: noSuchMethod
desc: Invoked when a nonexistent method or property is accessed.

name: operator ==
desc: The equality operator.

name: owner
desc: The owner for this render object (null if unattached).

name: paint
desc: Paint this render object into the given context at the given offset.

name: paintBounds
desc:
An estimate of the bounds within which this render object will paint.
Useful for debugging flags such as debugPaintLayerBordersEnabled.

name: paintOverflowIndicator
desc: To be called when the overflow indicators should be painted.

name: paintsChild
desc: Whether the given child would be painted if paint were called.

name: parent
desc: The parent of this render object in the render tree.

name: parentData
desc: Data for use by the parent render object.

name: performLayout
desc: Do the work of computing the layout for this render object.

name: performResize
desc: Updates the render objects size using only the constraints.

name: reassemble
desc:
Cause the entire subtree rooted at the given RenderObject to be marked
dirty for layout, paint, etc, so that the effects of a hot reload can be
seen, or so that the effect of changing a global debug flag (such as
debugPaintSizeEnabled) can be applied.

name: redepthChild
desc:
Adjust the depth of the given child to be greater than this node's own
depth.

name: redepthChildren
desc: Adjust the depth of this node's children, if any.

name: replaceRootLayer
desc:
Replace the layer. This is only valid for the root of a render
object subtree (whatever object scheduleInitialPaint was
called on).

name: runtimeType
desc: A representation of the runtime type of the object.

name: scheduleInitialLayout
desc: Bootstrap the rendering pipeline by scheduling the very first layout.

name: scheduleInitialPaint
desc: Bootstrap the rendering pipeline by scheduling the very first paint.

name: scheduleInitialSemantics
desc:
Bootstrap the semantics reporting mechanism by marking this node
as needing a semantics update.

name: semanticBounds
desc:
The bounding box, in the local coordinate system, of this
object, for accessibility purposes.

name: sendSemanticsEvent
desc: Sends a SemanticsEvent associated with this render object's SemanticsNode.

name: setupParentData
desc: Override to setup parent data correctly for your children.

name: showOnScreen
desc:
Attempt to make (a portion of) this or a descendant RenderObject visible
on screen.

name: sizedByParent
desc:
Whether the constraints are the only input to the sizing algorithm (in
particular, child nodes have no impact).

name: toDiagnosticsNode

Returns a debug representation of the object that is used by debugging
tools and by DiagnosticsNode.toStringDeep.

name: toString

name: toStringDeep

Returns a description of the tree rooted at this node.
If the prefix argument is provided, then every line in the output
will be prefixed by that string.

name: FixedColumnWidth
desc: Sizes the column to a specific number of pixels.

desc: Creates a column width based on a fixed number of logical pixels.

name: maxIntrinsicWidth
desc:
The ideal width that the column should have. This must be equal
to or greater than the minIntrinsicWidth. The column might be
bigger than this width, e.g. if the column is flexible or if the
table's width ends up being forced to be bigger than the sum of
all the maxIntrinsicWidth values.

name: minIntrinsicWidth
desc: The smallest width that the column can have.

name: toString

name: value
desc: The width the column should occupy in logical pixels.

Sizes the column by taking a part of the remaining space once all

name: FlexColumnWidth.new
desc:
Creates a column width based on a fraction of the remaining space once all
the other columns have been laid out.

name: flex
desc:
The flex factor to apply to the cell if there is any room left
over when laying out the table. The remaining space is
distributed to any columns with flex in proportion to their flex
value (higher values get more space).

name: maxIntrinsicWidth

The ideal width that the column should have. This must be equal
to or greater than the minIntrinsicWidth. The column might be
bigger than this width, e.g. if the column is flexible or if the
table's width ends up being forced to be bigger than the sum of
all the maxIntrinsicWidth values.

name: minIntrinsicWidth
desc: The smallest width that the column can have.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: value
desc:
The fraction of the remaining space once all the other columns have
been laid out that this column should occupy.

name: FlexFit

Generate vertex normals based on a list of positions and indices.
normals is assumed to be zeroed out, and much match positions in length.
indices is assumed to represent a triangle list.

name: generateTangents
desc:
Generate vertex tangents based on a list of positions, normals,
texCoords and indices.
tangents is assumed to be zeroed out, and much match positions,
normals, and texCoords in length.
indices is assumed to represent a triangle list.
Tangents are returned as Vector4s. The X, Y, and Z component represent
the tangent and the W component represents the direction of the bitangent
which can be generated as:
vec4 bitangent = cross(normal, tangent.xyz) * tangent.w;
Derived from the granddaddy of all tangent generation functions:
http://www.terathon.com/code/tangent.html

name: clearHttpProfile
desc:
The clearHttpProfile RPC is used to clear previously recorded HTTP
requests from the HTTP profiler state. Requests still in-flight after
clearing the profiler state will be ignored by the profiler.

name: clearSocketProfile
desc: Removes all statistics associated with prior and current sockets.

name: clearWebSocketProfile
desc: Clears all WebSocket profiling data.

name: getDartIOVersion
desc:
The getDartIOVersion RPC returns the available version of the dart:io
service protocol extensions.

name: getHttpProfile
desc:
The getHttpProfile RPC is used to retrieve HTTP profiling information
for requests made via dart:io's HttpClient.

name: getHttpProfileRequest
desc:
The getHttpProfileRequest RPC is used to retrieve an instance of
HttpProfileRequest, which includes request and response body data.

name: getOpenFileById
desc:
The getOpenFileById RPC is used to retrieve information about files
currently opened by dart:io from a given isolate.

name: getOpenFiles
desc:
The getOpenFiles RPC is used to retrieve the list of files currently
opened files by dart:io from a given isolate.

name: getSocketProfile
desc:
The getSocketProfile RPC is used to retrieve socket statistics collected
by the socket profiler. Only samples collected after the initial
socketProfilingEnabled call or the last call to clearSocketProfile
will be reported.

name: getSpawnedProcessById
desc:
The getSpawnedProcessById RPC is used to retrieve information about a process
spawned by dart:io from a given isolate.

name: getSpawnedProcesses
desc:
The getSpawnedProcesses RPC is used to retrieve the list of processed opened
by dart:io from a given isolate

name: getWebSocketConnection
desc:
The getWebSocketConnection RPC retrieves a single profiled WebSocket
connection.

name: getWebSocketProfile
desc:
The getWebSocketProfile RPC is used to retrieve WebSocket profiling
information collected by dart:io.

name: httpEnableTimelineLogging
desc:
The httpEnableTimelineLogging RPC is used to set and inspect the value of
HttpClient.enableTimelineLogging, which determines if HTTP client requests
and WebSocket activity should be logged to the timeline.
If enabled is provided, the state of HttpClient.enableTimelineLogging
will be updated to the value of enabled.

name: isHttpProfilingAvailable

name: isHttpTimelineLoggingAvailable

name: isSocketProfilingAvailable
desc: Whether socket profiling is available for the given isolateId.

name: isWebSocketProfilingAvailable
desc: Whether WebSocket profiling is available for the given isolateId.

name: socketProfilingEnabled
desc:
The socketProfilingEnabled RPC is used to enable/disable the socket profiler
and query its current state. If enabled is provided, the profiler state will
be updated to reflect the value of enabled.

desc:
The column associated with this location. Only provided for non-synthetic
token positions.

name: endTokenPos
desc: The last token of the location if this is a range.

name: line
desc:
The line associated with this location. Only provided for non-synthetic
token positions.

name: script
desc: The script containing the source location.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: tokenPos
desc: The first token of the location.

name: SourceReport
desc:
The SourceReport class represents a set of reports tied to source
locations in an isolate.

name: ranges
desc:
A list of ranges in the program source.  These ranges correspond to ranges
of executable code in the user's program (functions, methods,
constructors, etc.)

name: scripts
desc: A list of scripts, referenced by index in the report's ranges.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: SourceReportCoverage
desc:
The SourceReportCoverage class represents coverage information for one
SourceReportRange.

name: hits
desc:
A list of token positions (or line numbers if reportLines was enabled) in
a SourceReportRange which have been executed.  The list is sorted.

name: misses
desc:
A list of token positions (or line numbers if reportLines was enabled) in
a SourceReportRange which have not been executed.  The list is sorted.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: kBranchCoverage
desc: Used to request branch coverage information.

name: kCoverage
desc: Used to request a code coverage information.

name: kPossibleBreakpoints
desc: Used to request a list of token positions of possible breakpoints.

name: SourceReportRange
desc:
The SourceReportRange class represents a range of executable code
(function, method, constructor, etc) in the running program. It is part of a
SourceReport.

name: branchCoverage
desc:
Branch coverage information for this range.  Provided only when the
BranchCoverage report has been requested and the range has been compiled.

name: compiled
desc: Has this range been compiled by the Dart VM?

name: coverage
desc:
Code coverage information for this range.  Provided only when the Coverage
report has been requested and the range has been compiled.

name: endPos
desc: The token position at which this range ends.  Inclusive.

name: error
desc:
The error while attempting to compile this range, if this report was
generated with forceCompile=true.

name: possibleBreakpoints
desc:
Possible breakpoint information for this range, represented as a sorted
list of token positions (or line numbers if reportLines was enabled).
Provided only when the when the PossibleBreakpoint report has been
requested and the range has been compiled.

name: scriptIndex
desc:
An index into the script table of the SourceReport, indicating which
script contains this range of code.

name: startPos
desc: The token position at which this range begins.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: SpawnedProcess
desc: A SpawnedProcess contains startup information of a spawned process.

name: arguments
desc: The list of arguments provided to the process at launch.

name: id
desc: The unique ID associated with this process.

name: name
desc: The name of the executable.

name: pid
desc: The process ID associated with the process.

name: startedAt
desc: The time the process was started in milliseconds since epoch.

name: workingDirectory
desc: The working directory of the process at launch.

name: processes
desc: A list of processes spawned through dart:io on a given isolate.

name: SpawnedProcessRef
desc:
A SpawnedProcessRef contains identifying information about a spawned
process.

name: id
desc: The unique ID associated with this process.

name: name
desc: The name of the executable.

name: Stack
desc:
The Stack class represents the various components of a Dart stack trace
for a given isolate.

name: asyncCausalFrames
desc:
A list of frames which contains both synchronous part and the asynchronous
continuation e.g. async functions awaiting completion of the currently
running async function. Asynchronous frames are separated from each
other and synchronous prefix via frames of kind
FrameKind.kAsyncSuspensionMarker.

name: awaiterFrames
desc:
Deprecated since version 4.7 of the protocol. Will be always absent in the
response.

name: frames
desc:
A list of frames that make up the synchronous stack, rooted at the message
loop (i.e., the frames since the last asynchronous gap or the isolate's
entrypoint).

name: messages
desc:
Deprecated since version 4.22 of the protocol. Will always be empty in the
response.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: truncated
desc:
Specifies whether or not this stack is complete or has been artificially
truncated.

name: StepOption
desc:
A StepOption indicates which form of stepping is requested in a resume
RPC.

name: Success
desc:
The Success type is used to indicate that an operation completed
successfully.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: Timeline
desc: See VmService.getVMTimeline;

name: timeExtentMicros
desc: The duration of time covered by the timeline.

name: timeOriginMicros
desc: The start of the period of time in which traceEvents were collected.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: traceEvents
desc:
A list of timeline events. No order is guaranteed for these events; in
particular, these events may be unordered with respect to their
timestamps.

name: TimelineEvent
desc:
An TimelineEvent is an arbitrary map that contains a Trace Event Format
event.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: availableStreams
desc: The list of all available timeline streams.

name: recordedStreams
desc: The list of timeline streams that are currently enabled.

name: recorderName
desc:
The name of the recorder currently in use. Recorder types include, but are
not limited to: Callback, Endless, Fuchsia, Macos, Ring, Startup, and
Systrace. Set to "null" if no recorder is currently set.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: timestamp
desc: A timestamp in microseconds since epoch.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: TypeArguments
desc:
A TypeArguments object represents the type argument vector for some
instantiated generic type.

name: hashCode
desc: The hash code for this object.

name: name
desc: A name for this type argument list.

name: operator ==
desc: The equality operator.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: types
desc: A list of types.

name: TypeArgumentsRef
desc: TypeArgumentsRef is a reference to a TypeArguments object.

name: hashCode
desc: The hash code for this object.

name: name
desc: A name for this type argument list.

name: operator ==
desc: The equality operator.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: TypeParameters
desc:
A TypeParameters object represents the type argument vector for some
uninstantiated generic type.

name: bounds
desc: The bounds set on each type parameter.

name: defaults
desc: The default types for each type parameter.

name: hashCode
desc: The hash code for this object.

name: names
desc: The names of the type parameters.

name: operator ==
desc: The equality operator.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: TypeParametersRef
desc: TypeParametersRef is a reference to a TypeParameters object.

name: hashCode
desc: The hash code for this object.

name: operator ==
desc: The equality operator.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: UnresolvedSourceLocation
desc:
The UnresolvedSourceLocation class is used to refer to an unresolved
breakpoint location. As such, it is meant to approximate the final location
of the breakpoint but it is not exact.

name: column
desc:
An approximate column number for the source location. This may change when
the location is resolved.

name: line
desc:
An approximate line number for the source location. This may change when
the location is resolved.

name: script
desc: The script containing the source location if the script has been loaded.

name: scriptUri
desc:
The uri of the script containing the source location if the script has yet
to be loaded.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: tokenPos
desc:
An approximate token position for the source location. This may change
when the location is resolved.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: uris
desc: A list of URIs.

name: architectureBits
desc: Word length on target architecture (e.g. 32, 64).

name: hostCPU
desc: The CPU we are actually running on.

name: isolateGroups
desc: A list of isolate groups running in the VM.

name: isolates
desc: A list of isolates running in the VM.

name: name
desc: A name identifying this vm. Not guaranteed to be unique.

name: operatingSystem
desc: The operating system we are running on.

name: pid
desc: The process id for the VM.

name: startTime
desc: The time that the VM started in milliseconds since the epoch.

name: systemIsolateGroups
desc: A list of isolate groups which contain system isolates running in the VM.

name: systemIsolates
desc: A list of system isolates running in the VM.

name: targetCPU
desc: The CPU we are generating code for.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: version
desc: The Dart VM version string.

name: VMRef
desc: VMRef is a reference to a VM object.

name: name
desc: A name identifying this vm. Not guaranteed to be unique.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: Version
desc: See Versioning.

name: major
desc:
The major version number is incremented when the protocol is changed in a
potentially incompatible way.

name: minor
desc:
The minor version number is incremented when the protocol is changed in a
backwards compatible way.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: addBreakpoint
desc:
The addBreakpoint RPC is used to add a breakpoint at a specific line of
some script.

name: addBreakpointAtEntry
desc:
The addBreakpointAtEntry RPC is used to add a breakpoint at the
entrypoint of some function.

name: addBreakpointWithScriptUri
desc:
The addBreakpoint RPC is used to add a breakpoint at a specific line of
some script. This RPC is useful when a script has not yet been assigned an
id, for example, if a script is in a deferred library which has not yet
been loaded.

name: callMethod
desc:
Call an arbitrary service protocol method. This allows clients to call
methods not explicitly exposed by this library.

name: callServiceExtension
desc: Invoke a specific service protocol extension method.

name: clearCpuSamples
desc: Clears all CPU profiling samples.

name: clearVMTimeline
desc: Clears all VM timeline events.

name: createIdZone
desc:
The createIdZone RPC is used to create a new ID zone where temporary IDs
for instances in the specified isolate may be allocated. See IDs and
Names for more information about ID zones.

name: deleteIdZone
desc:
The deleteIdZone RPC frees the buffer that backs the specified ID zone,
and makes that zone unusable for the remainder of the program's execution.
For performance reasons, clients should aim to call invalidateIdZone and
reuse existing zones as much as possible instead of deleting zones and
then creating new ones.

name: evaluate
desc:
The evaluate RPC is used to evaluate an expression in the context of
some target.

name: evaluateInFrame
desc:
The evaluateInFrame RPC is used to evaluate an expression in the context
of a particular stack frame. frameIndex is the index of the desired
Frame, with an index of 0 indicating the top (most recent) frame.

name: getAllocationProfile
desc:
The getAllocationProfile RPC is used to retrieve allocation information
for a given isolate.

name: getAllocationTraces
desc:
The getAllocationTraces RPC allows for the retrieval of allocation
traces for objects of a specific set of types (see
VmService.setTraceClassAllocation). Only samples collected in the time
range [timeOriginMicros, timeOriginMicros + timeExtentMicros] will be
reported.

name: getClassList
desc:
The getClassList RPC is used to retrieve a ClassList containing all
classes for an isolate based on the isolate's isolateId.

name: getCpuSamples
desc:
The getCpuSamples RPC is used to retrieve samples collected by the CPU
profiler. See CpuSamples for a detailed description of the response.

name: getFlagList
desc:
The getFlagList RPC returns a list of all command line flags in the VM
along with their current values.

name: getInboundReferences
desc:
Returns a set of inbound references to the object specified by targetId.
Up to limit references will be returned.

name: getInstances
desc:
The getInstances RPC is used to retrieve a set of instances which are of
a specific class.

name: getInstancesAsList
desc:
The getInstancesAsList RPC is used to retrieve a set of instances which
are of a specific class. This RPC returns an InstanceRef corresponding
to a Dart List<dynamic> that contains the requested instances. This
List is not growable, but it is otherwise mutable. The response type is
what distinguishes this RPC from getInstances, which returns an
InstanceSet.

name: getIsolate
desc: The getIsolate RPC is used to lookup an Isolate object by its id.

name: getIsolateGroup
desc:
The getIsolateGroup RPC is used to lookup an IsolateGroup object by
its id.

name: getIsolateGroupMemoryUsage
desc:
The getIsolateGroupMemoryUsage RPC is used to lookup an isolate group's
memory usage statistics by its id.

name: getIsolatePauseEvent
desc:
The getIsolatePauseEvent RPC is used to lookup an isolate's pause event
by its id.

name: getMemoryUsage
desc:
The getMemoryUsage RPC is used to lookup an isolate's memory usage
statistics by its id.

name: getObject
desc:
The getObject RPC is used to lookup an object from some isolate by its
id.

name: getPerfettoCpuSamples
desc:
The getPerfettoCpuSamples RPC is used to retrieve samples collected by
the CPU profiler, serialized in Perfetto's proto format. See
PerfettoCpuSamples for a detailed description of the response.

name: getPerfettoVMTimeline
desc:
The getPerfettoVMTimeline RPC is used to retrieve an object which
contains a VM timeline trace represented in Perfetto's proto format. See
PerfettoTimeline for a detailed description of the response.

name: getPorts
desc:
The getPorts RPC is used to retrieve the list of ReceivePort instances
for a given isolate.

name: getProcessMemoryUsage
desc: Returns a description of major uses of memory known to the VM.

name: getQueuedMicrotasks
desc:
The getQueuedMicrotasks RPC returns a snapshot containing information
about the microtasks that were queued in the specified isolate when the
snapshot was taken.

name: getRetainingPath
desc:
The getRetainingPath RPC is used to lookup a path from an object
specified by targetId to a GC root (i.e., the object which is preventing
this object from being garbage collected).

name: getScripts
desc:
The getScripts RPC is used to retrieve a ScriptList containing all
scripts for an isolate based on the isolate's isolateId.

name: getSourceReport
desc:
The getSourceReport RPC is used to generate a set of reports tied to
source locations in an isolate.

name: getStack
desc:
The getStack RPC is used to retrieve the current execution stack and
message queue for an isolate. The isolate does not need to be paused.

name: getSupportedProtocols
desc:
The getSupportedProtocols RPC is used to determine which protocols are
supported by the current server.

name: getVM
desc: The getVM RPC returns global information about a Dart virtual machine.

name: getVMTimeline
desc:
The getVMTimeline RPC is used to retrieve an object which contains VM
timeline events. See Timeline for a detailed description of the
response.

name: getVMTimelineFlags
desc:
The getVMTimelineFlags RPC returns information about the current VM
timeline configuration.

name: getVMTimelineMicros
desc:
The getVMTimelineMicros RPC returns the current time stamp from the
clock used by the timeline, similar to Timeline.now in dart:developer
and Dart_TimelineGetMicros in the VM embedding API.

name: getVersion
desc:
The getVersion RPC is used to determine what version of the Service
Protocol is served by a VM.

name: invalidateIdZone
desc:
The invalidateIdZone RPC is used to invalidate all the IDs that have
been allocated in a certain ID zone. Invaliding the IDs makes them expire.
See IDs and Names for more information.

name: invoke
desc:
The invoke RPC is used to perform regular method invocation on some
receiver, as if by dart:mirror's ObjectMirror.invoke. Note this does not
provide a way to perform getter, setter or constructor invocation.

name: kill
desc:
The kill RPC is used to kill an isolate as if by dart:isolate's
Isolate.kill(IMMEDIATE).

name: lookupPackageUris
desc:
The lookupPackageUris RPC is used to convert a list of URIs to their
unresolved paths. For example, URIs passed to this RPC are mapped in the
following ways:

name: lookupResolvedPackageUris
desc:
The lookupResolvedPackageUris RPC is used to convert a list of URIs to
their resolved (or absolute) paths. For example, URIs passed to this RPC
are mapped in the following ways:

name: pause
desc:
The pause RPC is used to interrupt a running isolate. The RPC enqueues
the interrupt request and potentially returns before the isolate is
paused.

name: registerService
desc:
Registers a service that can be invoked by other VM service clients, where
service is the name of the service to advertise and alias is an
alternative name for the registered service.

name: registerServiceCallback
desc: Register a service for invocation.

name: reloadSources
desc:
The reloadSources RPC is used to perform a hot reload of the sources of
all isolates in the same isolate group as the isolate specified by
isolateId.

name: removeBreakpoint
desc: The removeBreakpoint RPC is used to remove a breakpoint by its id.

name: requestHeapSnapshot
desc: Requests a dump of the Dart heap of the given isolate.

name: resume
desc: The resume RPC is used to resume execution of a paused isolate.

name: setBreakpointState
desc:
The setBreakpointState RPC allows for breakpoints to be enabled or
disabled, without requiring for the breakpoint to be completely removed.

name: setExceptionPauseMode
desc:
The setExceptionPauseMode RPC is used to control if an isolate pauses
when an exception is thrown.

name: setFlag
desc:
The setFlag RPC is used to set a VM flag at runtime. Returns an error if
the named flag does not exist, the flag may not be set at runtime, or the
value is of the wrong type for the flag.

name: setIsolatePauseMode
desc:
The setIsolatePauseMode RPC is used to control if or when an isolate
will pause due to a change in execution state.

name: setLibraryDebuggable
desc:
The setLibraryDebuggable RPC is used to enable or disable whether
breakpoints and stepping work for a given library.

name: setName
desc: The setName RPC is used to change the debugging name for an isolate.

name: setTraceClassAllocation
desc:
The setTraceClassAllocation RPC allows for enabling or disabling
allocation tracing for a specific type of object. Allocation traces can be
retrieved with the getAllocationTraces RPC.

name: setVMName
desc: The setVMName RPC is used to change the debugging name for the vm.

name: setVMTimelineFlags
desc:
The setVMTimelineFlags RPC is used to set which timeline streams are
enabled.

name: streamCancel
desc: The streamCancel RPC cancels a stream subscription in the VM.

name: streamCpuSamplesWithUserTag
desc:
The streamCpuSamplesWithUserTag RPC is deprecated and calling it will
cause no effect. The RPC will return a Success object when called with
any string[] as the userTags argument, and will return an RPCError
when called with any other userTags argument.

name: streamListen
desc:
The streamListen RPC subscribes to a stream in the VM. Once subscribed,
the client will begin receiving events from the stream.

name: wrapFuture
desc: When overridden, this method wraps future with logic.

name: wsUri
desc: The web socket URI pointing to the target VM service instance.

name: WebSocketConnection
desc: Complete profiling information for a WebSocket connection.

name: WebSocketConnectionRef
desc: Profiling information for a single WebSocket connection.

name: id
desc: Unique connection identifier.

name: isolateId
desc: The ID of the isolate owning this connection.

name: state
desc: Current lifecycle state.

name: uri
desc: The remote WebSocket endpoint.

name: WebSocketEvent
desc: Describes an event related to a WebSocket connection.

name: event
desc: The title of the recorded event.

name: frameNumber
desc: Additional event-specific information.

name: timestamp
desc: The time at which the event occurred.

name: WebSocketProfile
desc: A collection of WebSocket connections collected by the profiler.

name: connections
desc: The profiled WebSocket connections.

name: timestamp
desc: Time when this profile snapshot was generated.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: decodeBase64
desc:
Decode a string in Base64 encoding into the equivalent non-encoded string.
This is useful for handling the results of the Stdout or Stderr events.

name: optional
desc: @optional

name: vmServiceConnectUri
desc: Connect to the given uri and return a new VmService instance.

name: vmServiceConnectUriWithFactory
desc:
Connect to the given uri and return a new instance of T, which is
constructed by vmServiceFactory and may be a subclass of VmService.

name: $CSS
desc:
The CSS interface holds useful CSS-related methods. No objects with
this interface are implemented: it contains only static methods and is
therefore a utilitarian interface.

name: $Console
desc:
The console object provides access to the debugging console (e.g., the
Web console
in Firefox).

name: ANGLE_instanced_arrays
desc:
The ANGLE_instanced_arrays extension is part of the
WebGL API and
allows to draw the same object, or groups of similar objects multiple times,
if they share the same vertex data, primitive count and type.

name: drawArraysInstancedANGLE
desc:
The ANGLE_instanced_arrays.drawArraysInstancedANGLE() method of the
WebGL API
renders primitives from array data like the
WebGLRenderingContext.drawArrays method. In addition, it can execute
multiple instances of the range of elements.

name: drawElementsInstancedANGLE
desc:
The ANGLE_instanced_arrays.drawElementsInstancedANGLE() method of
the
WebGL API
renders primitives from array data like the
WebGLRenderingContext.drawElements method. In addition, it can execute
multiple instances of a set of elements.

name: vertexAttribDivisorANGLE
desc:
The ANGLE_instanced_arrays.vertexAttribDivisorANGLE() method of the
WebGL API
modifies the rate at which generic vertex attributes advance when
rendering multiple instances of primitives with
ANGLE_instanced_arrays.drawArraysInstancedANGLE and
ANGLE_instanced_arrays.drawElementsInstancedANGLE.

name: AbortController
desc:
The AbortController interface represents a controller object that
allows you to abort one or more Web requests as and when desired.

name: abort
desc:
The abort() method of the AbortController interface aborts an
asynchronous operation before it has completed.
This is able to abort
fetch requests,
the consumption of any response bodies, or streams.

name: signal
desc:
The signal read-only property of the AbortController interface
returns an AbortSignal object instance, which can be used to communicate
with/abort an asynchronous operation as desired.

name: AbortSignal
desc:
The AbortSignal interface represents a signal object that allows you
to communicate with an asynchronous operation (such as a fetch request) and
abort it if required via an AbortController object.

name: abort
desc:
The AbortSignal.abort() static method returns an AbortSignal that
is already set as aborted (and which does not trigger an
AbortSignal.abort_event event).

name: aborted
desc:
The aborted read-only property returns a value that indicates
whether the asynchronous operations the signal is communicating with are
aborted (true) or not (false).

name: any
desc:
The AbortSignal.any() static method takes an iterable of abort
signals and returns an AbortSignal. The returned abort signal is aborted
when any of the input iterable abort signals are aborted. The
AbortSignal.reason will be set to the reason of the first signal that is
aborted. If any of the given abort signals are already aborted then so
will be the returned AbortSignal.

name: reason
desc:
The reason read-only property returns a JavaScript value that
indicates the abort reason.

name: throwIfAborted
desc:
The throwIfAborted() method throws the signal's abort
AbortSignal.reason if the signal has been aborted; otherwise it does
nothing.

name: timeout
desc:
The AbortSignal.timeout() static method returns an AbortSignal
that will automatically abort after a specified time.

name: AbsoluteOrientationSensor
desc:
The AbsoluteOrientationSensor interface of the
Sensor APIs
describes the device's physical orientation in relation to the Earth's
reference coordinate system.

name: AbstractRange
desc:
The AbstractRange abstract interface is the base class upon which all
range types are defined. A range is an object that indicates the start
and end points of a section of content within the document.

name: collapsed
desc:
The read-only collapsed property of the AbstractRange interface
returns true if the range's start position and end position are the
same.

name: endContainer
desc:
The read-only endContainer property of the AbstractRange interface
returns the Node in which the end of the range is located.

name: endOffset
desc:
The endOffset property of the AbstractRange interface returns the
offset into the end node of the range's end position.

name: startContainer
desc:
The read-only startContainer property of the AbstractRange
interface returns the start Node for the range.

name: startOffset
desc:
The read-only startOffset property of the AbstractRange interface
returns the offset into the start node of the range's start position.

name: AnalyserNode
desc:
The AnalyserNode interface represents a node able to provide real-time
frequency and time-domain analysis information. It is an AudioNode that
passes the audio stream unchanged from the input to the output, but allows
you to take the generated data, process it, and create audio visualizations.

name: fftSize
desc:
The fftSize property of the AnalyserNode interface is an unsigned
long value and represents the window size in samples that is used when
performing a
Fast Fourier Transform
(FFT) to get frequency domain data.

name: frequencyBinCount
desc:
The frequencyBinCount read-only property of the AnalyserNode
interface contains the total number of data points available to
AudioContext BaseAudioContext.sampleRate. This is half of the value
of the AnalyserNode.fftSize. The two methods' indices have a linear
relationship with the frequencies they represent, between 0 and the
Nyquist frequency.

name: getByteFrequencyData
desc:
The getByteFrequencyData() method of the AnalyserNode interface
copies the current frequency data into a Uint8Array (unsigned byte
array) passed into it.

name: getByteTimeDomainData
desc:
The getByteTimeDomainData() method of the AnalyserNode Interface
copies the current waveform, or time-domain, data into a Uint8Array
(unsigned byte array) passed into it.

name: getFloatFrequencyData
desc:
The getFloatFrequencyData() method of the AnalyserNode Interface
copies the current frequency data into a Float32Array array passed into
it. Each array value is a sample, the magnitude of the signal at a
particular time.

name: getFloatTimeDomainData
desc:
The getFloatTimeDomainData() method of the AnalyserNode Interface
copies the current waveform, or time-domain, data into a Float32Array
array passed into it. Each array value is a sample, the magnitude of the
signal at a particular time.

name: maxDecibels
desc:
The maxDecibels property of the AnalyserNode interface is a double
value representing the maximum power value in the scaling range for the
FFT analysis data, for conversion to unsigned byte values — basically,
this specifies the maximum value for the range of results when using
getByteFrequencyData().

name: minDecibels
desc:
The minDecibels property of the AnalyserNode interface is a double
value representing the minimum power value in the scaling range for the
FFT analysis data, for conversion to unsigned byte values — basically,
this specifies the minimum value for the range of results when using
getByteFrequencyData().

name: smoothingTimeConstant
desc:
The smoothingTimeConstant property of the AnalyserNode interface
is a double value representing the averaging constant with the last
analysis frame. It's basically an average between the current buffer and
the last buffer the AnalyserNode processed, and results in a much
smoother set of value changes over time.

name: Animation
desc:
The Animation interface of the
Web Animations API
represents a single animation player and provides playback controls and a
timeline for an animation node or source.

name: cancel
desc:
The Web Animations API's cancel() method of the Animation
interface clears all KeyframeEffects caused by this animation and aborts
its playback.

name: commitStyles
desc:
The commitStyles() method of the
Web Animations API's
Animation interface writes the
computed values
of the animation's current styles into its target element's
style
attribute. commitStyles() works even if the animation has been
automatically removed.

name: currentTime
desc:
The Animation.currentTime property of the
Web Animations API
returns and sets the current time value of the animation in milliseconds,
whether running or paused.

name: effect
desc:
The Animation.effect property of the
Web Animations API
gets and sets the target effect of an animation. The target effect may be
either an effect object of a type based on AnimationEffect, such as
KeyframeEffect, or null.

name: finish
desc:
The finish() method of the
Web Animations API's
Animation Interface sets the current playback time to the end of the
animation corresponding to the current playback direction.

name: finished
desc:
The Animation.finished read-only property of the
Web Animations API
returns a Promise which resolves once the animation has finished
playing.

name: id
desc:
The Animation.id property of the
Web Animations API
returns or sets a string used to identify the animation.

name: pause
desc:
The pause() method of the
Web Animations API's
Animation interface suspends playback of the animation.

name: pending
desc:
The read-only Animation.pending property of the
Web Animations API
indicates whether the animation is currently waiting for an asynchronous
operation such as initiating playback or pausing a running animation.

name: persist
desc:
The persist() method of the
Web Animations API's
Animation interface explicitly persists an animation, preventing it from
being
automatically removed
when it is replaced by another animation.

name: play
desc:
The play() method of the
Web Animations API's
Animation Interface starts or resumes playing of an animation. If the
animation is finished, calling play() restarts the animation, playing it
from the beginning.

name: playState
desc:
The read-only Animation.playState property of the
Web Animations API
returns an enumerated value describing the playback state of an animation.

name: playbackRate
desc:
The Animation.playbackRate property of the
Web Animations API
returns or sets the playback rate of the animation.

name: ready
desc:
The read-only Animation.ready property of the
Web Animations API
returns a Promise which resolves when the animation is ready to play. A
new promise is created every time the animation enters the "pending"
play state
as well as when the animation is canceled, since in both of those
scenarios, the animation is ready to be started again.

name: replaceState
desc:
The read-only Animation.replaceState property of the
Web Animations API
indicates whether the animation has been
removed by the browser automatically
after being replaced by another animation.

name: reverse
desc:
The Animation.reverse() method of the Animation Interface reverses
the playback direction, meaning the animation ends at its beginning. If
called on an unplayed animation, the whole animation is played backwards.
If called on a paused animation, the animation will continue in reverse.

name: startTime
desc:
The Animation.startTime property of the Animation interface is a
double-precision floating-point value which indicates the scheduled time
when an animation's playback should begin.

name: timeline
desc:
The Animation.timeline property of the Animation interface returns
or sets the AnimationTimeline associated with this animation. A timeline
is a source of time values for synchronization purposes, and is an
AnimationTimeline-based object. By default, the animation's timeline and
the Document's timeline are the same.

name: updatePlaybackRate
desc:
The updatePlaybackRate() method of the
Web Animations API's
Animation Interface sets the speed of an animation after first
synchronizing its playback position.

name: AnimationEffect
desc:
The AnimationEffect interface of the
Web Animations API
is an interface representing animation effects.

name: getComputedTiming
desc:
The getComputedTiming() method of the AnimationEffect interface
returns the calculated timing properties for this animation effect.

name: getTiming
desc:
The AnimationEffect.getTiming() method of the AnimationEffect
interface returns an object containing the timing properties for the
Animation Effect.

name: updateTiming
desc:
The updateTiming() method of the AnimationEffect interface updates the
specified timing properties for an animation effect.

name: AnimationEvent
desc:
The AnimationEvent interface represents events providing information
related to
animations.

name: animationName
desc:
The AnimationEvent.animationName read-only property is a
string containing the value of the  CSS
property associated with the transition.

name: elapsedTime
desc:
The AnimationEvent.elapsedTime read-only property is a
float giving the amount of time the animation has been running, in
seconds,
when this event fired, excluding any time the animation was paused. For an
Element.animationstart_event event,
elapsedTime is 0.0 unless there was a negative value for
, in which case the event will be fired with
elapsedTime containing (-1 * delay).

name: pseudoElement
desc:
The AnimationEvent.pseudoElement read-only property is a
string, starting with '::', containing the name of the
pseudo-element
the animation runs on.
If the animation doesn't run on a pseudo-element but on the element, an
empty string: ''.

name: AnimationPlaybackEvent
desc:
The AnimationPlaybackEvent interface of the
Web Animations API
represents animation events.

name: currentTime
desc:
The currentTime read-only property of the AnimationPlaybackEvent
interface represents the current time of the animation that generated the
event at the moment the event is queued. This will be unresolved if the
animation was idle at the time the event was generated.

name: timelineTime
desc:
The timelineTime read-only property of the AnimationPlaybackEvent
interface represents the time value of the animation's AnimationTimeline
at the moment the event is queued. This will be unresolved if the
animation was not associated with a timeline at the time the event was
generated or if the associated timeline was inactive.

name: AnimationTimeline
desc:
The AnimationTimeline interface of the
Web Animations API
represents the timeline of an animation. This interface exists to define
timeline features, inherited by other timeline types:

name: currentTime
desc:
The currentTime read-only property of the
Web Animations API's
AnimationTimeline interface returns the timeline's current time in
milliseconds, or null if the timeline is inactive.

name: Attr
desc:
The Attr interface represents one of an element's attributes as an
object. In most situations, you will directly retrieve the attribute value
as a string (e.g., Element.getAttribute), but some cases may require
interacting with Attr instances (e.g., Element.getAttributeNode).

name: localName
desc:
The read-only localName property of the Attr interface returns the
local part of the qualified name of an attribute, that is the name of
the attribute, stripped from any namespace in front of it. For example, if
the qualified name is xml:lang, the returned local name is lang, if
the element supports that namespace.

name: name
desc:
The read-only name property of the Attr interface returns the
qualified name of an attribute, that is the name of the attribute, with
the namespace prefix, if any, in front of it. For example, if the local
name is lang and the namespace prefix is xml, the returned qualified
name is xml:lang.

name: namespaceURI
desc:
The read-only namespaceURI property of the Attr interface returns
the namespace URI of the attribute,
or null if the element is not in a namespace.

name: ownerElement
desc:
The read-only ownerElement property of the Attr interface returns
the Element the attribute belongs to.

name: prefix
desc:
The read-only prefix property of the Attr returns the namespace
prefix of the attribute, or null if no prefix is specified.

name: specified
desc:
The read-only specified property of the Attr interface always
returns true.

name: value
desc:
The value property of the Attr interface contains the value of the
attribute.

name: AudioBuffer
desc:
The AudioBuffer interface represents a short audio asset residing in
memory, created from an audio file using the
BaseAudioContext.decodeAudioData method, or from raw data using
BaseAudioContext.createBuffer. Once put into an AudioBuffer, the audio can
then be played by being passed into an AudioBufferSourceNode.

name: copyFromChannel
desc:
The
copyFromChannel() method of the
AudioBuffer interface copies the audio sample data from the specified
channel of the AudioBuffer to a specified
Float32Array.

name: copyToChannel
desc:
The copyToChannel() method of the AudioBuffer interface copies
the samples to the specified channel of the AudioBuffer, from the source
array.

name: duration
desc:
The duration property of the AudioBuffer interface returns a
double representing the duration, in seconds, of the PCM data stored in
the buffer.

name: getChannelData
desc:
The getChannelData() method of the AudioBuffer Interface returns a
Float32Array containing the PCM data associated with the channel,
defined by the channel parameter (with 0 representing the first channel).

name: length
desc:
The length property of the AudioBuffer
interface returns an integer representing the length, in sample-frames, of
the PCM data
stored in the buffer.

name: numberOfChannels
desc:
The numberOfChannels property of the AudioBuffer
interface returns an integer representing the number of discrete audio
channels
described by the PCM data stored in the buffer.

name: sampleRate
desc:
The sampleRate property of the AudioBuffer interface returns a
float representing the sample rate, in samples per second, of the PCM data
stored in the buffer.

name: AudioBufferSourceNode
desc:
The AudioBufferSourceNode interface is an AudioScheduledSourceNode
which represents an audio source consisting of in-memory audio data, stored
in an AudioBuffer.

name: buffer
desc:
The buffer property of the AudioBufferSourceNode interface
provides the ability to play back audio using an AudioBuffer as the
source of the sound data.

name: detune
desc:
The detune property of the
AudioBufferSourceNode interface is a
k-rate
AudioParam
representing detuning of oscillation in
cents.

name: loop
desc:
The loop property of the AudioBufferSourceNode
interface is a Boolean indicating if the audio asset must be replayed when
the end of
the AudioBuffer is reached.

name: loopEnd
desc:
The loopEnd property of the AudioBufferSourceNode
interface specifies is a floating point number specifying, in seconds, at
what offset
into playing the AudioBuffer playback should loop back to the time
indicated by the AudioBufferSourceNode.loopStart property.
This is only used if the AudioBufferSourceNode.loop property is
true.

name: loopStart
desc:
The loopStart property of the AudioBufferSourceNode interface is a
floating-point value indicating, in seconds, where in the AudioBuffer
the restart of the play must happen.

name: playbackRate
desc:
The playbackRate property of
the AudioBufferSourceNode interface Is a
k-rate
AudioParam that
defines the speed at which the audio asset will be played.

name: start
desc:
The start() method of the AudioBufferSourceNode
Interface is used to schedule playback of the audio data contained in the
buffer, or
to begin playback immediately.

name: AudioContext
desc:
The AudioContext interface represents an audio-processing graph built from
audio modules linked together, each represented by an AudioNode.

name: baseLatency
desc:
The baseLatency read-only property of the
AudioContext interface returns a double that represents the number of
seconds of processing latency incurred by the AudioContext passing an
audio
buffer from the AudioDestinationNode — i.e. the end of the audio graph —
into the host system's audio subsystem ready for playing.

name: close
desc:
The close() method of the AudioContext Interface closes the audio
context, releasing any system audio resources that it uses.

name: createMediaElementSource
desc:
The createMediaElementSource() method of the AudioContext Interface is
used to create a new MediaElementAudioSourceNode object, given an
existing HTML audio or video element, the audio from which can then be
played and manipulated.

name: createMediaStreamDestination
desc:
The createMediaStreamDestination() method of the AudioContext
Interface is used to create a new MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode object
associated with a
WebRTC
MediaStream representing an audio stream, which may be stored in a local
file or sent to another computer.

name: createMediaStreamSource
desc:
The createMediaStreamSource() method of the AudioContext
Interface is used to create a new MediaStreamAudioSourceNode
object, given a media stream (say, from a MediaDevices.getUserMedia
instance), the audio from which can then be played and manipulated.

name: createMediaStreamTrackSource
desc:
The createMediaStreamTrackSource() method of the AudioContext
interface creates and returns a MediaStreamTrackAudioSourceNode which
represents an audio source whose data comes from the specified
MediaStreamTrack.

name: getOutputTimestamp
desc:
The
getOutputTimestamp() method of the
AudioContext interface returns a new AudioTimestamp object
containing two audio timestamp values relating to the current audio
context.

name: outputLatency
desc:
The outputLatency read-only property of
the AudioContext Interface provides an estimation of the output latency
of the current audio context.

name: resume
desc:
The resume() method of the AudioContext
interface resumes the progression of time in an audio context that has
previously been
suspended.

name: suspend
desc:
The suspend() method of the AudioContext Interface suspends the
progression of time in the audio context, temporarily halting audio
hardware access and reducing CPU/battery usage in the process — this is
useful if you want an application to power down the audio hardware when it
will not be using an audio context for a while.

name: AudioDestinationNode
desc:
The AudioDestinationNode interface represents the end destination of an
audio graph in a given context — usually the speakers of your device. It can
also be the node that will "record" the audio data when used with an
OfflineAudioContext.

name: maxChannelCount
desc:
The maxchannelCount property of the AudioDestinationNode interface is
an unsigned long defining the maximum amount of channels that the
physical device can handle.

name: AudioElement
desc:
All usages of this type alias should be updated to
the more consistent HTMLAudioElement.

name: AudioListener
desc:
The AudioListener interface represents the position and orientation of the
unique person listening to the audio scene, and is used in
audio spatialization.
All PannerNodes spatialize in relation to the AudioListener stored in
the BaseAudioContext.listener attribute.

name: forwardX
desc:
The forwardX read-only property of the AudioListener interface is an
AudioParam representing the x value of the direction vector defining the
forward direction the listener is pointing in.

name: forwardY
desc:
The forwardY read-only property of the AudioListener interface is an
AudioParam representing the y value of the direction vector defining the
forward direction the listener is pointing in.

name: forwardZ
desc:
The forwardZ read-only property of the AudioListener interface is an
AudioParam representing the z value of the direction vector defining the
forward direction the listener is pointing in.

name: positionX
desc:
The positionX read-only property of the AudioListener interface is an
AudioParam representing the x position of the listener in 3D cartesian
space.

name: positionY
desc:
The positionY read-only property of the AudioListener interface is an
AudioParam representing the y position of the listener in 3D cartesian
space.

name: positionZ
desc:
The positionZ read-only property of the AudioListener interface is an
AudioParam representing the z position of the listener in 3D cartesian
space.

name: setOrientation
desc:
The setOrientation() method of the AudioListener interface defines the
orientation of the listener.

name: setPosition
desc:
The setPosition() method of the AudioListener Interface defines the
position of the listener.

name: upX
desc:
The upX read-only property of the AudioListener interface is an
AudioParam representing the x value of the direction vector defining the
up direction the listener is pointing in.

name: upY
desc:
The upY read-only property of the AudioListener interface is an
AudioParam representing the y value of the direction vector defining the
up direction the listener is pointing in.

name: upZ
desc:
The upZ read-only property of the AudioListener interface is an
AudioParam representing the z value of the direction vector defining the
up direction the listener is pointing in.

name: AudioNode
desc:
The AudioNode interface is a generic interface for representing an
audio processing module.

name: channelCount
desc:
The channelCount property of the AudioNode interface represents an
integer used to determine how many channels are used when
up-mixing and down-mixing
connections to any inputs to the node.

name: channelCountMode
desc:
The channelCountMode property of the AudioNode interface represents an
enumerated value describing the way channels must be matched between the
node's inputs and outputs.

name: channelInterpretation
desc:
The channelInterpretation property of the AudioNode interface
represents an enumerated value describing how input channels are mapped to
output channels when the number of inputs/outputs is different. For
example, this setting defines how a mono input will be up-mixed to a
stereo or 5.1 channel output, or how a quad channel input will be
down-mixed to a stereo or mono output.

name: connect
desc:
The connect() method of the AudioNode interface lets
you connect one of the node's outputs to a target, which may be either
another
AudioNode (thereby directing the sound data to the specified node) or an
AudioParam, so that the node's output data is automatically used to
change the value of that parameter over time.

name: context
desc:
The read-only context property of the
AudioNode interface returns the associated
BaseAudioContext, that is the object representing the processing graph
the node is participating in.

name: disconnect
desc:
The disconnect() method of the AudioNode interface lets you
disconnect one or more nodes from the node on which the method is called.

name: numberOfInputs
desc:
The numberOfInputs property of
the AudioNode interface returns the number of inputs feeding the
node. Source nodes are defined as nodes having a numberOfInputs
property with a value of 0.

name: numberOfOutputs
desc:
The numberOfOutputs property of
the AudioNode interface returns the number of outputs coming out of
the node. Destination nodes — like AudioDestinationNode — have
a value of 0 for this attribute.

name: AudioParam
desc:
The Web Audio API's AudioParam interface represents an audio-related
parameter, usually a parameter of an AudioNode (such as GainNode.gain).

name: cancelAndHoldAtTime
desc:
The cancelAndHoldAtTime() method of the
AudioParam interface cancels all scheduled future changes to the
AudioParam but holds its value at a given time until further changes are
made using other methods.

name: cancelScheduledValues
desc:
The cancelScheduledValues() method of the AudioParam
Interface cancels all scheduled future changes to the AudioParam.

name: defaultValue
desc:
The defaultValue
read-only property of the AudioParam interface represents the initial
value of the attributes as defined by the specific AudioNode creating
the AudioParam.

name: exponentialRampToValueAtTime
desc:
The exponentialRampToValueAtTime() method of the AudioParam
Interface schedules a gradual exponential change in the value of the
AudioParam.
The change starts at the time specified for the previous event, follows
an exponential ramp to the new value given in the value parameter, and
reaches the new value at the time given in the
endTime parameter.

name: linearRampToValueAtTime
desc:
The linearRampToValueAtTime() method of the AudioParam
Interface schedules a gradual linear change in the value of the
AudioParam. The change starts at the time specified for the
previous event, follows a linear ramp to the new value given in the
value parameter, and reaches the new value at the time given in the
endTime parameter.

name: maxValue
desc:
The maxValue
read-only property of the AudioParam interface represents the maximum
possible value for the parameter's nominal (effective) range.

name: minValue
desc:
The minValue
read-only property of the AudioParam interface represents the minimum
possible value for the parameter's nominal (effective) range.

name: setTargetAtTime
desc:
The setTargetAtTime() method of the
AudioParam interface schedules the start of a gradual change to the
AudioParam value. This is useful for decay or release portions of ADSR
envelopes.

name: setValueAtTime
desc:
The setValueAtTime() method of the
AudioParam interface schedules an instant change to the
AudioParam value at a precise time, as measured against
BaseAudioContext.currentTime. The new value is given in the value
parameter.

name: setValueCurveAtTime
desc:
The
setValueCurveAtTime() method of the
AudioParam interface schedules the parameter's value to change
following a curve defined by a list of values.

name: value
desc:
The Web Audio
API's
AudioParam interface property value gets
or sets the value of this AudioParam at the current time. Initially, the
value is set to AudioParam.defaultValue.

name: AudioParamMap
desc:
The AudioParamMap interface of the
Web Audio API
represents an iterable and read-only set of multiple audio parameters.

name: AudioProcessingEvent
desc:
The AudioProcessingEvent interface of the
Web Audio API
represents events that occur when a ScriptProcessorNode input buffer is
ready to be processed.

name: inputBuffer
desc:
The inputBuffer read-only property of the AudioProcessingEvent
interface represents the input buffer of an audio processing event.

name: outputBuffer
desc:
The outputBuffer read-only property of the AudioProcessingEvent
interface represents the output buffer of an audio processing event.

name: playbackTime
desc:
The playbackTime read-only property of the AudioProcessingEvent
interface represents the time when the audio will be played. It is in the
same coordinate system as the time used by the AudioContext.

name: AudioScheduledSourceNode
desc:
The AudioScheduledSourceNode interface—part of the Web Audio API—is a
parent interface for several types of audio source node interfaces which
share the ability to be started and stopped, optionally at specified times.
Specifically, this interface defines the AudioScheduledSourceNode.start
and AudioScheduledSourceNode.stop methods, as well as the
AudioScheduledSourceNode.ended_event event.

name: start
desc:
The start() method on AudioScheduledSourceNode schedules a sound to
begin playback at the specified time.
If no time is specified, then the sound begins playing immediately.

name: stop
desc:
The stop() method on AudioScheduledSourceNode schedules a
sound to cease playback at the specified time. If no time is specified,
then the sound
stops playing immediately.

name: AudioTrack
desc:
The AudioTrack interface represents a single audio track from one of
the HTML media elements, audio or video.

name: enabled
desc:
The AudioTrack property
enabled specifies whether or not the described audio
track is currently enabled for use. If the track is disabled by setting
enabled to false, the track is muted and does not produce
audio.

name: id
desc:
The id property contains a
string which uniquely identifies the track represented by the
AudioTrack.

name: kind
desc:
The kind property contains a
string indicating the category of audio contained in the
AudioTrack.

name: label
desc:
The read-only AudioTrack
property label returns a string specifying the audio
track's human-readable label, if one is available; otherwise, it returns
an empty
string.

name: language
desc:
The read-only AudioTrack
property language returns a string identifying the
language used in the audio track.

name: sourceBuffer
desc:
The read-only AudioTrack
property sourceBuffer returns the
SourceBuffer that created the track, or null if the track was not
created by a SourceBuffer or the SourceBuffer has been
removed from the MediaSource.sourceBuffers attribute of its parent
media source.

name: AudioTrackList
desc:
The AudioTrackList interface is used to represent a list of the audio
tracks contained within a given HTML media element, with each track
represented by a separate AudioTrack object in the list.

name: getTrackById
desc:
The AudioTrackList method getTrackById() returns the first
AudioTrack object from the track list whose AudioTrack.id matches the
specified string.
This lets you find a specified track if you know its ID string.

name: length
desc:
The read-only AudioTrackList
property length returns the number of entries in the
AudioTrackList, each of which is an AudioTrack
representing one audio track in the media element. A value of 0 indicates
that
there are no audio tracks in the media.

name: AudioWorklet
desc:
The AudioWorklet interface of the
Web Audio API
is used to supply custom audio processing scripts that execute in a separate
thread to provide very low latency audio processing.

name: AudioWorkletGlobalScope
desc:
The AudioWorkletGlobalScope interface of the
Web Audio API
represents a global execution context for user-supplied code, which defines
custom AudioWorkletProcessor-derived classes.

name: currentFrame
desc:
The read-only currentFrame property of the AudioWorkletGlobalScope
interface returns an integer that represents the ever-increasing current
sample-frame of the audio block being processed. It is incremented by 128
(the size of a render quantum) after the processing of each audio block.

name: currentTime
desc:
The read-only currentTime property of the AudioWorkletGlobalScope
interface returns a double that represents the ever-increasing context
time of the audio block being processed. It is equal to the
BaseAudioContext.currentTime property of the BaseAudioContext the
worklet belongs to.

name: registerProcessor
desc:
The registerProcessor method of the
AudioWorkletGlobalScope interface registers a class constructor derived
from AudioWorkletProcessor interface under a specified name.

name: sampleRate
desc:
The read-only sampleRate property of the AudioWorkletGlobalScope
interface returns a float that represents the sample rate of the
associated BaseAudioContext the worklet belongs to.

name: AudioWorkletNode
desc:
Note: Although the interface is available outside
secure contexts,
the BaseAudioContext.audioWorklet property is not, thus custom
AudioWorkletProcessors cannot be defined outside them.

name: parameters
desc:
The read-only parameters property of the
AudioWorkletNode interface returns the associated
AudioParamMap — that is, a Map-like collection of
AudioParam objects. They are instantiated during creation of the
underlying AudioWorkletProcessor according to its
AudioWorkletProcessor.parameterDescriptors static
getter.

name: port
desc:
The read-only port property of the
AudioWorkletNode interface returns the associated
MessagePort. It can be used to communicate between the node and its
associated AudioWorkletProcessor.

name: AudioWorkletProcessor
desc:
The AudioWorkletProcessor interface of the
Web Audio API
represents an audio processing code behind a custom AudioWorkletNode. It
lives in the AudioWorkletGlobalScope and runs on the Web Audio rendering
thread. In turn, an AudioWorkletNode based on it runs on the main thread.

name: port
desc:
The read-only port property of the
AudioWorkletProcessor interface returns the associated
MessagePort. It can be used to communicate between the processor and the
AudioWorkletNode to which it belongs.

name: AuthenticatorAssertionResponse
desc:
The AuthenticatorAssertionResponse interface of the
Web Authentication API
contains a
digital signature
from the private key of a particular WebAuthn credential. The relying
party's server can verify this signature to authenticate a user, for example
when they sign in.

name: authenticatorData
desc:
The authenticatorData property of the
AuthenticatorAssertionResponse interface returns an ArrayBuffer
containing information from the authenticator such as the Relying Party ID
Hash (rpIdHash), a signature counter, test of user presence, user
verification flags, and any extensions processed by the authenticator.

name: signature
desc:
The signature read-only property of the
AuthenticatorAssertionResponse interface is an ArrayBuffer
object which is the signature of the authenticator for both
AuthenticatorAssertionResponse.authenticatorData and a SHA-256 hash of
the client data
(AuthenticatorResponse.clientDataJSON).

name: userHandle
desc:
The userHandle read-only property of the
AuthenticatorAssertionResponse interface is an ArrayBuffer object
providing an opaque identifier for the given user. Such an identifier can
be used by the relying party's server to link the user account with its
corresponding credentials and other data.

name: AuthenticatorAttestationResponse
desc:
The AuthenticatorAttestationResponse interface of the
Web Authentication API
is the result of a WebAuthn credential registration. It contains information
about the credential that the server needs to perform WebAuthn assertions,
such as its credential ID and public key.

name: attestationObject
desc:
The attestationObject property of the
AuthenticatorAttestationResponse interface returns an
ArrayBuffer containing the new public key, as well as signature over the
entire attestationObject with a private key that is stored in the
authenticator when it is manufactured.

name: getAuthenticatorData
desc:
The getAuthenticatorData() method of the
AuthenticatorAttestationResponse interface returns an ArrayBuffer
containing the authenticator data contained within the
AuthenticatorAttestationResponse.attestationObject property.

name: getPublicKey
desc:
The getPublicKey() method of the AuthenticatorAttestationResponse
interface returns an ArrayBuffer containing the DER
SubjectPublicKeyInfo of the new credential (see
Subject Public Key Info),
or null if this is not available.

name: getPublicKeyAlgorithm
desc:
The getPublicKeyAlgorithm() method of the
AuthenticatorAttestationResponse interface returns a number that is
equal to a
COSE Algorithm Identifier,
representing the cryptographic algorithm used for the new credential.

name: getTransports
desc:
The getTransports() method of the AuthenticatorAttestationResponse
interface returns an array of strings describing the different transports
which may be used by the authenticator.

name: AuthenticatorResponse
desc:
The AuthenticatorResponse interface of the
Web Authentication API
is the base interface for interfaces that provide a cryptographic root of
trust for a key pair. The child interfaces include information from the
browser such as the challenge origin and either may be returned from
PublicKeyCredential.response.

name: clientDataJSON
desc:
The clientDataJSON property of the AuthenticatorResponse interface
stores a
JSON
