The ariaPressed property of the ElementInternals interface
reflects the value of the
aria-pressed
attribute, which indicates the current "pressed" state of toggle buttons.

name: ariaReadOnly
desc:
The ariaReadOnly property of the ElementInternals interface
reflects the value of the
aria-readonly
attribute, which indicates that the element is not editable, but is
otherwise operable.

name: ariaRequired
desc:
The ariaRequired property of the ElementInternals interface
reflects the value of the
aria-required
attribute, which indicates that user input is required on the element
before a form may be submitted.

name: ariaRoleDescription
desc:
The ariaRoleDescription property of the ElementInternals interface
reflects the value of the
aria-roledescription
attribute, which defines a human-readable, author-localized description
for the role of an element.

name: ariaRowCount
desc:
The ariaRowCount property of the ElementInternals interface
reflects the value of the
aria-rowcount
attribute, which defines the total number of rows in a table, grid, or
treegrid.

name: ariaRowIndex
desc:
The ariaRowIndex property of the ElementInternals interface
reflects the value of the
aria-rowindex
attribute, which defines an element's row index or position with respect
to the total number of rows within a table, grid, or treegrid.

name: ariaRowSpan
desc:
The ariaRowSpan property of the ElementInternals interface
reflects the value of the
aria-rowspan
attribute, which defines the number of rows spanned by a cell or gridcell
within a table, grid, or treegrid.

name: ariaSelected
desc:
The ariaSelected property of the ElementInternals interface
reflects the value of the
aria-selected
attribute, which indicates the current "selected" state of elements that
have a selected state.

name: ariaSetSize
desc:
The ariaSetSize property of the ElementInternals interface
reflects the value of the
aria-setsize
attribute, which defines the number of items in the current set of
listitems or treeitems.

name: ariaSort
desc:
The ariaSort property of the ElementInternals interface reflects
the value of the
aria-sort
attribute, which indicates if items in a table or grid are sorted in
ascending or descending order.

name: ariaValueMax
desc:
The ariaValueMax property of the ElementInternals interface
reflects the value of the
aria-valuemax
attribute, which defines the maximum allowed value for a range widget.

name: ariaValueMin
desc:
The ariaValueMin property of the ElementInternals interface
reflects the value of the
aria-valuemin
attribute, which defines the minimum allowed value for a range widget.

name: ariaValueNow
desc:
The ariaValueNow property of the ElementInternals interface
reflects the value of the
aria-valuenow
attribute, which defines the current value for a range widget.

name: ariaValueText
desc:
The ariaValueText property of the ElementInternals interface
reflects the value of the
aria-valuetext
attribute, which defines the human-readable text alternative of
aria-valuenow for a range widget.

name: checkValidity
desc:
The checkValidity() method of the ElementInternals interface
checks if the element meets any
constraint validation
rules applied to it.

name: form
desc:
The form read-only property of the ElementInternals interface
returns the HTMLFormElement associated with this element.

name: labels
desc:
The labels read-only property of the ElementInternals interface
returns the labels associated with the element.

name: reportValidity
desc:
The reportValidity() method of the ElementInternals interface
checks if the element meets any
constraint validation
rules applied to it.

name: role
desc:
The role read-only property of the ElementInternals interface
returns the
WAI-ARIA role
for the element. For example, a checkbox might have
role="checkbox".

name: setFormValue
desc:
The setFormValue() method of the ElementInternals interface sets
the element's submission value and state, communicating these to the user
agent.

name: setValidity
desc:
The setValidity() method of the ElementInternals interface sets
the validity of the element.

name: shadowRoot
desc:
The shadowRoot read-only property of the ElementInternals
interface returns the ShadowRoot for this element.

name: states
desc:
The states read-only property of the ElementInternals interface
returns a CustomStateSet representing the possible states of the custom
element.

name: validationMessage
desc:
The validationMessage read-only property of the ElementInternals
interface returns the validation message for the element.

name: validity
desc:
The validity read-only property of the ElementInternals interface
returns a ValidityState object which represents the different validity
states the element can be in, with respect to constraint validation.

name: willValidate
desc:
The willValidate read-only property of the ElementInternals
interface returns true if the element is a submittable element that is a
candidate for
constraint validation.

name: ElementStream
desc: A stream that allows capturing events on a parent element.

name: capture
desc: Adds a capturing subscription to this stream.

desc: @AvailableInWorkers("window_and_dedicated")

name: ErrorEvent
desc:
The ErrorEvent interface represents events providing information
related to errors in scripts or in files.

name: Event
desc:
The Event interface represents an event which takes place on an
EventTarget.

name: bubbles
desc:
The bubbles read-only property of the Event interface indicates
whether the event bubbles up through the DOM tree or not.

name: cancelBubble
desc:
The cancelBubble property of the Event
interface is deprecated. Use Event.stopPropagation instead.
Setting its value to true before returning from an event handler
prevents propagation
of the event. In later implementations, setting this to false does
nothing.
See Browser compatibility for details.

name: cancelable
desc:
The cancelable read-only property of the Event interface indicates
whether the event
can be canceled, and therefore prevented as if the event never happened.

name: composed
desc:
The read-only composed property of the
Event interface returns a boolean value which indicates whether
or not the event will propagate across the shadow DOM boundary into the
standard DOM.

name: composedPath
desc:
The composedPath() method of the Event
interface returns the event's path which is an array of the objects on
which listeners
will be invoked. This does not include nodes in shadow trees if the shadow
root was
created with its ShadowRoot.mode closed.

name: currentTarget
desc:
The currentTarget read-only property of the Event interface
identifies the element to which the event handler has been attached.

name: defaultPrevented
desc:
The defaultPrevented read-only property of the Event interface
returns a boolean value indicating whether or not the call to
Event.preventDefault canceled the event.

name: eventPhase
desc:
The eventPhase read-only property of the
Event interface indicates which phase of the event flow is currently
being evaluated.

name: initEvent
desc:
The Event.initEvent() method is used to initialize the
value of an event created using Document.createEvent.

name: isTrusted
desc:
The isTrusted read-only property of the
Event interface is a boolean value that is true
when the event was generated by the user agent (including via user actions
and programmatic methods such as HTMLElement.focus),
and false when the event was dispatched via
EventTarget.dispatchEvent.
The only exception is the click event, which initializes the isTrusted
property to false in user agents.

name: preventDefault
desc:
The preventDefault() method of the Event interface tells the  that
if the event does not get explicitly handled, its default action should
not be taken as it normally would be.

name: returnValue
desc:
The Event property
returnValue indicates whether the default action for
this event has been prevented or not.

name: srcElement
desc:
The deprecated Event.srcElement is an alias for the Event.target
property. Use Event.target instead.

name: stopImmediatePropagation
desc:
The stopImmediatePropagation() method of the
Event interface prevents other listeners of the same event from being
called.

name: stopPropagation
desc:
The stopPropagation() method of the Event
interface prevents further propagation of the current event in the
capturing and
bubbling phases. It does not, however, prevent any default behaviors from
occurring; for
instance, clicks on links are still processed. If you want to stop those
behaviors, see
the Event.preventDefault method. It also does not
prevent propagation to other event-handlers of the current element. If you
want to stop those,
see Event.stopImmediatePropagation.

name: target
desc:
The read-only target property of the
Event interface is a reference to the object onto which the event was
dispatched. It is different from Event.currentTarget when the event
handler is called during the bubbling or capturing phase of the event.

name: timeStamp
desc:
The timeStamp read-only property of the Event interface returns
the time (in milliseconds) at which the event was created.

name: type
desc:
The type read-only property of the Event
interface returns a string containing the event's type. It is set when the
event is
constructed and is the name commonly used to refer to the specific event,
such as
click, load, or error.

name: EventCounts
desc:
The EventCounts interface of the
Performance API
provides the number of events that have been dispatched for each event type.

name: client
desc:
A Point representation of the clientX and clientY properties
of this MouseEvent.

name: EventSource
desc:
The EventSource interface is web content's interface to
server-sent events.

name: close
desc:
The close() method of the EventSource
interface closes the connection, if one is made, and sets the
EventSource.readyState attribute to 2 (closed).

name: readyState
desc:
The readyState read-only property of the
EventSource interface returns a number representing the state of the
connection.

name: url
desc:
The url read-only property of the
EventSource interface returns a string representing the
URL of the source.

name: withCredentials
desc:
The withCredentials read-only property of the
EventSource interface returns a boolean value indicating whether
the EventSource object was instantiated with CORS credentials set.

name: EventStreamProvider
desc:
Helper class used to create streams abstracting DOM events. This is a
piece of the helper layer directly derived from a similar feature in
dart:html.

name: forElement
desc: Gets a Stream for this event type, on the specified element.

name: forTarget
desc: Gets a Stream for this event type, on the specified target.

name: getEventType
desc:
Gets the type of the event which this would listen for on the specified
event target.

name: EventStreamProviders
desc: Statically accessible EventStreamProviders for all event types.

name: EventTarget
desc:
The EventTarget interface is implemented by objects that can receive
events and may have listeners for them.
In other words, any target of events implements the three methods associated
with this interface.

name: addEventListener
desc:
The addEventListener() method of the EventTarget interface
sets up a function that will be called whenever the specified event is
delivered to the target.

name: dispatchEvent
desc:
The dispatchEvent() method of the EventTarget sends an Event to
the object, (synchronously) invoking the affected
event listeners in the appropriate order. The normal event processing
rules (including the capturing and optional bubbling phase) also apply to
events
dispatched manually with dispatchEvent().

name: removeEventListener
desc:
The removeEventListener() method of the EventTarget interface
removes an event listener previously registered with
EventTarget.addEventListener from the target.
The event listener to be removed is identified using a combination of the
event type,
the event listener function itself, and various optional options that may
affect the matching process;
see
Matching event listeners for removal.

name: FederatedCredentialInit
desc:
The FederatedCredentialInit dictionary represents the object passed to
CredentialsContainer.create as the value of the federated option: that
is, when creating a FederatedCredential object representing a credential
associated with a federated identify provider.

name: FetchEvent
desc: @AvailableInWorkers("service")

desc: @AvailableInWorkers("service")

name: handled
desc: @AvailableInWorkers("service")

name: preloadResponse
desc: @AvailableInWorkers("service")

name: replacesClientId
desc: @AvailableInWorkers("service")

name: request
desc: @AvailableInWorkers("service")

desc: @AvailableInWorkers("service")

desc: @AvailableInWorkers("service")

name: File
desc:
The File interface provides information about files and allows
JavaScript in a web page to access their content.

name: lastModified
desc:
The lastModified read-only property of the File interface provides
the
last modified date of the file as the number of milliseconds since the
Unix
epoch (January 1, 1970 at midnight). Files without a known last modified
date return the
current date.

name: name
desc:
The name read-only property of the File interface returns the name
of the file represented by a File object. For security
reasons, the path is excluded from this property.

name: webkitRelativePath
desc:
The webkitRelativePath read-only property of the File interface
contains a string which specifies the file's path relative to the
directory selected by the user in an input element with its
webkitdirectory
attribute set.

name: FileList
desc:
The FileList interface represents an object of this type returned by
the files property of the HTML input element; this lets you access the
list of files selected with the <input type="file"> element. It's also
used for a list of files dropped into web content when using the drag and
drop API; see the DataTransfer object for details on this usage.

name: item
desc:
The item() method of the FileList interface returns a File
object representing the file at the specified index in the file list.

name: length
desc:
The length read-only property of the FileList interface returns
the number of files in the FileList.

name: FileReader
desc:
The FileReader interface lets web applications asynchronously read the
contents of files (or raw data buffers) stored on the user's computer, using
File or Blob objects to specify the file or data to read.

name: abort
desc:
The abort() method of the FileReader interface aborts the read
operation. Upon return,
the FileReader.readyState will be DONE.

name: error
desc:
The error read-only property of the FileReader interface returns
the
error that occurred while reading the file.

name: readAsArrayBuffer
desc:
The readAsArrayBuffer() method of the FileReader interface is used
to start reading the
contents of a specified Blob or File. When the read
operation is finished, the FileReader.readyState property becomes
DONE, and the FileReader.loadend_event event is
triggered. At that time, the FileReader.result property
contains an ArrayBuffer representing the file's data.

name: readAsBinaryString
desc:
Note: This method is deprecated in favor of
FileReader.readAsArrayBuffer.

name: readAsDataURL
desc:
The readAsDataURL() method of the FileReader interface is used to
read the contents of the specified
Blob or File. When the read operation is finished, the
FileReader.readyState property becomes DONE, and the
FileReader.loadend_event event is triggered. At that time, the
FileReader.result attribute contains the data as a data:
URL
representing the
file's data as a base64 encoded string.

name: readAsText
desc:
The readAsText() method of the FileReader interface is used to
read the contents of the specified Blob or File.
When the read operation is complete, the FileReader.readyState property
is changed to DONE,
the FileReader.loadend_event event is triggered, and the
FileReader.result property contains the contents of the file as a text
string.

name: readyState
desc:
The readyState read-only property of the FileReader interface
provides the current state of the reading operation.
This will be one of the states: EMPTY, LOADING, or DONE.

name: result
desc:
The result read-only property of the FileReader interface returns
the
file's contents. This property is only valid after the read operation is
complete, and
the format of the data depends on which of the methods was used to
initiate the read
operation.

name: FileReaderSync
desc: @AvailableInWorkers("worker_except_service")

desc: @AvailableInWorkers("worker_except_service")

desc: @AvailableInWorkers("worker_except_service")

name: FileSystem
desc:
The File and Directory Entries API interface FileSystem is used to
represent a file system. These objects can be obtained from the
FileSystemEntry.filesystem property on any file system entry. Some
browsers offer additional APIs to create and manage file systems, such as
Chrome's Window.requestFileSystem method.

name: name
desc:
The read-only name property of the
FileSystem interface indicates the file system's name. This
string is unique among all file systems currently exposed by the
File and Directory Entries API.

name: root
desc:
The read-only root property of the
FileSystem interface specifies a FileSystemDirectoryEntry
object representing the root directory of the file system, for use with
the
File and Directory Entries API.

name: FileSystemDirectoryEntry
desc:
The FileSystemDirectoryEntry interface of the
File and Directory Entries API
represents a directory in a file system. It provides methods which make it
possible to access and manipulate the files in a directory, as well as to
access the entries within the directory.

name: createReader
desc:
The FileSystemDirectoryEntry interface's method
createReader() returns a
FileSystemDirectoryReader object which can be used to read the entries
in
the directory.

name: getDirectory
desc:
The FileSystemDirectoryEntry interface's method
getDirectory() returns a
FileSystemDirectoryEntry object corresponding to a directory contained
somewhere within the directory subtree rooted at the directory on which
it's called.

name: getFile
desc:
The FileSystemDirectoryEntry interface's method
getFile() returns a
FileSystemFileEntry object corresponding to a file contained somewhere
within the directory subtree rooted at the directory on which it's called.

name: FileSystemDirectoryHandle
desc:
The FileSystemDirectoryHandle interface of the File System API
provides a handle to a file system directory.

name: getDirectoryHandle
desc:
The getDirectoryHandle() method of the
FileSystemDirectoryHandle interface returns a
FileSystemDirectoryHandle for a subdirectory with the specified name
within the directory handle on which the method is called.

name: getFileHandle
desc:
The getFileHandle() method of the
FileSystemDirectoryHandle interface returns a
FileSystemFileHandle for a file with the specified name, within the
directory the method is called.

name: removeEntry
desc:
The removeEntry() method of the
FileSystemDirectoryHandle interface attempts to remove an entry if the
directory handle contains a file or directory called the name specified.

name: resolve
desc:
The resolve() method of the
FileSystemDirectoryHandle interface returns an Array of
directory names from the parent handle to the specified child entry, with
the name of
the child entry as the last array item.

name: FileSystemDirectoryReader
desc:
The FileSystemDirectoryReader interface of the
File and Directory Entries API
lets you access the FileSystemFileEntry-based objects (generally
FileSystemFileEntry or FileSystemDirectoryEntry) representing each entry
in a directory.

name: readEntries
desc:
The FileSystemDirectoryReader interface's readEntries() method
retrieves the directory entries
within the directory being read and delivers them in an array to a
provided callback function.

name: FileSystemEntry
desc:
The FileSystemEntry interface of the File and Directory Entries API
represents a single entry in a file system. The entry can be a file or a
directory (directories are represented by the FileSystemDirectoryEntry
interface). It includes methods for working with files—including copying,
moving, removing, and reading files—as well as information about a file it
points to—including the file name and its path from the root to the entry.

name: filesystem
desc:
The read-only filesystem
property of the FileSystemEntry interface contains a
FileSystem object that represents the file system on which the entry
resides.

name: fullPath
desc:
The read-only fullPath property
of the FileSystemEntry interface returns a string
specifying the full, absolute path from the file system's root to the file
represented
by the entry.

name: getParent
desc:
The FileSystemEntry interface's method
getParent() obtains a
FileSystemDirectoryEntry.

name: isDirectory
desc:
The read-only isDirectory
property of the FileSystemEntry interface is true if the
entry represents a directory (meaning it's a FileSystemDirectoryEntry)
and false if it's not.

name: isFile
desc:
The read-only isFile property of
the FileSystemEntry interface is true if the entry
represents a file (meaning it's a FileSystemFileEntry) and
false if it's not.

name: name
desc:
The read-only name property of
the FileSystemEntry interface returns a string
specifying the entry's name; this is the entry within its parent directory
(the last
component of the path as indicated by the FileSystemEntry.fullPath
property).

name: FileSystemFileEntry
desc:
The FileSystemFileEntry interface of the
File and Directory Entries API
represents a file in a file system. It offers properties describing the
file's attributes, as well as the FileSystemFileEntry.file method, which
creates a File object that can be used to read the file.

name: file
desc:
The FileSystemFileEntry interface's method
file() returns a
File object which can be used to read data from the file represented by
the directory entry.

name: FileSystemFileHandle
desc:
The FileSystemFileHandle interface of the File System API represents
a handle to a file system entry. The interface is accessed through the
window.showOpenFilePicker method.

name: createSyncAccessHandle
desc: @AvailableInWorkers("dedicated")

name: createWritable
desc:
The createWritable() method of the FileSystemFileHandle interface
creates a FileSystemWritableFileStream that can be used to write to a
file.
The method returns a Promise which resolves to this created stream.

name: getFile
desc:
The getFile() method of the
FileSystemFileHandle interface returns a Promise which resolves to a
File object representing the state on disk of the entry represented by
the handle.

name: FileSystemHandle
desc:
The FileSystemHandle interface of the File System API is an object
which represents a file or directory entry. Multiple handles can represent
the same entry. For the most part you do not work with FileSystemHandle
directly but rather its child interfaces FileSystemFileHandle and
FileSystemDirectoryHandle.

name: isSameEntry
desc:
The isSameEntry() method of the
FileSystemHandle interface compares two FileSystemHandle to see if the
associated entries (either a file or directory) match.

name: kind
desc:
The kind read-only property of the
FileSystemHandle interface returns the type of entry. This is
'file' if the associated entry is a file or 'directory'. It is
used to distinguish files from directories when iterating over the
contents of a
directory.

name: name
desc:
The name read-only property of the
FileSystemHandle interface returns the name of the entry represented by
handle.

name: FileSystemSyncAccessHandle
desc: @AvailableInWorkers("dedicated")

name: close
desc: @AvailableInWorkers("dedicated")

name: flush
desc: @AvailableInWorkers("dedicated")

name: getSize
desc: @AvailableInWorkers("dedicated")

name: read
desc: @AvailableInWorkers("dedicated")

name: truncate
desc: @AvailableInWorkers("dedicated")

name: write
desc: @AvailableInWorkers("dedicated")

name: FileSystemWritableFileStream
desc:
The FileSystemWritableFileStream interface of the File System API is
a WritableStream object with additional convenience methods, which
operates on a single file on disk. The interface is accessed through the
FileSystemFileHandle.createWritable method.

name: seek
desc:
The seek() method of the FileSystemWritableFileStream interface
updates the current file cursor offset to the position (in bytes)
specified when calling the method.

name: truncate
desc:
The truncate() method of the FileSystemWritableFileStream
interface resizes the file associated with the stream to the specified
size in bytes.

name: write
desc:
The write() method of the FileSystemWritableFileStream interface
writes content into the file the method is called on, at the current file
cursor offset.

name: FocusEvent
desc:
The FocusEvent interface represents focus-related events, including
Element.focus_event, Element.blur_event, Element.focusin_event, and
Element.focusout_event.

name: relatedTarget
desc:
The relatedTarget read-only property of the FocusEvent interface
is the secondary target, depending on the type of event:

name: FontFace
desc:
The FontFace interface of the
CSS Font Loading API
represents a single usable font face.

name: ascentOverride
desc:
The ascentOverride property of the FontFace interface returns and
sets the ascent metric for the font, the height above the baseline that
CSS uses to lay out line boxes in an inline formatting context.

name: descentOverride
desc:
The descentOverride property of the FontFace interface returns and
sets the value of the  descriptor.
The possible values are normal, indicating that the metric used should
be obtained from the font file, or a percentage.

name: display
desc:
The display property of the FontFace interface determines how a
font face is displayed based on whether and when it is downloaded and
ready to use.
This property is equivalent to the CSS font-display descriptor.

name: family
desc:
The FontFace.family property allows the author to get or set the
font family of a FontFace object.

name: featureSettings
desc:
The featureSettings property of the FontFace interface retrieves
or sets infrequently used font features that are not available from a
font's variant properties.

name: lineGapOverride
desc:
The lineGapOverride property of the FontFace interface returns and
sets the value of the  descriptor.
The possible values are normal, indicating that the metric used should
be obtained from the font file, or a percentage.

name: load
desc:
The load() method of the FontFace interface requests and loads a
font whose source was specified as a URL. It returns a Promise that
resolves with the current FontFace object.

name: loaded
desc:
The loaded read-only property of the FontFace interface returns a
Promise that resolves with the current FontFace object when the font
specified in the object's constructor is done loading or rejects with a
SyntaxError.

name: status
desc:
The status read-only property of the FontFace interface returns an
enumerated value indicating the status of the font, one of "unloaded",
"loading", "loaded", or "error".

name: stretch
desc:
The stretch property of the FontFace interface retrieves or sets
how the font stretches.

name: style
desc:
The style property of the FontFace interface retrieves or sets the
font's style.

name: unicodeRange
desc:
The unicodeRange property of the FontFace interface retrieves or
sets the range of unicode code points encompassing the font.

name: weight
desc:
The weight property of the FontFace interface retrieves or sets
the weight of the font.

name: FontFaceSet
desc:
The FontFaceSet interface of the
CSS Font Loading API
manages the loading of font-faces and querying of their download status.

name: add
desc:
The add() method of the FontFaceSet interface adds a new font to
the set.

name: check
desc:
The check() method of the FontFaceSet returns true if you can render
some text using the given font specification without attempting to use any
fonts in this FontFaceSet that are not yet fully loaded. This means you
can use the font specification without causing a
font swap.

name: clear
desc:
The clear() method of the FontFaceSet interface removes all fonts
added via this interface. Fonts added with the  rule are not removed.

name: delete
desc:
The delete() method of the FontFaceSet interface removes a font
from the set.

name: load
desc:
The load() method of the FontFaceSet forces all the fonts given in
parameters to be loaded.

name: ready
desc:
The ready read-only property of the FontFaceSet interface returns a
Promise that resolves to the given FontFaceSet.

name: status
desc:
The status read-only property of the FontFaceSet interface returns
the loading state of the fonts in the set.

name: FontFaceSetLoadEvent
desc:
The FontFaceSetLoadEvent interface of the
CSS Font Loading API
represents events fired at a FontFaceSet after it starts loading font
faces.

name: fontfaces
desc:
The fontfaces read-only property of the
FontFaceSetLoadEvent interface returns an array of
FontFace instances, each of which represents a single usable font.

name: FormData
desc:
The FormData interface provides a way to construct a set of key/value
pairs representing form fields and their values, which can be sent using the
fetch, XMLHttpRequest.send or navigator.sendBeacon methods. It uses
the same format a form would use if the encoding type were set to
"multipart/form-data".

name: append
desc:
The append() method of the FormData interface appends a new value
onto an existing key inside a FormData object, or adds the key if it
does not already exist.

name: delete
desc:
The delete() method of the FormData interface deletes a key and
its value(s) from a FormData object.

name: get
desc:
The get() method of the FormData interface
returns the first value associated with a given key from within a
FormData
object. If you expect multiple values and want all of them, use the
FormData.getAll method instead.

name: getAll
desc:
The getAll() method of the FormData interface returns all the
values associated with a given key from within a FormData object.

name: has
desc:
The has() method of the FormData interface returns whether a
FormData object contains a certain key.

name: set
desc:
The set() method of the FormData interface sets a new value for an
existing key inside a FormData object, or adds the key/value if it does
not already exist.

name: FormDataEvent
desc:
The FormDataEvent interface represents a
formdata event
— such an event is fired on an HTMLFormElement object after the entry list
representing the form's data is constructed. This happens when the form is
submitted, but can also be triggered by the invocation of a
FormData.FormData constructor.

name: formData
desc:
The formData read-only property of the FormDataEvent
interface contains the FormData object representing the data contained
in
the form when the event was fired.

name: GainNode
desc:
The GainNode interface represents a change in volume. It is an AudioNode
audio-processing module that causes a given gain to be applied to the input
data before its propagation to the output. A GainNode always has exactly
one input and one output, both with the same number of channels.

name: gain
desc:
The gain property of the GainNode interface is an
a-rate
AudioParam representing the amount of gain to apply.

name: Gamepad
desc:
The Gamepad interface of the
Gamepad API
defines an individual gamepad or other controller, allowing access to
information such as button presses, axis positions, and id.

name: axes
desc:
The Gamepad.axes property of the Gamepad
interface returns an array representing the controls with axes present on
the device
(e.g. analog thumb sticks).

name: buttons
desc:
The Gamepad.buttons property of the Gamepad interface returns an
array of gamepadButton objects representing the
buttons present on the device.

name: connected
desc:
The Gamepad.connected property of the
Gamepad interface returns a boolean indicating whether the gamepad is
still connected to the system.

name: id
desc:
The Gamepad.id property of the Gamepad
interface returns a string containing some information about the
controller.

name: index
desc:
The Gamepad.index property of the Gamepad
interface returns an integer that is auto-incremented to be unique for
each device
currently connected to the system.

name: mapping
desc:
The Gamepad.mapping property of the
Gamepad interface returns a string indicating whether the browser has
remapped the controls on the device to a known layout.

name: timestamp
desc:
The Gamepad.timestamp property of the
Gamepad interface returns a DOMHighResTimeStamp
representing the last time the data for this gamepad was updated.

name: GamepadButton
desc:
The GamepadButton interface defines an individual button of a gamepad
or other controller, allowing access to the current state of different types
of buttons available on the control device.

name: pressed
desc:
The GamepadButton.pressed property of the
GamepadButton interface returns a boolean indicating whether
the button is currently pressed (true) or unpressed (false).

name: touched
desc:
The touched property of the
GamepadButton interface returns a boolean indicating whether
a button capable of detecting touch is currently touched (true) or not
touched (false).

name: value
desc:
The GamepadButton.value property of the
GamepadButton interface returns a double value used to represent the
current state of analog buttons on many modern gamepads, such as the
triggers.

name: GamepadEvent
desc:
The GamepadEvent interface of the Gamepad API contains references to
gamepads connected to the system, which is what the gamepad events
Window.gamepadconnected_event and Window.gamepaddisconnected_event are
fired in response to.

name: gamepad
desc:
The GamepadEvent.gamepad property of the
GamepadEvent interface returns a Gamepad
object, providing access to the associated gamepad data for fired
Window.gamepadconnected_event and Window.gamepaddisconnected_event
events.

name: GamepadHapticActuator
desc:
The GamepadHapticActuator interface of the
Gamepad API
represents hardware in the controller designed to provide haptic feedback to
the user (if available), most commonly vibration hardware.

name: playEffect
desc:
The playEffect() method of the GamepadHapticActuator interface
makes the hardware play a specific vibration pattern.

name: pulse
desc:
The pulse() method of the GamepadHapticActuator interface makes
the hardware pulse at a certain intensity for a specified duration.

name: Geolocation
desc:
The Geolocation interface represents an object able to obtain the
position of the device programmatically. It gives Web content access to the
location of the device. This allows a website or app to offer customized
results based on the user's location.

name: clearWatch
desc:
The clearWatch() method of the Geolocation interface is used to
unregister location/error monitoring handlers previously installed using
Geolocation.watchPosition.

name: getCurrentPosition
desc:
The getCurrentPosition() method of the Geolocation interface is
used to get the current position of the device.

name: watchPosition
desc:
The watchPosition() method of the Geolocation interface is used to
register a handler function that will be called automatically each time
the position of the device changes.
You can also, optionally, specify an error handling callback function.

name: GeolocationCoordinates
desc:
The GeolocationCoordinates interface represents the position and
altitude of the device on Earth, as well as the accuracy with which these
properties are calculated.
The geographic position information is provided in terms of World Geodetic
System coordinates (WGS84).

name: accuracy
desc:
The accuracy read-only property of the GeolocationCoordinates
interface is a strictly positive double representing the accuracy, with
a 95% confidence level, of the GeolocationCoordinates.latitude and
GeolocationCoordinates.longitude properties expressed in meters.

name: altitude
desc:
The altitude read-only property of the GeolocationCoordinates
interface is a double representing the altitude of the position in
meters above the
WGS84 ellipsoid
(which defines the nominal sea level surface). This value is null if the
implementation cannot provide this data.

name: altitudeAccuracy
desc:
The altitudeAccuracy read-only property of the
GeolocationCoordinates interface is a strictly positive double
representing the accuracy, with a 95% confidence level, of the altitude
expressed in meters. This value is null if the implementation doesn't
support measuring altitude.

name: heading
desc:
The heading read-only property of the GeolocationCoordinates
interface is a double representing the direction in which the device is
traveling. This value, specified in degrees, indicates how far off from
heading due north the device is. 0 degrees represents true north, and
the direction is determined clockwise (which means that east is 90
degrees and west is 270 degrees). If GeolocationCoordinates.speed is
0, heading is NaN. If the device is not able to provide heading
information, this value is null.

name: latitude
desc:
The latitude read-only property of the GeolocationCoordinates
interface is a double representing the latitude of the position in
decimal degrees.

name: longitude
desc:
The longitude read-only property of the GeolocationCoordinates
interface is a number which represents the longitude of a geographical
position, specified in decimal degrees.
Together with a timestamp, given as  in milliseconds, indicating a time of
measurement, the GeolocationCoordinates object is part of the
GeolocationPosition interface, which is the object type returned by
Geolocation API functions that obtain and return a geographical position.

name: speed
desc:
The speed read-only property of the GeolocationCoordinates
interface is a double representing the velocity of the device in meters
per second. This value is null if the implementation is not able to
measure it.

name: toJSON
desc:
The toJSON() method of the GeolocationCoordinates interface is a ;
it returns a JSON representation of the GeolocationCoordinates object.

name: GeolocationPosition
desc:
The GeolocationPosition interface represents the position of the
concerned device at a given time. The position, represented by a
GeolocationCoordinates object, comprehends the 2D position of the device,
on a spheroid representing the Earth, but also its altitude and its speed.

name: coords
desc:
The coords read-only property of the GeolocationPosition interface
returns a GeolocationCoordinates object representing a geographic
position. It contains the location, that is longitude and latitude on the
Earth, the altitude, and the speed of the object concerned, regrouped
inside the returned value. It also contains accuracy information about
these values.

name: timestamp
desc:
The timestamp read-only property of the GeolocationPosition
interface represents the date and time that the position was acquired by
the device.

name: toJSON
desc:
The toJSON() method of the GeolocationPosition interface is a ; it
returns a JSON representation of the GeolocationPosition object.

name: GeolocationPositionError
desc:
The GeolocationPositionError interface represents the reason of an
error occurring when using the geolocating device.

name: code
desc:
The code read-only property of the GeolocationPositionError
interface is an unsigned short representing the error code.

name: message
desc:
The message read-only property of the GeolocationPositionError
interface returns a human-readable string describing the details of the
error.

name: GravitySensor
desc:
The GravitySensor interface of the
Sensor APIs
provides on each reading the gravity applied to the device along all three
axes.

name: Gyroscope
desc:
The Gyroscope interface of the
Sensor APIs
provides on each reading the angular velocity of the device along all three
axes.

name: x
desc:
The x read-only property of the
Gyroscope interface returns a number specifying the
angular velocity of the device along its x-axis.

name: y
desc:
The y read-only property of the Gyroscope interface returns a
number specifying the angular velocity of the device along its y-axis.

name: z
desc:
The z read-only property of the
Gyroscope interface returns a number specifying the
angular velocity of the device along its z-axis.

name: HTMLAllCollection
desc:
The HTMLAllCollection interface represents a collection of all of
the document's elements, accessible by index (like an array) and by the
element's
id.
It is returned by the document.all property.

name: item
desc:
The item() method of the HTMLAllCollection interface returns the
element located at the specified offset into the collection, or the
element with the specified value for its id or name attribute.

name: length
desc:
The HTMLAllCollection.length property returns the number of items in
this HTMLAllCollection.

name: namedItem
desc:
The namedItem() method of the HTMLAllCollection interface returns
the first Element in the collection whose id or name attribute
matches the specified name, or null if no element matches.

name: HTMLAnchorElement
desc:
The HTMLAnchorElement interface represents hyperlink elements and
provides special properties and methods (beyond those of the regular
HTMLElement object interface that they inherit from) for manipulating the
layout and presentation of such elements. This interface corresponds to
<a>
element; not to be confused with
<link>,
which is represented by
HTMLLinkElement.

name: HTMLAnchorElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLAnchorElement using the tag 'a'.

name: download
desc:
The HTMLAnchorElement.download property is a
string indicating that the linked resource is intended to be
downloaded rather than displayed in the browser. The value, if any,
specifies the
default file name for use in labeling the resource in a local file system.
If the name
is not a valid file name in the underlying OS, the browser will adjust it.

name: hash
desc:
The
HTMLAnchorElement.hash property returns a
string containing a '#' followed by the fragment
identifier of the URL.

name: host
desc:
The HTMLAnchorElement.host property is a
string containing the host, that is the hostname, and then,
if the port of the URL is nonempty, a ':', and the port
of the URL.

name: hostname
desc:
The HTMLAnchorElement.hostname property is a
string containing the domain of the URL.

name: href
desc:
The HTMLAnchorElement.href property is a
that returns a string containing the whole URL, and allows
the href to be updated.

name: hreflang
desc:
The hreflang property of the HTMLAnchorElement interface is a
string that is the language of the linked resource.

name: origin
desc:
The
HTMLAnchorElement.origin read-only property is a
string containing the Unicode serialization of the origin of the
represented URL.

name: password
desc:
The HTMLAnchorElement.password property is a
string containing the password specified before the domain name.

name: pathname
desc:
The HTMLAnchorElement.pathname property is a
string containing an initial '/' followed by the path of
the URL not including the query string or fragment (or the empty string if
there is no
path).

name: ping
desc:
The ping property of the HTMLAnchorElement interface is a
space-separated list of URLs. When the link is followed, the browser will
send POST requests with the body PING to the URLs.

name: port
desc:
The HTMLAnchorElement.port property is a
string containing the port number of the URL. If the URL does not
contain an explicit port number, it will be set to ''.

name: protocol
desc:
The
HTMLAnchorElement.protocol
property is a string representing the protocol scheme of the URL,
including the final ':'.

name: referrerPolicy
desc:
The
HTMLAnchorElement.referrerPolicy
property reflect the HTML
referrerpolicy
attribute of the
a element defining which referrer is sent when fetching the resource.

name: rel
desc:
The HTMLAnchorElement.rel property reflects the
rel
attribute. It is a string containing a space-separated list of link types
indicating the relationship between the resource represented by the a
element and the current document.

name: relList
desc:
The HTMLAnchorElement.relList read-only property reflects the
rel
attribute. It is a live DOMTokenList containing the set of link types
indicating the relationship between the resource represented by the a
element and the current document.

name: search
desc:
The HTMLAnchorElement.search property is a search
string, also called a query string, that is a string containing
a '?' followed by the parameters of the URL.

name: target
desc:
The target property of the HTMLAnchorElement interface is a string
that indicates where to display the linked resource.

name: text
desc:
The text property of the HTMLAnchorElement represents the text
inside the the element.
This property represents the same information as Node.textContent.

name: type
desc:
The type property of the HTMLAnchorElement interface is a string
that indicates the MIME type of the linked resource.

name: username
desc:
The HTMLAnchorElement.username property is a
string containing the username specified before the domain name.

name: HTMLAreaElement
desc:
The HTMLAreaElement interface provides special properties and methods
(beyond those of the regular object HTMLElement interface it also has
available to it by inheritance) for manipulating the layout and presentation
of area elements.

name: HTMLAreaElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLAreaElement using the tag 'area'.

name: hash
desc:
The
HTMLAreaElement.hash property returns a
string containing a '#' followed by the fragment
identifier of the URL.

name: host
desc:
The HTMLAreaElement.host property is a
string containing the host, that is the hostname, and then,
if the port of the URL is nonempty, a ':', and the port
of the URL.

name: hostname
desc:
The HTMLAreaElement.hostname property is a string containing the
domain of the URL.

name: href
desc:
The HTMLAreaElement.href property is a
that returns a string containing the whole URL, and allows
the href to be updated.

name: origin
desc:
The
HTMLAreaElement.origin read-only property is a
string containing the Unicode serialization of the origin of the
represented URL.

name: password
desc:
The HTMLAreaElement.password property is a
string containing the password specified before the domain name.

name: pathname
desc:
The HTMLAreaElement.pathname property is a
string containing an initial '/' followed by the path of
the URL not including the query string or fragment (or the empty string if
there is no
path).

name: ping
desc:
The ping property of the HTMLAreaElement interface is a
space-separated list of URLs. When the link is followed, the browser will
send POST requests with the body PING to the URLs.

name: port
desc:
The HTMLAreaElement.port property is a
string containing the port number of the URL. If the URL does not
contain an explicit port number, it will be set to ''.

name: protocol
desc:
The
HTMLAreaElement.protocol
property is a string representing the protocol scheme of the URL,
including the final ':'.

name: referrerPolicy
desc:
The
HTMLAreaElement.referrerPolicy
property reflect the HTML
referrerpolicy
attribute of the
area element defining which referrer is sent when fetching the
resource.

name: rel
desc:
The HTMLAreaElement.rel property reflects the
rel
attribute. It is a string containing a space-separated list of link types
indicating the relationship between the resource represented by the area
element and the current document.

name: relList
desc:
The HTMLAreaElement.relList read-only property reflects the
rel
attribute. It is a live DOMTokenList containing the set of link types
indicating the relationship between the resource represented by the area
element and the current document.

name: search
desc:
The HTMLAreaElement.search property is a search
string, also called a query string, that is a string containing
a '?' followed by the parameters of the URL.

name: target
desc:
The target property of the HTMLAreaElement interface is a string
that indicates where to display the linked resource.

name: username
desc:
The HTMLAreaElement.username property is a
string containing the username specified before the domain name.

name: HTMLAudioElement
desc:
The HTMLAudioElement interface provides access to the properties of
audio elements, as well as methods to manipulate them.

name: HTMLAudioElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLAudioElement using the tag 'audio'.

name: HTMLBRElement
desc:
The HTMLBRElement interface represents an HTML line break element
(br). It inherits from HTMLElement.

name: HTMLBRElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLBRElement using the tag 'br'.

name: HTMLBaseElement
desc:
The HTMLBaseElement interface contains the base URI for a document.
This object inherits all of the properties and methods as described in the
HTMLElement interface.

name: HTMLBaseElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLBaseElement using the tag 'base'.

name: target
desc:
The target property of the HTMLBaseElement interface is a string that
represents the default target tab to show the resulting output for
hyperlinks and form elements.

name: HTMLBodyElement
desc:
The HTMLBodyElement interface provides special properties (beyond
those inherited from the regular HTMLElement interface) for manipulating
body elements.

name: HTMLBodyElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLBodyElement using the tag 'body'.

name: HTMLButtonElement
desc:
The HTMLButtonElement interface provides properties and methods
(beyond the regular HTMLElement interface it also has available to it by
inheritance) for manipulating button elements.

name: HTMLButtonElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLButtonElement using the tag 'button'.

name: disabled
desc:
The HTMLButtonElement.disabled property indicates whether the
control is disabled, meaning that it does not accept any clicks.

name: labels
desc:
The HTMLButtonElement.labels read-only property returns a
NodeList of the label elements associated with the
button element.

name: popoverTargetAction
desc:
The popoverTargetAction property of the HTMLButtonElement
interface gets and sets the action to be performed ("hide", "show", or
"toggle") on a popover element being controlled by a button.

name: popoverTargetElement
desc:
The popoverTargetElement property of the HTMLButtonElement
interface gets and sets the popover element to control via a button.

name: type
desc:
The type property of the HTMLButtonElement interface is a string
that indicates the behavior type of the button element.

name: HTMLCanvasElement
desc:
The HTMLCanvasElement interface provides properties and methods for
manipulating the layout and presentation of canvas elements. The
HTMLCanvasElement interface also inherits the properties and methods of
the HTMLElement interface.

name: HTMLCanvasElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLCanvasElement using the tag 'canvas'.

name: captureStream
desc:
The captureStream() method of the HTMLCanvasElement interface
returns a MediaStream
which includes a CanvasCaptureMediaStreamTrack containing a real-time
video capture of the canvas's contents.

name: getContext
desc:
The
HTMLCanvasElement.getContext() method returns a drawing
context on the canvas, or
null
if the context identifier is not
supported, or the canvas has already been set to a different context mode.

name: height
desc:
The HTMLCanvasElement.height property is a
positive integer reflecting the
height
HTML
attribute of the canvas element interpreted in CSS pixels. When the
attribute is not specified, or if it is set to an invalid value, like a
negative, the
default value of 150 is used.

name: toBlob
desc:
The HTMLCanvasElement.toBlob() method creates a Blob object
representing the image contained in the canvas.
This file may be cached on the disk or stored in memory at the discretion
of the user agent.

name: toDataURL
desc:
The HTMLCanvasElement.toDataURL() method returns a
data URL
containing a representation of the image in the format specified by the
type parameter.

name: transferControlToOffscreen
desc:
The HTMLCanvasElement.transferControlToOffscreen() method transfers
control to an OffscreenCanvas object, either on the main thread or on a
worker.

name: width
desc:
The HTMLCanvasElement.width property is a
positive integer reflecting the
width
HTML
attribute of the canvas element interpreted in CSS pixels. When the
attribute is not specified, or if it is set to an invalid value, like a
negative, the
default value of 300 is used.

name: HTMLCollection
desc:
The HTMLCollection interface represents a generic collection
(array-like object similar to arguments) of elements (in document order)
and offers methods and properties for selecting from the list.

name: item
desc:
The HTMLCollection method item()
returns the element located at the specified offset into the collection.

name: length
desc:
The HTMLCollection.length property returns the number of
items in a HTMLCollection.

name: namedItem
desc:
The namedItem() method of the HTMLCollection interface returns
the first Element in the collection whose id or name attribute match
the specified name, or null if no element matches.

name: HTMLDListElement
desc:
The HTMLDListElement interface provides special properties (beyond
those of the regular HTMLElement interface it also has available to it by
inheritance) for manipulating definition list (dl) elements.

name: HTMLDListElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLDListElement using the tag 'dl'.

name: HTMLDataElement
desc:
The HTMLDataElement interface provides special properties (beyond the
regular HTMLElement interface it also has available to it by inheritance)
for manipulating data elements.

name: HTMLDataElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLDataElement using the tag 'data'.

name: value
desc:
The value property of the HTMLDataElement
interface returns a string reflecting the
value
HTML attribute.

name: HTMLDataListElement
desc:
The HTMLDataListElement interface provides special properties (beyond
the HTMLElement object interface it also has available to it by
inheritance) to manipulate datalist elements and their content.

name: HTMLDataListElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLDataListElement using the tag 'datalist'.

name: HTMLDetailsElement
desc:
The HTMLDetailsElement interface provides special properties (beyond
the regular HTMLElement interface it also has available to it by
inheritance) for manipulating details elements.

name: HTMLDetailsElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLDetailsElement using the tag 'details'.

name: open
desc:
The open property of the
HTMLDetailsElement interface is a boolean value reflecting the
open
HTML attribute, indicating whether the details's contents (not counting
the summary) is to be shown to the user.

name: HTMLDialogElement
desc:
The HTMLDialogElement interface provides methods to manipulate
dialog elements. It inherits properties and methods from the HTMLElement
interface.

name: HTMLDialogElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLDialogElement using the tag 'dialog'.

name: close
desc:
The close() method of the HTMLDialogElement interface closes the
dialog.
An optional string may be passed as an argument, updating the
returnValue of the dialog.

name: open
desc:
The open property of the
HTMLDialogElement interface is a boolean value reflecting the
open
HTML attribute, indicating whether the dialog is
available for interaction.

name: returnValue
desc:
The returnValue property of the HTMLDialogElement interface gets
or sets the return value for the dialog, usually to indicate which
button the user pressed to close it.

name: show
desc:
The show() method of the HTMLDialogElement
interface displays the dialog modelessly, i.e. still allowing interaction
with content
outside of the dialog.

name: showModal
desc:
The showModal() method of the
HTMLDialogElement interface displays the dialog as a modal, over the top
of any other dialogs that might be present. It displays in the , along
with a
pseudo-element. Interaction outside the dialog is blocked and
the content outside it is rendered inert.

name: HTMLDirectoryElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLDirectoryElement using the tag 'dir'.

name: HTMLDivElement
desc:
The HTMLDivElement interface provides special properties (beyond the
regular HTMLElement interface it also has available to it by inheritance)
for manipulating div elements.

name: HTMLDivElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLDivElement using the tag 'div'.

name: HTMLElement
desc:
The HTMLElement interface represents any
HTML element. Some
elements directly implement this interface, while others implement it via an
interface that inherits it.

name: HTMLElement.abbr
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'abbr'.

name: HTMLElement.acronym
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'acronym'.

name: HTMLElement.address
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'address'.

name: HTMLElement.article
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'article'.

name: HTMLElement.aside
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'aside'.

name: HTMLElement.b
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'b'.

name: HTMLElement.basefont
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'basefont'.

name: HTMLElement.bdi
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'bdi'.

name: HTMLElement.bdo
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'bdo'.

name: HTMLElement.big
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'big'.

name: HTMLElement.center
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'center'.

name: HTMLElement.cite
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'cite'.

name: HTMLElement.code
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'code'.

name: HTMLElement.dd
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'dd'.

name: HTMLElement.dfn
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'dfn'.

name: HTMLElement.dt
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'dt'.

name: HTMLElement.em
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'em'.

name: HTMLElement.figcaption
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'figcaption'.

name: HTMLElement.figure
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'figure'.

name: HTMLElement.footer
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'footer'.

name: HTMLElement.header
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'header'.

name: HTMLElement.hgroup
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'hgroup'.

name: HTMLElement.i
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'i'.

name: HTMLElement.kbd
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'kbd'.

name: HTMLElement.main
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'main'.

name: HTMLElement.mark
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'mark'.

name: HTMLElement.menuitem
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'menuitem'.

name: HTMLElement.nav
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'nav'.

name: HTMLElement.nobr
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'nobr'.

name: HTMLElement.noembed
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'noembed'.

name: HTMLElement.noframes
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'noframes'.

name: HTMLElement.noscript
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'noscript'.

name: HTMLElement.plaintext
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'plaintext'.

name: HTMLElement.rb
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'rb'.

name: HTMLElement.rp
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'rp'.

name: HTMLElement.rt
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'rt'.

name: HTMLElement.rtc
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'rtc'.

name: HTMLElement.ruby
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'ruby'.

name: HTMLElement.s
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 's'.

name: HTMLElement.samp
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'samp'.

name: HTMLElement.search
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'search'.

name: HTMLElement.section
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'section'.

name: HTMLElement.small
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'small'.

name: HTMLElement.strike
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'strike'.

name: HTMLElement.strong
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'strong'.

name: HTMLElement.sub
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'sub'.

name: HTMLElement.summary
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'summary'.

name: HTMLElement.sup
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'sup'.

name: HTMLElement.tt
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'tt'.

name: HTMLElement.u
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'u'.

name: HTMLElement.var_
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'var'.

name: HTMLElement.wbr
desc: Creates an HTMLElement using the tag 'wbr'.

name: accessKey
desc:
The HTMLElement.accessKey property sets the keystroke which a user
can press to jump to a given element.

name: accessKeyLabel
desc:
The HTMLElement.accessKeyLabel
read-only property returns a string containing the element's
browser-assigned access key (if any); otherwise it returns an empty
string.

name: attachInternals
desc:
The HTMLElement.attachInternals() method returns an
ElementInternals object.
This method allows a
custom element
to participate in HTML forms. The ElementInternals interface provides
utilities for working with these elements in the same way you would work
with any standard HTML form element, and also exposes the
Accessibility Object Model to
the element.

name: attributeStyleMap
desc:
The attributeStyleMap read-only property of the HTMLElement
interface returns a live StylePropertyMap object that contains a list of
style properties of the element that are defined in the element's inline
style attribute, or assigned using the HTMLElement.style property of
the HTMLElement interface via script.

name: autocapitalize
desc:
The autocapitalize property of the HTMLElement interface
represents the element's capitalization behavior for user input. It is
available on all HTML elements, though it doesn't affect all of them,
including:

name: autofocus
desc:
The autofocus property of the HTMLElement interface represents a
boolean value reflecting the
autofocus
HTML global attribute, which indicates whether the control should be
focused when the page loads, or when dialog or popover become shown if
specified in an element inside dialog elements or elements whose popover
attribute is set.

name: blur
desc:
The HTMLElement.blur() method removes keyboard focus from the
current element.

name: click
desc:
The HTMLElement.click() method simulates a mouse click on an
element. When called on an element, the element's Element.click_event
event is fired (unless its
disabled
attribute is set).

name: contentEditable
desc:
The contentEditable property of
the HTMLElement interface specifies whether or not the element is
editable.

name: dataset
desc:
The dataset read-only property
of the HTMLElement interface provides read/write access to
custom data attributes
(data-*) on elements. It exposes a map of strings
(DOMStringMap) with an entry for each data-* attribute.

name: dir
desc:
The HTMLElement.dir property gets or sets the text
writing directionality of the content of the current element.

name: draggable
desc:
The draggable property of the HTMLElement interface gets and sets
a Boolean primitive indicating if the element is draggable.

name: enterKeyHint
desc:
The enterKeyHint property is an enumerated property defining
what action label (or icon) to present for the enter key on virtual
keyboards.
It reflects the
enterkeyhint
HTML global attribute and is an enumerated property, only accepting the
following values
as a string:

name: focus
desc:
The HTMLElement.focus() method sets focus on the specified element,
if it can be focused.
The focused element is the element that will receive keyboard and similar
events by default.

name: hidden
desc:
The HTMLElement property hidden reflects the value of the
element's
hidden
attribute.

name: hidePopover
desc:
The hidePopover() method of the HTMLElement interface hides a
popover
element (i.e. one that has a valid
popover
attribute) by removing it from the  and styling it with display: none.

name: inert
desc:
The HTMLElement property inert reflects the value of the element's
inert
attribute. It is a boolean value that, when present, makes the browser
"ignore" user input events for the element, including focus events and
events from assistive technologies. The browser may also ignore page
search and text selection in the element. This can be useful when building
UIs such as modals where you would want to "trap" the focus inside the
modal when it's visible.

name: innerText
desc:
The innerText property of the HTMLElement interface represents the
rendered text content of a node and its descendants.

name: inputMode
desc:
The HTMLElement property inputMode reflects the value of the
element's
inputmode
attribute.

name: isContentEditable
desc:
The HTMLElement.isContentEditable read-only property
returns a boolean value that is true if the contents of the element
are editable; otherwise it returns false.

name: lang
desc:
The HTMLElement.lang property gets or sets the base
language of an element's attribute values and text content.

name: nonce
desc:
The nonce property of the HTMLElement interface returns the
cryptographic number used once that is used by
Content Security Policy
to determine whether a given fetch will be allowed to proceed.

name: offsetHeight
desc:
The HTMLElement.offsetHeight read-only property returns
the height of an element, including vertical padding and borders, as an
integer.

name: offsetLeft
desc:
The HTMLElement.offsetLeft read-only property returns the number of
pixels that the upper left corner of the current element is offset to
the left within the HTMLElement.offsetParent node.

name: offsetParent
desc:
The HTMLElement.offsetParent read-only property returns a
reference to the element which is the closest (nearest in the containment
hierarchy)
positioned ancestor element.

name: offsetTop
desc:
The HTMLElement.offsetTop read-only property returns the
distance from the outer border of the current element (including its
margin) to the top padding edge of the HTMLelement.offsetParent, the
closest positioned
ancestor element.

name: offsetWidth
desc:
The HTMLElement.offsetWidth read-only property returns
the layout width of an element as an integer.

name: outerText
desc:
The outerText property of the HTMLElement interface returns the
same value as HTMLElement.innerText.
When used as a setter it replaces the whole current node with the given
text (this differs from innerText, which replaces the content inside
the current node).

name: popover
desc:
The popover property of the HTMLElement interface gets and sets an
element's popover state via JavaScript ("auto" or "manual"), and can
be used for feature detection.

name: showPopover
desc:
The showPopover() method of the HTMLElement interface shows a
Popover_API element (i.e. one that has a valid
popover
attribute) by adding it to the .

name: spellcheck
desc:
The spellcheck property of the HTMLElement interface represents a
boolean value that controls the
spell-checking
hint. It is available on all HTML elements, though it doesn't affect all
of them.

name: style
desc:
The read-only style property of the HTMLElement returns the
inline style of an element in the form of a live CSSStyleDeclaration
object that contains a list of all styles properties for that element with
values assigned only for the attributes that are defined in the element's
inline
style
attribute.

name: tabIndex
desc:
The tabIndex property of the
HTMLElement interface represents the tab order of the current element.

name: title
desc:
The HTMLElement.title property
represents the title of the element: the text usually displayed in a
'tooltip' popup
when the mouse is over the node.

name: togglePopover
desc:
The togglePopover() method of the HTMLElement interface toggles a
Popover_API element (i.e. one that has a valid
popover
attribute) between the hidden and showing states.

name: translate
desc:
The translate property of the HTMLElement interface indicates
whether an element's attribute values and the values of its Text node
children are to be translated when the page is localized, or whether to
leave them unchanged.

name: HTMLEmbedElement
desc:
The HTMLEmbedElement interface provides special properties (beyond the
regular HTMLElement interface it also has available to it by inheritance)
for manipulating embed elements.

name: HTMLEmbedElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLEmbedElement using the tag 'embed'.

name: height
desc:
The height property of the HTMLEmbedElement interface returns a
string that reflects the height attribute of the embed element,
indicating the displayed height of the resource in CSS pixels.

name: src
desc:
The src property of the HTMLEmbedElement interface returns a
string that indicates the URL of the resource being embedded.

name: width
desc:
The width property of the HTMLEmbedElement interface returns a
string that reflects the width attribute of the embed element,
indicating the displayed width of the resource in CSS pixels.

name: HTMLFieldSetElement
desc:
The HTMLFieldSetElement interface provides special properties and
methods (beyond the regular HTMLElement interface it also has available to
it by inheritance) for manipulating the layout and presentation of
fieldset elements.

name: HTMLFieldSetElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLFieldSetElement using the tag 'fieldset'.

name: HTMLFontElement
desc:
Implements the document object model (DOM) representation of the font
element. The HTML Font Element font defines the font size, font face and
color of text.

name: HTMLFontElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLFontElement using the tag 'font'.

name: color
desc:
The obsolete
HTMLFontElement.color
property is a string that reflects the
color
HTML attribute, containing either a named color or a color specified in
the
hexadecimal #RRGGBB format.

name: face
desc:
The obsolete
HTMLFontElement.face
property is a string that reflects the
face
HTML attribute, containing a comma-separated list of one or more font
names.

name: size
desc:
The obsolete
HTMLFontElement.size property is a
string that reflects the
size
HTML
attribute. It contains either a font size ranging from 1 to 7 or a
number relative to the default value 3, for example -2 or +1.

name: HTMLFormControlsCollection
desc:
The HTMLFormControlsCollection interface represents a collection of
HTML form control elements, returned by the HTMLFormElement interface's
HTMLFormElement.elements property.

name: namedItem
desc:
The HTMLFormControlsCollection.namedItem() method returns
the RadioNodeList or the Element in the collection whose
name or id match the specified name, or null if
no node matches.

name: HTMLFormElement
desc:
The HTMLFormElement interface represents a form element in the DOM.
It allows access to—and, in some cases, modification of—aspects of the form,
as well as access to its component elements.

name: HTMLFormElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLFormElement using the tag 'form'.

name: acceptCharset
desc:
The HTMLFormElement.acceptCharset property represents a
list of the supported
character encodings
for the given form element. This list can be
comma-separated or space-separated.

name: action
desc:
The HTMLFormElement.action property represents the action
of the form element.

name: elements
desc:
The HTMLFormElement property
elements returns an
HTMLFormControlsCollection listing all the form controls contained in
the form element.

name: encoding
desc:
The HTMLFormElement.encoding property is an alternative name for the
HTMLFormElement.enctype element on the DOM HTMLFormElement object.

name: enctype
desc:
The HTMLFormElement.enctype property is the  of content that is used
to submit the form to the server. Possible values are:

name: length
desc:
The HTMLFormElement.length
read-only property returns the number of controls in the form
element.

name: method
desc:
The HTMLFormElement.method property represents the
method used to submit the form.

name: name
desc:
The HTMLFormElement.name property represents the name of
the current form element as a string.

name: reportValidity
desc:
The HTMLFormElement.reportValidity() method returns
true if the element's child controls satisfy their validation
constraints.
When false is returned, cancelable
invalid
events are fired for
each invalid child and validation problems are reported to the user.

name: requestSubmit
desc:
The HTMLFormElement method requestSubmit() requests
that the form be submitted using a specific submit button.

name: reset
desc:
The HTMLFormElement.reset() method restores a form
element's default values. This method does the same thing as clicking the
form's
<input type="reset">
control.

name: submit
desc:
The HTMLFormElement.submit() method submits a given
form.

name: target
desc:
The target property of the HTMLFormElement
interface represents the target of the form's action (i.e., the frame in
which to render
its output).

name: HTMLFrameElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLFrameElement using the tag 'frame'.

name: HTMLFrameSetElement
desc:
The HTMLFrameSetElement interface provides special properties (beyond
those of the regular HTMLElement interface they also inherit) for
manipulating frameset elements.

name: HTMLFrameSetElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLFrameSetElement using the tag 'frameset'.

name: HTMLHRElement
desc:
The HTMLHRElement interface provides special properties (beyond those
of the HTMLElement interface it also has available to it by inheritance)
for manipulating hr elements.

name: HTMLHRElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLHRElement using the tag 'hr'.

name: HTMLHeadElement
desc:
The HTMLHeadElement interface contains the descriptive information, or
metadata, for a document. This object inherits all of the properties and
methods described in the HTMLElement interface.

name: HTMLHeadElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLHeadElement using the tag 'head'.

name: HTMLHeadingElement
desc:
The HTMLHeadingElement interface represents the different heading
elements, <h1> through
<h6>.
It inherits methods and properties from the HTMLElement interface.

name: HTMLHeadingElement.h1
desc: Creates an HTMLHeadingElement using the tag 'h1'.

name: HTMLHeadingElement.h2
desc: Creates an HTMLHeadingElement using the tag 'h2'.

name: HTMLHeadingElement.h3
desc: Creates an HTMLHeadingElement using the tag 'h3'.

name: HTMLHeadingElement.h4
desc: Creates an HTMLHeadingElement using the tag 'h4'.

name: HTMLHeadingElement.h5
desc: Creates an HTMLHeadingElement using the tag 'h5'.

name: HTMLHeadingElement.h6
desc: Creates an HTMLHeadingElement using the tag 'h6'.

name: HTMLHtmlElement
desc:
The HTMLHtmlElement interface serves as the root node for a given HTML
document. This object inherits the properties and methods described in the
HTMLElement interface.

name: HTMLHtmlElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLHtmlElement using the tag 'html'.

name: version
desc:
Note: This property has been declared as deprecated by the W3C
technical recommendation for HTML 4.01 in favor of use of the DTD for
obtaining version information for a document.

name: HTMLIFrameElement
desc:
The HTMLIFrameElement interface provides special properties and
methods (beyond those of the HTMLElement interface it also has available
to it by inheritance) for manipulating the layout and presentation of inline
frame elements.

name: HTMLIFrameElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLIFrameElement using the tag 'iframe'.

name: allow
desc:
The allow property of the HTMLIFrameElement interface indicates
the
Permissions Policy
specified for this <iframe> element. The policy defines what features
are available to the <iframe> element (for example, access to the
microphone, camera, battery, web-share, etc.) based on the origin
of the request.

name: allowFullscreen
desc:
The allowFullscreen property of the HTMLIFrameElement interface is
a boolean value that reflects the allowfullscreen attribute of the
iframe element, indicating whether to allow the iframe's contents to use
Element.requestFullscreen.

name: contentDocument
desc:
If the iframe and the iframe's parent document are
Same Origin,
returns a
Document
(that is, the active document in the inline frame's nested browsing
context), else returns null.

name: contentWindow
desc:
The contentWindow property returns the
Window object
of an
HTMLIFrameElement.

name: height
desc:
The height property of the HTMLIFrameElement interface returns a
string that reflects the height attribute of the iframe element,
indicating the height of the frame in CSS pixels.

name: loading
desc:
The loading property of the HTMLIFrameElement interface is a
string that provides a hint to the  indicating whether the
iframe
should be loaded immediately on page load, or only when it is needed.

name: name
desc:
The name property of the HTMLIFrameElement interface is a string
value that reflects the name attribute of the iframe element,
indicating the specific name of the <iframe> element.

name: referrerPolicy
desc:
The
HTMLIFrameElement.referrerPolicy
property reflects the HTML
referrerpolicy
attribute of the
iframe element defining which referrer is sent when fetching the
resource.

name: sandbox
desc:
The sandbox read-only property of the HTMLIFrameElement interface
returns a DOMTokenList indicating extra restrictions on the behavior of
the nested content.

name: src
desc:
The HTMLIFrameElement.src
A string that reflects the
src
HTML attribute, containing the address of the content to be embedded.

name: srcdoc
desc:
The srcdoc property of the HTMLIFrameElement specifies the content
of the page.

name: width
desc:
The width property of the HTMLIFrameElement interface returns a
string that reflects the width attribute of the iframe element,
indicating the width of the frame in CSS pixels.

name: HTMLImageElement
desc:
The HTMLImageElement interface represents an HTML img element,
providing the properties and methods used to manipulate image elements.

name: HTMLImageElement.new
desc: Creates an HTMLImageElement using the tag 'img'.

name: align
desc:
The obsolete align
property of the HTMLImageElement interface is a string which indicates
how to position the image relative to its container.

name: alt
desc:
The HTMLImageElement property alt provides fallback (alternate)
text to display when the image specified by the img element is not
loaded.

name: border
desc:
The obsolete HTMLImageElement
property border specifies the number of pixels thick the
border surrounding the image should be. A value of 0, the default,
indicates that no
border should be drawn.

name: complete
desc:
The read-only HTMLImageElement interface's
complete attribute is a Boolean value which indicates
whether or not the image has completely loaded.

name: crossOrigin
desc:
The HTMLImageElement
interface's crossOrigin attribute is a string which
specifies the Cross-Origin Resource Sharing () setting to use when
retrieving the image.

name: currentSrc
desc:
The read-only HTMLImageElement property
currentSrc indicates the URL of the image which is
currently presented in the img element it represents.

name: decode
desc:
The decode()
method of the HTMLImageElement interface returns a
Promise that resolves once the image is decoded and it is safe to append
it to the DOM.

name: decoding
desc:
The decoding property of the HTMLImageElement interface provides a
hint to the browser as to how it should decode the image. More
specifically, whether it should wait for the image to be decoded before
presenting other content updates or not.

name: fetchPriority
desc:
The fetchPriority property of the
HTMLImageElement interface represents a hint given to the browser on how
it should prioritize the fetch of the image relative to other images.

name: height
desc:
The height property of the
HTMLImageElement interface indicates the height at which the image is
