name: WorkerGlobalScope
desc:
The WorkerGlobalScope interface of the
Web Workers API
is an interface representing the scope of any worker. Workers have no
browsing context; this scope contains the information usually conveyed by
Window objects — in this case event handlers, the console or the
associated WorkerNavigator object. Each WorkerGlobalScope has its own
event loop.

name: atob
desc:
The atob() method of the WorkerGlobalScope interface decodes a
string of data which has been encoded using  encoding. You can use
the WorkerGlobalScope.btoa method to encode and transmit
data which may otherwise cause communication problems, then transmit it
and use the
atob() method to decode the data again. For example, you can encode,
transmit, and decode control characters such as  values 0 through 31.

name: btoa
desc:
The btoa() method of the WorkerGlobalScope interface creates a
-encoded  string from a binary string (i.e., a
string in which each character in the string is treated as a byte
of binary data).

name: caches
desc:
The caches read-only property of the WorkerGlobalScope interface
returns the CacheStorage object associated with the current context.
This object enables functionality such as storing assets for offline use,
and generating custom responses to requests.

name: crossOriginIsolated
desc:
The crossOriginIsolated read-only property of the
WorkerGlobalScope interface returns a boolean value that
indicates whether the website is in a cross-origin isolation state. That
state mitigates the risk of side-channel attacks and unlocks a few
capabilities:

name: crypto
desc:
The crypto read-only property of the WorkerGlobalScope interface
returns the Crypto object for this worker. This object gives workers
access to certain cryptographic related services.

name: fonts
desc:
The fonts property of the WorkerGlobalScope interface returns the
FontFaceSet interface of the worker.

name: importScripts
desc:
The importScripts() method of the WorkerGlobalScope interface
synchronously imports one or more scripts into the worker's scope.

name: indexedDB
desc:
The indexedDB read-only property of the WorkerGlobalScope
interface provides a mechanism for workers to
asynchronously access the capabilities of indexed databases.

name: isSecureContext
desc:
The isSecureContext read-only property of the WorkerGlobalScope
interface returns a boolean indicating whether the current
context is secure
(true) or not (false).

name: location
desc:
The location read-only property of the WorkerGlobalScope interface
returns the WorkerLocation associated with the worker. It is a specific
location object, mostly a subset of the Location for browsing scopes,
but adapted to workers.

name: navigator
desc:
The navigator read-only property of the WorkerGlobalScope
interface returns the WorkerNavigator associated with the worker. It is
a specific navigator object, mostly a subset of the Navigator for
browsing scopes, but adapted to workers.

name: origin
desc:
The origin read-only property of the WorkerGlobalScope interface
returns the origin of the global scope, serialized as a string.

name: performance
desc:
The performance property of the WorkerGlobalScope interface
returns a Performance object, which can be used to gather performance
information about code running in the worker's scope.

name: scheduler
desc:
The scheduler read-only property of the WorkerGlobalScope
interface is the entry point for using the
Prioritized Task Scheduling API.

name: self
desc:
The self read-only property of the WorkerGlobalScope interface
returns a reference to the WorkerGlobalScope itself. Most of the time it
is a specific scope like DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope,
SharedWorkerGlobalScope, or ServiceWorkerGlobalScope.

name: trustedTypes
desc:
The trustedTypes read-only property of the WorkerGlobalScope
interface returns the TrustedTypePolicyFactory object associated with
the global object, providing the entry point for using the
Trusted Types API.

name: WorkerLocation
desc:
The WorkerLocation interface defines the absolute location of the
script executed by the Worker. Such an object is initialized for each
worker and is available via the WorkerGlobalScope.location property
obtained by calling self.location.

name: hash
desc:
The hash property of a WorkerLocation object returns the
URL.hash part of the worker's location.

name: host
desc:
The host property of a WorkerLocation object returns the
URL.host part of the worker's location.

name: hostname
desc:
The hostname property of a WorkerLocation object returns the
URL.hostname part of the worker's location.

name: href
desc:
The href property of a WorkerLocation object returns a string
containing the serialized URL for the worker's location.

name: origin
desc:
The origin property of a WorkerLocation object returns the
worker's URL.origin.

name: pathname
desc:
The pathname property of a WorkerLocation object returns the
URL.pathname part of the worker's location.

name: port
desc:
The port property of a WorkerLocation object returns the
URL.port part of the worker's location.

name: protocol
desc:
The protocol property of a WorkerLocation object returns the
URL.protocol part of the worker's location.

name: search
desc:
The search property of a WorkerLocation object returns the
URL.search part of the worker's location.

name: WorkerNavigator
desc:
The WorkerNavigator interface represents a subset of the Navigator
interface allowed to be accessed from a Worker. Such an object is
initialized for each worker and is available via the
WorkerGlobalScope.navigator property.

name: appCodeName
desc:
The value of the WorkerNavigator.appCodeName property is
always "Mozilla", in any browser. This property is kept only for
compatibility purposes.

name: appName
desc:
The value of the WorkerNavigator.appName property is always
"Netscape", in any browser. This property is kept only for compatibility
purposes.

name: appVersion
desc:
Returns either "4.0" or a string representing version information about
the browser.

name: connection
desc:
The connection read-only property of the WorkerNavigator interface
returns a NetworkInformation object containing information about the
system's connection, such as the current bandwidth of the user's device or
whether the connection is metered.
This could be used to select high definition content or low definition
content based on the user's connection.

name: deviceMemory
desc:
The deviceMemory read-only
property of the WorkerNavigator interface returns the approximate amount
of
device memory in gigabytes.

name: hardwareConcurrency
desc:
The navigator.hardwareConcurrency read-only property
returns the number of logical processors available to run threads on the
user's
computer.

name: language
desc:
The WorkerNavigator.language read-only property returns
a string representing the preferred language of the user, usually the
language of the
browser UI.

name: languages
desc:
The WorkerNavigator.languages read-only property
returns an array of strings representing the user's preferred
languages. The language is described using language tags according to
5646, "Tags for Identifying Languages (also known as BCP 47)". In the
returned
array they are ordered by preference with the most preferred language
first.

name: locks
desc:
The locks read-only property of
the WorkerNavigator interface returns a LockManager
object which provides methods for requesting a new Lock object and
querying for an existing Lock object.

name: mediaCapabilities
desc:
The read-only WorkerNavigator.mediaCapabilities property
returns a MediaCapabilities object that can expose information about the
decoding and encoding capabilities for a given format and output
capabilities as defined
by the
Media Capabilities API.

name: onLine
desc:
Returns the online status of the browser. The property returns a boolean
value, with true meaning online and false meaning offline. The
property sends updates whenever the browser's ability to connect to the
network changes. The update occurs when the user follows links or when a
script requests a remote page.

name: permissions
desc:
The permissions read-only property of the WorkerNavigator
interface
returns a Permissions object that can be used to query and update
permission status of APIs covered by the
Permissions API.

name: platform
desc:
Returns a string representing the platform of the browser. The
specification allows
browsers to always return the empty string, so don't rely on this property
to get a
reliable answer.

name: product
desc:
The value of the WorkerNavigator.product property is always
"Gecko", in any browser. This property is kept only for compatibility
purposes.

name: serviceWorker
desc:
The serviceWorker read-only property of the WorkerNavigator
interface returns the ServiceWorkerContainer object for the
associated document,
which provides access to registration, removal, upgrade, and communication
with the ServiceWorker.

name: storage
desc:
The storage read-only property of the WorkerNavigator interface
returns the singleton StorageManager object used to
access the overall storage capabilities of the browser for the current
site or app.
The returned object lets you examine and configure persistence of data
stores and
learn approximately how much more space your browser has available for
local storage
use.

name: usb
desc:
The usb read-only property of the WorkerNavigator interface
returns a USB object for the current document, providing access to
WebUSB API
functionality.

name: userAgent
desc:
The WorkerNavigator.userAgent read-only property returns the
user agent string for the current browser.

name: Worklet
desc:
The Worklet interface is a lightweight version of Worker and gives
developers access to low-level parts of the rendering pipeline.

name: addModule
desc:
The addModule() method of the
Worklet interface loads the module in the given JavaScript file and
adds it to the current Worklet.

name: WorkletGlobalScope
desc:
The WorkletGlobalScope interface is an abstract class that specific
worklet scope classes inherit from. Each WorkletGlobalScope defines a new
global environment.

name: WritableStream
desc:
The WritableStream interface of the
Streams API
provides a standard abstraction for writing streaming data to a destination,
known as a sink.
This object comes with built-in backpressure and queuing.

name: abort
desc:
The abort() method of the WritableStream interface aborts the
stream, signaling that the producer can no longer successfully write to
the stream and it is to be immediately moved to an error state, with any
queued writes discarded.

name: close
desc:
The close() method of the WritableStream interface closes the
associated stream. All chunks written before this method is called are
sent before the returned promise is fulfilled.

name: getWriter
desc:
The getWriter() method of the WritableStream interface returns a
new instance of WritableStreamDefaultWriter and locks the stream to that
instance.
While the stream is locked, no other writer can be acquired until this one
is released.

name: locked
desc:
The locked read-only property of the WritableStream interface
returns a boolean indicating whether the WritableStream is locked to a
writer.

name: WritableStreamDefaultController
desc:
The WritableStreamDefaultController interface of the
Streams API
represents a controller allowing control of a WritableStream's state. When
constructing a WritableStream, the underlying sink is given a
corresponding WritableStreamDefaultController instance to manipulate.

name: error
desc:
The error() method of the
WritableStreamDefaultController interface causes any future interactions
with the associated stream to error.

name: signal
desc:
The read-only signal property of the
WritableStreamDefaultController interface returns the AbortSignal
associated with the controller.

name: WritableStreamDefaultWriter
desc:
The WritableStreamDefaultWriter interface of the
Streams API
is the object returned by WritableStream.getWriter and once created locks
the writer to the WritableStream ensuring that no other streams can write
to the underlying sink.

name: abort
desc:
The abort() method of the
WritableStreamDefaultWriter interface aborts the stream, signaling that
the producer can no longer successfully write to the stream and it is to
be immediately
moved to an error state, with any queued writes discarded.

name: close
desc:
The close() method of the
WritableStreamDefaultWriter interface closes the associated writable
stream.

name: closed
desc:
The closed read-only property of the
WritableStreamDefaultWriter interface returns a
Promise that fulfills if the stream becomes closed, or rejects if
the stream errors or the writer's lock is released.

name: desiredSize
desc:
The desiredSize read-only property of the
WritableStreamDefaultWriter interface returns the desired size required
to fill the stream's internal queue.

name: ready
desc:
The ready read-only property of the
WritableStreamDefaultWriter interface returns a Promise
that resolves when the desired size of the stream's internal queue
transitions from
non-positive to positive, signaling that it is no longer applying
backpressure.

name: releaseLock
desc:
The releaseLock() method of the
WritableStreamDefaultWriter interface releases the writer's lock on the
corresponding stream. After the lock is released, the writer is no longer
active. If the
associated stream is errored when the lock is released, the writer will
appear errored
in the same way from now on; otherwise, the writer will appear closed.

name: write
desc:
The write() method of the
WritableStreamDefaultWriter interface writes a passed chunk of data to a
WritableStream and its underlying sink, then returns a
Promise that resolves to indicate the success or failure of the write
operation.

name: XMLDocument
desc:
The XMLDocument interface represents an XML document. It inherits from
the generic Document and does not add any specific methods or properties
to it: nevertheless, several algorithms behave differently with the two
types of documents.

name: XMLSerializer
desc:
The XMLSerializer interface provides the XMLSerializer.serializeToString
method to construct an XML string representing a  tree.

name: serializeToString
desc:
The XMLSerializer method
serializeToString() constructs a string representing the
specified  tree in  form.

name: XPathEvaluator
desc: The XPathEvaluator interface allows to compile and evaluate  expressions.

name: createExpression
desc:
This method compiles an XPathExpression which can then be used for
(repeated) evaluations of the  expression.

name: createNSResolver
desc:
This method adapts any DOM node to resolve namespaces so that an XPath
expression can
be easily evaluated relative to the context of the node where it appeared
within the
document.

name: evaluate
desc:
The evaluate() method of the XPathEvaluator interface
executes an XPath expression on the given node or document and returns an
XPathResult.

name: XPathExpression
desc:
This interface is a compiled XPath expression that can be evaluated on a
document or specific node to return information from its  tree.

name: evaluate
desc:
The evaluate() method of the
XPathExpression interface executes an
XPath expression on
the given node or document and
returns an XPathResult.

name: XPathResult
desc:
The XPathResult interface represents the results generated by
evaluating an XPath expression within the context of a given node.

name: booleanValue
desc:
The read-only booleanValue property of the
XPathResult interface returns the boolean value of a result with
XPathResult.resultType being BOOLEAN_TYPE.

name: invalidIteratorState
desc:
The read-only invalidIteratorState property of the
XPathResult interface signifies that the iterator has become invalid. It
is true if XPathResult.resultType is
UNORDERED_NODE_ITERATOR_TYPE or ORDERED_NODE_ITERATOR_TYPE and
the document has been modified since this result was returned.

name: iterateNext
desc:
The iterateNext() method of the
XPathResult interface iterates over a node set result and returns the
next node from it or null if there are no more nodes.

name: numberValue
desc:
The read-only numberValue property of the
XPathResult interface returns the numeric value of a result with
XPathResult.resultType being NUMBER_TYPE.

name: resultType
desc:
The read-only resultType property of the
XPathResult interface represents the type of the result, as defined by
the type constants.

name: singleNodeValue
desc:
The read-only singleNodeValue property of the
XPathResult interface returns a Node value or
null in case no node was matched of a result with
XPathResult.resultType being ANY_UNORDERED_NODE_TYPE or
FIRST_ORDERED_NODE_TYPE.

name: snapshotItem
desc:
The snapshotItem() method of the
XPathResult interface returns an item of the snapshot collection or
null in case the index is not within the range of nodes. Unlike the
iterator result, the snapshot does not become invalid, but may not
correspond to the
current document if it is mutated.

name: snapshotLength
desc:
The read-only snapshotLength property of the
XPathResult interface represents the number of nodes in the result
snapshot.

name: stringValue
desc:
The read-only stringValue property of the
XPathResult interface returns the string value of a result with
XPathResult.resultType being STRING_TYPE.

name: XRHand
desc:
The XRHand interface is pair iterator (an ordered map) with the key
being the hand joints and the value being an XRJointSpace.

name: XRInputSource
desc:
The WebXR Device
API's
XRInputSource interface describes a single source of control input
which is part of the user's WebXR-compatible virtual or augmented reality
system. The device is specific to the platform being used, but provides the
direction in which it is being aimed and optionally may generate events if
the user triggers performs actions using the device.

name: gamepad
desc:
The read-only XRInputSource property gamepad returns a Gamepad
object describing the state of the buttons and axes on the XR input
source, if it is a gamepad or comparable device. If the device isn't a
gamepad-like device, this property's value is null.

name: gripSpace
desc:
The read-only XRInputSource property gripSpace returns an
XRSpace whose native origin tracks the pose used to render virtual
objects so they appear to be held in (or part of) the user's hand. For
example, if a user were holding a virtual straight rod, the native origin
of this XRSpace would be located at the approximate center of mass of
the user's fist.

name: hand
desc:
The read-only hand property of the XRInputSource interface is a
XRHand object providing access to a hand-tracking device.

name: handedness
desc:
The read-only XRInputSource property
handedness indicates which of the user's hands the WebXR
input source is associated with, or if it's not associated with a hand at
all.

name: profiles
desc:
The read-only XRInputSource property profiles returns an array of
strings, each describing a configuration profile for the input source. The
profile strings are listed in order of specificity, with the most specific
profile listed first.

name: targetRayMode
desc:
The read-only XRInputSource
property targetRayMode indicates the method by which the
target ray for the input source should be generated and how it should be
presented to
the user.

name: targetRaySpace
desc:
The read-only XRInputSource property
targetRaySpace returns an XRSpace
(typically an XRReferenceSpace) representing the position and
orientation of the target ray in the virtual space. Its native origin
tracks
the position of the origin point of the target ray, and its orientation
indicates the
orientation of the controller device itself. These values, interpreted in
the context of
the input source's XRInputSource.targetRayMode, can be
used both to fully interpret the device as an input source.

name: XRInputSourceEvent
desc:
The
WebXR Device API's
XRInputSourceEvent interface describes an event which has occurred on
a WebXR user input device such as a hand controller, gaze tracking system,
or motion tracking system. More specifically, they represent a change in the
state of an XRInputSource.

name: frame
desc:
The read-only XRInputSourceEvent property
frame specifies an XRFrame object
representing the event frame during which a
WebXR
user input occurred.
This may thus be an event which occurred in the past rather than a current
or impending
event.

name: inputSource
desc:
The XRInputSourceEvent interface's read-only
inputSource property specifies the
XRInputSource which generated the input event. This information
lets you handle the event appropriately given the particulars of the user
input device
being manipulated.

name: XRInputSourcesChangeEvent
desc:
The WebXR Device API interface XRInputSourcesChangeEvent is used to
represent the XRSession.inputsourceschange_event event sent to an
XRSession when the set of available WebXR input controllers changes.

name: added
desc:
The read-only XRInputSourcesChangeEvent
property XRInputSourcesChangeEvent.added is a list of zero or
more input sources, each identified using an XRInputSource object,
which have been newly made available for use.

name: removed
desc:
The read-only XRInputSourcesChangeEvent property
XRInputSourcesChangeEvent.removed is an array of
zero or more XRInputSource objects representing the input sources that
have been removed from the XRSession.

name: session
desc:
The XRInputSourcesChangeEvent property
XRInputSourcesChangeEvent.session specifies the
XRSession to which the input source list change event applies.

name: XRJointPose
desc:
The XRJointPose interface is an XRPose with additional information
about the size of the skeleton joint it represents.

name: radius
desc:
The read-only radius property of the XRJointPose interface
indicates the radius (distance from skin) for a joint.

name: XRJointSpace
desc:
The XRJointSpace interface is an XRSpace and represents the position
and orientation of an XRHand joint.

name: jointName
desc:
The read-only jointName property of the XRJointSpace interface
contains the name of the joint it tracks.

name: XRPose
desc:
XRPose is a
WebXR API
interface representing a position and orientation in the 3D space, relative
to the XRSpace within which it resides. The XRSpace—which is either an
XRReferenceSpace or an XRBoundedReferenceSpace—defines the coordinate
system used for the pose and, in the case of an XRViewerPose, its
underlying views.

name: angularVelocity
desc:
The angularVelocity read-only property of the
XRPose interface is a DOMPointReadOnly describing
the angular velocity in radians per second relative to the base
XRSpace.

name: emulatedPosition
desc:
The emulatedPosition read-only attribute of the
XRPose interface is a Boolean value indicating whether or not both the
XRRigidTransform.position component of the pose's
XRPose.transform is directly taken from the XR device, or
it's simulated or computed based on other sources.

name: linearVelocity
desc:
The linearVelocity read-only property of the
XRPose interface is a DOMPointReadOnly describing
the linear velocity in meters per second relative to the base
XRSpace.

name: transform
desc:
The transform read-only attribute of the
XRPose interface is a XRRigidTransform object providing
the position and orientation of the pose relative to the base XRSpace
as specified when the pose was obtained by calling
XRFrame.getPose.

name: XRReferenceSpace
desc:
The WebXR Device API's XRReferenceSpace interface describes the
coordinate system for a specific tracked entity or object within the virtual
world using a specified tracking behavior. The tracking behavior is defined
by the selected reference space type. It expands
upon the base class, XRSpace, by adding support for several different
tracking behaviors as well as to request a new reference space which
describes the offset transform between the tracked object and another
location in the world.

name: getOffsetReferenceSpace
desc:
The XRReferenceSpace
interface's getOffsetReferenceSpace() method returns a
new reference space object which describes the relative difference in
position between
the object on which the method is called and a given point in 3D space.
The
object returned by getOffsetReferenceSpace() is an
XRReferenceSpace if called on an XRReferenceSpace, or an
XRBoundedReferenceSpace if called on an object of that type.

name: XRReferenceSpaceEvent
desc:
The
WebXR Device API
interface XRReferenceSpaceEvent represents an event sent to an
XRReferenceSpace. Currently, the only event that uses this type is the
XRReferenceSpace.reset_event event.

name: referenceSpace
desc:
The read-only XRReferenceSpaceEvent property
referenceSpace specifies the reference space which is the
originator of the event.

name: transform
desc:
The read-only XRReferenceSpaceEvent property
transform indicates the position and orientation of the
affected XRReferenceSpaceEvent.referenceSpace's
native origin after the changes the event represents are applied. The
transform is defined using the old coordinate system, which allows it to
be
used to convert coordinates from the pre-event coordinate system to the
post-event
coordinate system.

name: XRRigidTransform
desc:
The XRRigidTransform is a
WebXR API
interface that represents the 3D geometric transform described by a position
and orientation.

name: inverse
desc:
The read-only inverse property
of the XRRigidTransform interface returns another
XRRigidTransform object which is the inverse of its owning
transform. That is, you can always get the inverse of any
XRRigidTransform using its inverse property, instead of having
to explicitly generate it.

name: matrix
desc:
The read-only XRRigidTransform property
matrix returns the transform
matrix represented by the object. The returned matrix can then be
premultiplied with a
column vector to rotate the
vector by the 3D rotation specified by the
XRRigidTransform.orientation, then translate
it by the XRRigidTransform.position.

name: orientation
desc:
The read-only XRRigidTransform property
orientation is a DOMPointReadOnly
containing a normalized  (also called a unit
quaternion or versor)
specifying the rotational component of the transform represented by the
object.
If you specify a quaternion whose length is not exactly 1.0 meters, it
will be
normalized for you.

name: position
desc:
The read-only XRRigidTransform property
position is a DOMPointReadOnly object which
provides the 3D point, specified in meters, describing the translation
component of the
transform.

name: XRSessionEvent
desc:
The
WebXR Device API's
XRSessionEvent interface describes an event which indicates the change
of the state of an XRSession. These events occur, for example, when the
session ends or the visibility of its context changes.

name: session
desc:
The read-only XRSessionEvent interface's
session property indicates which
XRSession the event is about.

name: XRSpace
desc:
The XRSpace interface of the
WebXR Device API
is an abstract interface providing a common basis for every class which
represents a virtual coordinate system within the virtual world, in which
its origin corresponds to a physical location. Spatial data in WebXR is
always expressed relative to an object based upon one of the descendant
interfaces of XRSpace, at the time at which a given XRFrame takes place.

name: XRViewerPose
desc:
The WebXR Device API interface XRViewerPose represents the pose (the
position and orientation) of a viewer's point of view on the scene. Each
XRViewerPose can have multiple views to represent, for example, the slight
separation between the left and right eye.

name: views
desc:
The read-only XRViewerPose property views
returns an array which contains every XRView which must be rendered in
order to fully represent the scene from the viewpoint defined by the
viewer pose. For
monoscopic devices, this array contains a single view.

name: XRViewport
desc:
The WebXR Device API's XRViewport interface provides properties used
to describe the size and position of the current viewport within the
XRWebGLLayer being used to render the 3D scene.

name: height
desc:
The read-only XRViewport property
height specifies the height, in pixels, of the viewport
onto the drawing surface within which the WebXR view is to be rendered.
Along

name: Focus.new
desc: Creates a widget that manages a FocusNode.

name: Focus.withExternalFocusNode

Creates a Focus widget that uses the given focusNode as the source of
truth for attributes on the node, rather than the attributes of this widget.

name: autofocus
desc:
True if this widget will be selected as the initial focus when no other
node in its scope is currently focused.

name: canRequestFocus
desc: If true, this widget may request the primary focus.

name: child
desc: The child widget of this Focus.

name: createState
desc: Creates the mutable state for this widget at a given location in the tree.

name: debugFillProperties
desc: Add additional properties associated with the node.

name: debugLabel
desc: A debug label for this widget.

name: descendantsAreFocusable
desc: If false, will make this widget's descendants unfocusable.

name: descendantsAreTraversable
desc: If false, will make this widget's descendants untraversable.

name: focusNode
desc: An optional focus node to use as the focus node for this widget.

name: includeSemantics
desc: Include semantics information in this widget.

name: isAt
desc: Returns true if the nearest enclosing Focus widget's node is focused.

name: maybeOf
desc:
Returns the focusNode of the Focus that most tightly encloses the
given BuildContext.

name: of
desc:
Returns the focusNode of the Focus that most tightly encloses the
given BuildContext.

name: onFocusChange
desc: Handler called when the focus changes.

name: onKey
desc:
A handler for keys that are pressed when this object or one of its
children has focus.

name: onKeyEvent
desc:
A handler for keys that are pressed when this object or one of its
children has focus.

name: parentNode
desc:
The optional parent node to use when reparenting the focusNode for this
Focus widget.

name: skipTraversal
desc:
Sets the FocusNode.skipTraversal flag on the focus node so that it won't
be visited by the FocusTraversalPolicy.

name: FocusAttachment
desc: An attachment point for a FocusNode.

desc:
Detaches the FocusNode this attachment point is associated with from the
focus tree, and disconnects it from this attachment point.

name: isAttached
desc: Returns true if the associated node is attached to this attachment.

name: reparent
desc:
Ensures that the FocusNode attached at this attachment point has the
proper parent node, changing it if necessary.

name: FocusHighlightMode
desc:
An enum to describe which kind of focus highlight behavior to use when
displaying focus information.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: FocusHighlightStrategy
desc:
An enum to describe how the current value of FocusManager.highlightMode is
determined. The strategy is set on FocusManager.highlightStrategy.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: FocusManager
desc: Manages the focus tree.

name: FocusManager.new
desc: Creates an object that manages the focus tree.

name: addEarlyKeyEventHandler
desc:
Adds a key event handler to a set of handlers that are called before any
key event handlers in the focus tree are called.

name: addHighlightModeListener
desc:
Register a closure to be called when the FocusManager notifies its listeners
that the value of highlightMode has changed.

name: addLateKeyEventHandler
desc:
Adds a key event handler to a set of handlers that are called if none of
the key event handlers in the focus tree handle the event.

name: applyFocusChangesIfNeeded
desc:
Applies any pending focus changes and notifies listeners that the focus
has changed.

name: debugDescribeChildren
desc:
Returns a list of DiagnosticsNode objects describing this node's
children.

name: debugFillProperties
desc: Add additional properties associated with the node.

name: dispose
desc: Discards any resources used by the object.

name: highlightMode
desc: Indicates the current interaction mode for focus highlights.

name: highlightStrategy
desc: Sets the strategy by which highlightMode is determined.

name: instance
desc:
Provides convenient access to the current FocusManager singleton from
the WidgetsBinding instance.

name: listenToApplicationLifecycleChangesIfSupported
desc:
Enables this FocusManager to listen to changes of the application
lifecycle if it does not already have an application lifecycle listener
active, and the app isn't running on a native mobile platform.

name: primaryFocus
desc: The node that currently has the primary focus.

name: registerGlobalHandlers
desc: Registers global input event handlers that are needed to manage focus.

name: removeEarlyKeyEventHandler
desc: Removes a key handler added by calling addEarlyKeyEventHandler.

name: removeHighlightModeListener
desc:
Remove a previously registered closure from the list of closures that the
FocusManager notifies.

name: removeLateKeyEventHandler
desc: Removes a key handler added by calling addLateKeyEventHandler.

name: rootScope
desc: The root FocusScopeNode in the focus tree.

name: FocusNode
desc:
An object that can be used by a stateful widget to obtain the keyboard focus
and to handle keyboard events.

name: FocusNode.new
desc: Creates a focus node.

name: ancestors
desc: An Iterable over the ancestors of this node.

name: attach
desc:
Called by the host StatefulWidget to attach a FocusNode to the
widget tree.

name: canRequestFocus
desc: If true, this focus node may request the primary focus.

name: children
desc: An iterator over the children of this node.

name: consumeKeyboardToken
desc: Removes the keyboard token from this focus node if it has one.

name: context
desc: The context that was supplied to attach.

name: debugDescribeChildren
desc:
Returns a list of DiagnosticsNode objects describing this node's
children.

name: debugFillProperties
desc: Add additional properties associated with the node.

name: debugLabel
desc: A debug label that is used for diagnostic output.

name: descendants
desc:
An Iterable over the hierarchy of children below this one, in
depth-first order.

name: descendantsAreFocusable
desc: If false, will disable focus for all of this node's descendants.

name: descendantsAreTraversable
desc:
If false, tells the focus traversal policy to skip over for all of this
node's descendants for purposes of the traversal algorithm.

name: dispose
desc: Discards any resources used by the object.

name: enclosingScope
desc:
Returns the nearest enclosing scope node above this node, or null if the
node has not yet be added to the focus tree.

name: focusInDirection
desc:
Request to move the focus to the nearest focus node in the given
direction, by calling the FocusTraversalPolicy.inDirection method.

name: hasFocus
desc: Whether this node has input focus.

name: hasPrimaryFocus
desc: Returns true if this node currently has the application-wide input focus.

name: highlightMode
desc: Returns the FocusHighlightMode that is currently in effect for this node.

name: nearestScope
desc:
Returns the nearest enclosing scope node above this node, including
this node, if it's a scope.

name: nextFocus
desc:
Request to move the focus to the next focus node, by calling the
FocusTraversalPolicy.next method.

name: offset
desc:
Returns the global offset to the upper left corner of the attached
widget's RenderObject, in logical units.

name: onKey
desc:
Called if this focus node receives a key event while focused (i.e. when
hasFocus returns true).

name: onKeyEvent
desc:
Called if this focus node receives a key event while focused (i.e. when
hasFocus returns true).

name: parent
desc: Returns the parent node for this object.

name: previousFocus
desc:
Request to move the focus to the previous focus node, by calling the
FocusTraversalPolicy.previous method.

name: rect
desc:
Returns the global rectangle of the attached widget's RenderObject, in
logical units.

name: requestFocus
desc:
Requests the primary focus for this node, or for a supplied node, which
will also give focus to its ancestors.

name: size
desc:
Returns the size of the attached widget's RenderObject, in logical
units.

name: skipTraversal
desc:
If true, tells the focus traversal policy to skip over this node for
purposes of the traversal algorithm.

name: toStringShort
desc:
A brief description of this object, usually just the runtimeType and the
hashCode.

name: traversalChildren
desc:
An iterator over the children that are allowed to be traversed by the
FocusTraversalPolicy.

name: traversalDescendants
desc:
Returns all descendants which do not have the skipTraversal and do have
the canRequestFocus flag set.

name: unfocus
desc: Removes the focus on this node by moving the primary focus to another node.

name: FocusOnKeyCallback
desc:
Signature of a callback used by Focus.onKey and FocusScope.onKey
to receive key events.

name: FocusOnKeyEventCallback
desc:
Signature of a callback used by Focus.onKeyEvent and FocusScope.onKeyEvent
to receive key events.

name: FocusOrder
desc: Base class for all sort orders for OrderedTraversalPolicy traversal.

name: FocusOrder.new
desc:
Abstract const constructor. This constructor enables subclasses to provide
const constructors so that they can be used in const expressions.

name: compareTo
desc: Compares this object to another Comparable.

name: doCompare
desc: The subclass implementation called by compareTo to compare orders.

name: FocusScope
desc:
A FocusScope is similar to a Focus, but also serves as a scope for its
descendants, restricting focus traversal to the scoped controls.

name: FocusScope.new
desc: Creates a widget that manages a FocusScopeNode.

name: FocusScope.withExternalFocusNode
desc:
Creates a FocusScope widget that uses the given focusScopeNode as the
source of truth for attributes on the node, rather than the attributes of
this widget.

name: createState
desc: Creates the mutable state for this widget at a given location in the tree.

name: of
desc:
Returns the FocusNode.nearestScope of the Focus or FocusScope that
most tightly encloses the given context.

name: FocusScopeNode
desc:
A subclass of FocusNode that acts as a scope for its descendants,
maintaining information about which descendant is currently or was last
focused.

name: FocusScopeNode.new
desc: Creates a FocusScopeNode.

name: autofocus
desc: If this scope lacks a focus, request that the given node become the focus.

name: debugFillProperties
desc: Add additional properties associated with the node.

name: descendantsAreFocusable
desc: If false, will disable focus for all of this node's descendants.

name: directionalTraversalEdgeBehavior
desc: Controls the directional transfer of focus when the focus is on the first or last item.

name: focusedChild
desc:
Returns the child of this node that should receive focus if this scope
node receives focus.

name: isFirstFocus
desc: Returns true if this scope is the focused child of its parent scope.

name: nearestScope
desc:
Returns the nearest enclosing scope node above this node, including
this node, if it's a scope.

name: requestScopeFocus
desc:
Requests that the scope itself receive focus, without trying to find
a descendant that should receive focus.

name: setFirstFocus
desc: Make the given scope the active child scope for this scope.

name: traversalChildren
desc:
An iterator over the children that are allowed to be traversed by the
FocusTraversalPolicy.

name: traversalDescendants
desc:
Returns all descendants which do not have the skipTraversal and do have
the canRequestFocus flag set.

name: traversalEdgeBehavior
desc:
Controls the transfer of focus beyond the first and the last items of a
FocusScopeNode.

name: FocusTraversalGroup
desc:
A widget that describes the inherited focus policy for focus traversal for
its descendants, grouping them into a separate traversal group.

name: FocusTraversalGroup.new
desc: Creates a FocusTraversalGroup object.

name: child
desc: The child widget of this FocusTraversalGroup.

name: createState
desc: Creates the mutable state for this widget at a given location in the tree.

name: debugFillProperties
desc: Add additional properties associated with the node.

name: descendantsAreFocusable
desc: If false, will make this widget's descendants unfocusable.

name: descendantsAreTraversable
desc: If false, will make this widget's descendants untraversable.

name: maybeOf
desc:
Returns the FocusTraversalPolicy that applies to the FocusNode of the
nearest ancestor Focus widget, or null, given a BuildContext.

name: maybeOfNode
desc:
Returns the FocusTraversalPolicy that applies to the nearest ancestor of
the given FocusNode.

name: of
desc:
Returns the FocusTraversalPolicy that applies to the FocusNode of the
nearest ancestor Focus widget, given a BuildContext.

name: onFocusNodeCreated
desc: Called when the FocusNode of this widget is created.

name: parentNode
desc: The optional parent node to use when reparenting this group's FocusNode.

name: policy
desc:
The policy used to move the focus from one focus node to another when
traversing them using a keyboard.

name: FocusTraversalOrder
desc:
An inherited widget that describes the order in which its child subtree
should be traversed.

name: FocusTraversalOrder.new
desc:
Creates an inherited widget used to describe the focus order of
the child subtree.

name: debugFillProperties
desc: Add additional properties associated with the node.

name: maybeOf
desc: Finds the FocusOrder in the nearest ancestor FocusTraversalOrder widget.

name: of
desc: Finds the FocusOrder in the nearest ancestor FocusTraversalOrder widget.

name: order
desc: The order for the widget descendants of this FocusTraversalOrder.

name: updateShouldNotify
desc: Whether the framework should notify widgets that inherit from this widget.

name: FocusTraversalPolicy
desc: Determines how focusable widgets are traversed within a FocusTraversalGroup.

name: FocusTraversalPolicy.new
desc:
Abstract const constructor. This constructor enables subclasses to provide
const constructors so that they can be used in const expressions.

name: changedScope
desc:
This is called whenever the given node is re-parented into a new scope,
so that the policy has a chance to update or invalidate any cached data
that it maintains per scope about the node.

name: defaultTraversalRequestFocusCallback
desc:
The default value for requestFocusCallback.
Requests focus from node and ensures the node is visible
by calling Scrollable.ensureVisible.

name: findFirstFocus
desc:
Returns the node that should receive focus if focus is traversing
forwards, and there is no current focus.

name: findFirstFocusInDirection
desc:
Returns the first node in the given direction that should receive focus
if there is no current focus in the scope to which the currentNode
belongs.

name: findLastFocus
desc:
Returns the node that should receive focus if focus is traversing
backwards, and there is no current focus.

name: inDirection
desc:
Focuses the next widget in the given direction in the focus scope that
contains the given currentNode.

name: invalidateScopeData
desc: Clears the data associated with the given FocusScopeNode for this object.

name: next
desc:
Focuses the next widget in the focus scope that contains the given
currentNode.

name: previous
desc:
Focuses the previous widget in the focus scope that contains the given
currentNode.

name: requestFocusCallback
desc:
The callback used to move the focus from one focus node to another when
traversing them using a keyboard. By default it requests focus on the next
node and ensures the node is visible if it's in a scrollable.

name: sortDescendants
desc: Sorts the given descendants into focus order.

name: FocusableActionDetector
desc:
A widget that combines the functionality of Actions, Shortcuts,
MouseRegion and a Focus widget to create a detector that defines actions
and key bindings, and provides callbacks for handling focus and hover
highlights.

name: FocusableActionDetector.new
desc: Create a const FocusableActionDetector.

name: actions
desc:
A map of Intent keys to Action<Intent> objects that defines which
actions this widget knows about.

name: autofocus
desc:
True if this widget will be selected as the initial focus when no other
node in its scope is currently focused.

name: child
desc: The child widget for this FocusableActionDetector widget.

name: createState
desc: Creates the mutable state for this widget at a given location in the tree.

name: descendantsAreFocusable
desc: If false, will make this widget's descendants unfocusable.

name: descendantsAreTraversable
desc: If false, will make this widget's descendants untraversable.

name: enabled
desc: Is this widget enabled or not.

name: focusNode
desc: An optional focus node to use as the focus node for this widget.

name: includeFocusSemantics
desc: Whether to include semantics from Focus.

name: mouseCursor
desc:
The cursor for a mouse pointer when it enters or is hovering over the
widget.

name: onFocusChange
desc: A function that will be called when the focus changes.

name: onShowFocusHighlight
desc:
A function that will be called when the focus highlight should be shown or
hidden.

name: onShowHoverHighlight
desc: A function that will be called when the hover highlight should be shown or hidden.

name: shortcuts
desc:
The map of shortcuts that describes the mapping between a key sequence
defined by a ShortcutActivator and the Intent that will be emitted
when that key sequence is pressed.

name: Form
desc:
An optional container for grouping together multiple form field widgets
(e.g. TextField widgets).

desc: Creates a container for form fields.

Used to enable/disable form fields auto validation and update their error
text.

name: canPop
desc: When false, blocks the current route from being popped.

name: child
desc: The widget below this widget in the tree.

name: createState
desc: Creates the mutable state for this widget at a given location in the tree.

name: maybeOf
desc:
Returns the FormState of the closest Form widget which encloses the
given context, or null if none is found.

name: of
desc:
Returns the FormState of the closest Form widget which encloses the
given context.

name: onChanged
desc: Called when one of the form fields changes.

name: onPopInvoked
desc: Called after a route pop was handled.

name: onPopInvokedWithResult
desc: Called after a route pop was handled.

name: onWillPop
desc:
Enables the form to veto attempts by the user to dismiss the ModalRoute
that contains the form.

name: FormField
desc: A single form field.

desc: Creates a single form field.

name: autovalidateMode
desc:
Used to enable/disable this form field auto validation and update its
error text.

name: builder
desc: Function that returns the widget representing this form field.

name: createState
desc: Creates the mutable state for this widget at a given location in the tree.

name: enabled
desc: Whether the form is able to receive user input.

name: errorBuilder
desc: Function that returns the widget representing the error to display.

name: forceErrorText
desc:
An optional property that forces the FormFieldState into an error state
by directly setting the FormFieldState.errorText property without
running the validator function.

name: initialValue
desc: An optional value to initialize the form field to, or null otherwise.

name: onReset
desc:
An optional method to call when the form field is reset via
FormFieldState.reset.

name: onSaved
desc:
An optional method to call with the final value when the form is saved via
FormState.save.

name: restorationId
desc: Restoration ID to save and restore the state of the form field.

name: validator
desc:
An optional method that validates an input. Returns an error string to
display if the input is invalid, or null otherwise.

name: FormFieldBuilder
desc: Signature for building the widget representing the form field.

name: FormFieldErrorBuilder
desc: Signature for a callback that builds an error widget.

name: FormFieldSetter
desc: Signature for being notified when a form field changes value.

name: FormFieldState
desc:
The current state of a FormField. Passed to the FormFieldBuilder method
for use in constructing the form field's widget.

name: build
desc: Describes the part of the user interface represented by this widget.

name: clearError
desc: Clears any visible validation error for this field without resetting the field's value.

name: deactivate
desc: Called when this object is removed from the tree.

name: didChange
desc:
Updates this field's state to the new value. Useful for responding to
child widget changes, e.g. Slider's Slider.onChanged argument.

name: didChangeDependencies
desc: Called when a dependency of this State object changes.

name: didUpdateWidget
desc: Called whenever the widget configuration changes.

name: dispose
desc: Called when this object is removed from the tree permanently.

name: errorText
desc:
The current validation error returned by the FormField.validator
callback, or the manually provided error message using the
FormField.forceErrorText property.

name: hasError
desc: True if this field has any validation errors.

name: hasInteractedByUser
desc: Returns true if the user has modified the value of this field.

name: initState
desc: Called when this object is inserted into the tree.

name: isValid
desc: True if the current value is valid.

name: reset
desc: Resets the field to its initial value.

name: restorationId
desc:
The restoration ID used for the RestorationBucket in which the mixin
will store the restoration data of all registered properties.

name: restoreState
desc:
Called to initialize or restore the RestorablePropertys used by the
State object.

name: save
desc: Calls the FormField's onSaved method with the current value.

name: setValue
desc: Sets the value associated with this form field.

name: validate
desc:
Calls FormField.validator to set the errorText only if FormField.forceErrorText is null.
When FormField.forceErrorText is not null, FormField.validator will not be called.

name: value
desc: The current value of the form field.

name: FormFieldValidator
desc: Signature for validating a form field.

name: FormState
desc: State associated with a Form widget.

name: build
desc: Describes the part of the user interface represented by this widget.

name: clearError
desc:
Clears the validation errors for all FormFields in this Form
without resetting their values.

name: fields
desc: The FormFieldState objects that are currently registered with this Form.

name: reset
desc:
Resets every FormField that is a descendant of this Form back to its
FormField.initialValue.

name: save
desc: Saves every FormField that is a descendant of this Form.

name: validate
desc:
Validates every FormField that is a descendant of this Form, and
returns true if there are no errors.

desc:
Validates every FormField that is a descendant of this Form, and
returns a Set of FormFieldState of the invalid field(s) only, if any.

RenderFractionallySizedOverflowBox.

name: alignment
desc: How to align the child.

name: createRenderObject
desc:
Creates an instance of the RenderObject class that this
RenderObjectWidget represents, using the configuration described by this
RenderObjectWidget.

name: debugFillProperties
desc: Add additional properties associated with the node.

name: heightFactor
desc: If non-null, the fraction of the incoming height given to the child.

name: updateRenderObject
desc:
Copies the configuration described by this RenderObjectWidget to the
given RenderObject, which will be of the same type as returned by this
object's createRenderObject.

name: widthFactor
desc: If non-null, the fraction of the incoming width given to the child.

name: FutureBuilder

A widget that builds itself based on the latest snapshot of interaction with
a Future.

name: FutureBuilder.new
desc:
Creates a widget that builds itself based on the latest snapshot of
interaction with a Future.

name: builder
desc: The build strategy currently used by this builder.

name: createState
desc: Creates the mutable state for this widget at a given location in the tree.

Whether the latest error received by the asynchronous computation should
be rethrown or swallowed. This property is useful for debugging purposes.

name: future
desc:
The asynchronous computation to which this builder is currently connected,
possibly null.

name: initialData
desc:
The data that will be used to create the snapshots provided until a
non-null future has completed.

name: GenerateAppTitle
desc: The signature of WidgetsApp.onGenerateTitle.

name: GestureDetector
desc: A widget that detects gestures.

desc: Creates a widget that detects gestures.

name: behavior
desc:
How this gesture detector should behave during hit testing when deciding
how the hit test propagates to children and whether to consider targets
behind this one.

name: build
desc: Describes the part of the user interface represented by this widget.

name: child
desc: The widget below this widget in the tree.

name: debugFillProperties
desc: Add additional properties associated with the node.

desc: Determines the way that drag start behavior is handled.

Whether to exclude these gestures from the semantics tree. For
example, the long-press gesture for showing a tooltip is
excluded because the tooltip itself is included in the semantics
tree directly and so having a gesture to show it would result in
duplication of information.

name: onDoubleTap
desc:
The user has tapped the screen with a primary button at the same location
twice in quick succession.

name: onDoubleTapCancel
desc:
The pointer that previously triggered onDoubleTapDown will not end up
causing a double tap.

name: onDoubleTapDown
desc:
A pointer that might cause a double tap has contacted the screen at a
particular location.

name: onForcePressEnd
desc: The pointer tracked by onForcePressStart is no longer in contact with the screen.

name: onForcePressPeak
desc:
The pointer is in contact with the screen and has pressed with the maximum
force. The amount of force is at least
ForcePressGestureRecognizer.peakPressure.

name: onForcePressStart
desc:
The pointer is in contact with the screen and has pressed with sufficient
force to initiate a force press. The amount of force is at least
ForcePressGestureRecognizer.startPressure.

name: onForcePressUpdate
desc:
A pointer is in contact with the screen, has previously passed the
ForcePressGestureRecognizer.startPressure and is either moving on the
plane of the screen, pressing the screen with varying forces or both
simultaneously.

name: onHorizontalDragCancel
desc:
The pointer that previously triggered onHorizontalDragDown did not
complete.

name: onHorizontalDragDown
desc:
A pointer has contacted the screen with a primary button and might begin
to move horizontally.

name: onHorizontalDragEnd
desc:
A pointer that was previously in contact with the screen with a primary
button and moving horizontally is no longer in contact with the screen and
was moving at a specific velocity when it stopped contacting the screen.

name: onHorizontalDragStart
desc:
A pointer has contacted the screen with a primary button and has begun to
move horizontally.

name: onHorizontalDragUpdate
desc:
A pointer that is in contact with the screen with a primary button and
moving horizontally has moved in the horizontal direction.

name: onLongPress
desc: Called when a long press gesture with a primary button has been recognized.

name: onLongPressCancel
desc:
A pointer that previously triggered onLongPressDown will not end up
causing a long-press.

name: onLongPressDown
desc:
The pointer has contacted the screen with a primary button, which might
be the start of a long-press.

name: onLongPressEnd
desc:
A pointer that has triggered a long-press with a primary button has
stopped contacting the screen.

name: onLongPressMoveUpdate
desc: A pointer has been drag-moved after a long-press with a primary button.

name: onLongPressStart
desc: Called when a long press gesture with a primary button has been recognized.

name: onLongPressUp
desc:
A pointer that has triggered a long-press with a primary button has
stopped contacting the screen.

name: onPanCancel
desc: The pointer that previously triggered onPanDown did not complete.

name: onPanDown
desc:
A pointer has contacted the screen with a primary button and might begin
to move.

name: onPanEnd
desc:
A pointer that was previously in contact with the screen with a primary
button and moving is no longer in contact with the screen and was moving
at a specific velocity when it stopped contacting the screen.

name: onPanStart
desc:
A pointer has contacted the screen with a primary button and has begun to
move.

name: onPanUpdate
desc:
A pointer that is in contact with the screen with a primary button and
moving has moved again.

name: onScaleEnd
desc: The pointers are no longer in contact with the screen.

name: onScaleStart
desc:
The pointers in contact with the screen have established a focal point and
initial scale of 1.0.

name: onScaleUpdate
desc:
The pointers in contact with the screen have indicated a new focal point
and/or scale.

name: onSecondaryLongPress
