Returns MediaQueryData.orientation for the nearest MediaQuery ancestor or
throws an exception, if no such ancestor exists.

name: paddingOf
desc:
Returns MediaQueryData.padding for the nearest MediaQuery ancestor or
throws an exception, if no such ancestor exists.

name: platformBrightnessOf
desc:
Returns MediaQueryData.platformBrightness for the nearest MediaQuery
ancestor or Brightness.light, if no such ancestor exists.

name: sizeOf
desc:
Returns MediaQueryData.size from the nearest MediaQuery ancestor or
throws an exception, if no such ancestor exists.

name: supportsAnnounceOf
desc:
Returns the MediaQueryData.supportsAnnounce accessibility setting for the
nearest MediaQuery ancestor or false, if no such ancestor exists.

name: supportsShowingSystemContextMenu
desc:
Returns MediaQueryData.supportsShowingSystemContextMenu for the nearest
MediaQuery ancestor or throws an exception, if no such ancestor exists.

name: systemGestureInsetsOf
desc:
Returns MediaQueryData.systemGestureInsets for the nearest MediaQuery
ancestor or throws an exception, if no such ancestor exists.

name: textScaleFactorOf
desc:
Deprecated. Will be removed in a future version of Flutter. Use
maybeTextScalerOf instead.

name: textScalerOf
desc:
Returns the MediaQueryData.textScaler for the nearest MediaQuery
ancestor or TextScaler.noScaling if no such ancestor exists.

name: updateShouldNotify
desc: Whether the framework should notify widgets that inherit from this widget.

name: updateShouldNotifyDependent
desc:
Return true if the changes between this model and oldWidget match any
of the dependencies.

name: viewInsetsOf
desc:
Returns MediaQueryData.viewInsets for the nearest MediaQuery ancestor
or throws an exception, if no such ancestor exists.

name: viewPaddingOf
desc:
Returns MediaQueryData.viewPadding for the nearest MediaQuery ancestor
or throws an exception, if no such ancestor exists.

name: widthOf
desc:
Returns width of MediaQueryData.size from the nearest MediaQuery
ancestor or throws an exception, if no such ancestor exists.

name: withClampedTextScaling
desc:
Wraps the child in a MediaQuery and applies TextScaler.clamp on the
current MediaQueryData.textScaler.

name: withNoTextScaling
desc:
Wraps the child in a MediaQuery with its MediaQueryData.textScaler
set to TextScaler.noScaling.

name: MediaQueryData
desc: Information about a piece of media (e.g., a window).

name: MediaQueryData.fromView
desc: Creates data for a MediaQuery based on the given view.

name: MediaQueryData.fromWindow
desc: Deprecated. Use MediaQueryData.fromView instead.

name: MediaQueryData.new
desc: Creates data for a media query with explicit values.

name: accessibleNavigation
desc:
Whether the user is using an accessibility service like TalkBack or
VoiceOver to interact with the application.

name: alwaysUse24HourFormat
desc: Whether to use 24-hour format when formatting time.

name: applyDisplayCornerRadii
desc:
Creates a copy of this media query data but with the displayCornerRadii
replaced with the given value.

name: applyTextStyleOverrides
desc:
Creates a copy of this media query data but with the
lineHeightScaleFactorOverride, letterSpacingOverride,
wordSpacingOverride, and paragraphSpacingOverride replaced
with the given values.

name: boldText
desc:
Whether the platform is requesting that text be drawn with a bold font
weight.

name: copyWith
desc:
Creates a copy of this media query data but with the given fields replaced
with the new values.

name: devicePixelRatio
desc:
The number of device pixels for each logical pixel of the encompassing FlutterView.
This number might not be a power of two. Indeed, it might not even be an integer.
For example, the Nexus 6 has a device pixel ratio of 3.5.

name: disableAnimations
desc:
Whether the platform is requesting that animations be disabled or reduced
as much as possible.

name: displayCornerRadii
desc: The radii of the display corners in logical pixels.

name: displayFeatures
desc: Areas of the display that are obstructed by hardware features.

name: gestureSettings
desc: The gesture settings for the view this media query is derived from.

name: hashCode
desc: The hash code for this object.

name: highContrast
desc:
Whether the platform is requesting a high contrast between foreground and
background content.

name: invertColors
desc: Whether the operating system is currently inverting the colors of the platform.

name: letterSpacingOverride
desc:
Overrides the amount of space (in logical pixels) to add between each
letter in a piece of text.

name: lineHeightScaleFactorOverride
desc: Overrides the height of the text, as a multiple of the font size.

name: navigationMode
desc: Describes the navigation mode requested by the platform.

name: onOffSwitchLabels
desc:
Whether the user requested to show on/off labels inside switches on iOS,
via Settings -> Accessibility -> Display & Text Size -> On/Off Labels.

name: operator ==
desc: The equality operator.

name: orientation
desc:
The orientation of the media (e.g., whether the device is in landscape or
portrait mode).

name: padding
desc:
The parts of the display that are partially obscured by system UI,
typically by the hardware display "notches" or the system status bar.

name: paragraphSpacingOverride
desc:
The amount of space (in logical pixels) to add following each paragraph
in a piece of text.

name: platformBrightness
desc: The current brightness mode of the host platform.

name: removeDisplayFeatures
desc:
Creates a copy of this media query data by removing displayFeatures that
are completely outside the given sub-screen and adjusting the padding,
viewInsets and viewPadding to be zero on the sides that are not
included in the sub-screen.

name: removePadding
desc:
Creates a copy of this media query data but with the given paddings
replaced with zero.

name: removeViewInsets
desc:
Creates a copy of this media query data but with the given viewInsets
replaced with zero.

name: removeViewPadding
desc:
Creates a copy of this media query data but with the given viewPadding
replaced with zero.

name: size
desc: The size of the media in logical pixels (e.g, the size of the screen).

name: supportsAnnounce
desc:
Whether accessibility announcements (like SemanticsService.sendAnnouncement)
are supported on the current platform.

name: supportsShowingSystemContextMenu
desc: Whether showing the system context menu is supported.

name: systemGestureInsets
desc:
The areas along the edges of the display where the system consumes
certain input events and blocks delivery of those events to the app.

name: textScaleFactor
desc:
Deprecated. Will be removed in a future version of Flutter. Use
textScaler instead.

name: textScaler
desc: The font scaling strategy to use for laying out textual contents.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: viewInsets
desc:
The parts of the display that are completely obscured by system UI,
typically by the device's keyboard.

name: viewPadding
desc:
The parts of the display that are partially obscured by system UI,
typically by the hardware display "notches" or the system status bar.

name: wordSpacingOverride
desc:
Overrides the amount of space (in logical pixels) to add at each
sequence of white-space (i.e. between each word) in a piece of text.

name: MenuController
desc:
A controller used to manage a menu created by a subclass of RawMenuAnchor,
such as MenuAnchor, MenuBar, SubmenuButton.

name: close
desc: Close the menu that this MenuController is associated with.

name: closeChildren
desc:
Close the children of the menu associated with this MenuController,
without closing the menu itself.

name: isOpen
desc: Whether or not the menu associated with this MenuController is open.

name: maybeIsOpenOf
desc:
Returns the value of MenuController.isOpen of the ancestor
RawMenuAnchor or RawMenuAnchorGroup nearest to the given context, if
one exists. Otherwise, returns null.

name: maybeOf
desc:
Returns the MenuController of the ancestor RawMenuAnchor nearest to
the given context, if one exists. Otherwise, returns null.

name: open
desc: Opens the menu that this MenuController is associated with.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: MenuItemSerializableIdGenerator
desc:
The signature for a function that generates unique menu item IDs for
serialization of a PlatformMenuItem.

name: MenuSerializableShortcut
desc:
A mixin allowing a ShortcutActivator to provide data for serialization of
the shortcut when sending to the platform.

name: serializeForMenu
desc:
Implement this in a ShortcutActivator subclass to allow it to be
serialized for use in a PlatformMenuBar.

name: MergeSemantics
desc: A widget that merges the semantics of its descendants.

name: MergeSemantics.new
desc: Creates a widget that merges the semantics of its descendants.

name: createRenderObject
desc:
Creates an instance of the RenderObject class that this
RenderObjectWidget represents, using the configuration described by this
RenderObjectWidget.

name: MetaData
desc: Holds opaque meta data in the render tree.

name: MetaData.new
desc: Creates a widget that hold opaque meta data.

name: behavior
desc: How to behave during hit testing.

name: createRenderObject
desc:
Creates an instance of the RenderObject class that this
RenderObjectWidget represents, using the configuration described by this
RenderObjectWidget.

name: debugFillProperties
desc: Add additional properties associated with the node.

name: metaData
desc: Opaque meta data ignored by the render tree.

name: updateRenderObject
desc:
Copies the configuration described by this RenderObjectWidget to the
given RenderObject, which will be of the same type as returned by this
object's createRenderObject.

name: ModalBarrier
desc: A widget that prevents the user from interacting with widgets behind itself.

name: ModalBarrier.new
desc: Creates a widget that blocks user interaction.

name: barrierSemanticsDismissible
desc: Whether the modal barrier semantics are included in the semantics tree.

name: build
desc: Describes the part of the user interface represented by this widget.

name: clipDetailsNotifier
desc:
Contains a value of type EdgeInsets that specifies how the
SemanticsNode.rect of the widget should be clipped.

name: color
desc: If non-null, fill the barrier with this color.

name: dismissible
desc: Specifies if the barrier will be dismissed when the user taps on it.

name: onDismiss
desc: Called when the barrier is being dismissed.

name: semanticsLabel
desc: Semantics label used for the barrier if it is dismissible.

name: semanticsOnTapHint
desc:
The semantic hint text that informs users what will happen if they
tap on the widget. Announced in the format of 'Double tap to ...'.

name: ModalRoute
desc: A route that blocks interaction with previous routes.

name: ModalRoute.new
desc: Creates a route that blocks interaction with previous routes.

name: addScopedWillPopCallback
desc: Enables this route to veto attempts by the user to dismiss it.

name: animation
desc:
The animation that drives the route's transition and the previous route's
forward transition.

name: barrierColor
desc:
The color to use for the modal barrier. If this is null, the barrier will
be transparent.

name: barrierCurve
desc: The curve that is used for animating the modal barrier in and out.

name: barrierDismissible
desc: Whether you can dismiss this route by tapping the modal barrier.

name: barrierLabel
desc: The semantic label used for a dismissible barrier.

name: buildModalBarrier
desc:
Build the barrier for this ModalRoute, subclasses can override
this method to create their own barrier with customized features such as
color or accessibility focus size.

name: buildPage
desc: Override this method to build the primary content of this route.

name: buildTransitions
desc:
Override this method to wrap the child with one or more transition
widgets that define how the route arrives on and leaves the screen.

name: canPop
desc: Whether this route can be popped.

name: canPopOf
desc:
Returns ModalRoute.canPop for the modal route most closely associated
with the given context.

name: changedExternalState
desc:
Called whenever the Navigator has updated in some manner that might
affect routes, to indicate that the route may wish to rebuild as well.

name: changedInternalState
desc: Called whenever the internal state of the route has changed.

name: createOverlayEntries
desc: Subclasses should override this getter to return the builders for the overlay.

name: delegatedTransition
desc:
The DelegatedTransitionBuilder provided to the route below this one in the
navigation stack.

name: didAdd
desc: Called after install when the route is added to the navigator.

name: didChangeNext
desc: This route's next route has changed to the given new route.

name: didChangePrevious
desc: This route's previous route has changed to the given new route.

name: didPopNext
desc:
The given route, which was above this one, has been popped off the
navigator.

name: didPush
desc: Called after install when the route is pushed onto the navigator.

name: directionalTraversalEdgeBehavior
desc:
Controls the directional transfer of focus beyond the first and the last
items of a FocusScopeNode.

name: filter
desc: The filter to add to the barrier.

name: fullscreenDialog
desc: Whether this route is a full-screen dialog.

name: hasScopedWillPopCallback
desc: True if one or more WillPopCallback callbacks exist.

name: impliesAppBarDismissal
desc:
Whether an AppBar in the route should automatically add a back button or
close button.

name: install
desc: Called when the route is inserted into the navigator.

name: isActiveOf
desc:
Returns ModalRoute.isActive for the modal route most closely associated
with the given context.

name: isCurrentOf
desc:
Returns ModalRoute.isCurrent for the modal route most closely associated
with the given context.

name: isFirstOf
desc:
Returns ModalRoute.isFirst for the modal route most closely associated
with the given context.

name: maintainState
desc: Whether the route should remain in memory when it is inactive.

name: of
desc: Returns the modal route most closely associated with the given context.

name: offstage
desc: Whether this route is currently offstage.

name: onPopInvokedWithResult
desc: Called after a route pop was handled.

name: opaqueOf
desc:
Returns ModalRoute.opaque for the modal route most closely associated
with the given context.

name: popDisposition
desc:
Returns RoutePopDisposition.doNotPop if any of the PopEntry instances
registered with registerPopEntry have PopEntry.canPopNotifier set to
false.

name: popDispositionOf
desc:
Returns ModalRoute.popDisposition for the modal route most closely associated
with the given context.

name: popGestureEnabled
desc: Whether a pop gesture can be started by the user for this route.

name: popGestureInProgress
desc:
True if a back gesture (iOS-style back swipe or Android predictive back)
is currently underway for this route.

name: receivedTransition
desc:
The DelegatedTransitionBuilder received from the route above this one in
the navigation stack.

name: registerPopEntry
desc: Registers the existence of a PopEntry in the route.

name: removeScopedWillPopCallback
desc: Remove one of the callbacks run by willPop.

name: secondaryAnimation
desc:
The animation for the route being pushed on top of this route. This
animation lets this route coordinate with the entrance and exit transition
of route pushed on top of this route.

name: semanticsDismissible
desc:
Whether the semantics of the modal barrier are included in the
semantics tree.

name: setState
desc: Schedule a call to buildTransitions.

name: settingsOf
desc:
Returns ModalRoute.settings for the modal route most closely associated
with the given context.

name: subtreeContext
desc: The build context for the subtree containing the primary content of this route.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: traversalEdgeBehavior
desc:
Controls the transfer of focus beyond the first and the last items of a
FocusScopeNode.

name: unregisterPopEntry
desc: Unregisters a PopEntry in the route's widget subtree.

name: willPop
desc:
Returns RoutePopDisposition.doNotPop if any of callbacks added with
addScopedWillPopCallback returns either false or null. If they all
return true, the base Route.willPop's result will be returned. The
callbacks will be called in the order they were added, and will only be
called if all previous callbacks returned true.

name: withName
desc:
Returns a predicate that's true if the route has the specified name and if
popping the route will not yield the same route, i.e. if the route's
willHandlePopInternally property is false.

name: MouseRegion
desc: A widget that tracks the movement of mice.

name: MouseRegion.new
desc: Creates a widget that forwards mouse events to callbacks.

name: createRenderObject
desc:
Creates an instance of the RenderObject class that this
RenderObjectWidget represents, using the configuration described by this
RenderObjectWidget.

name: cursor
desc: The mouse cursor for mouse pointers that are hovering over the region.

name: debugFillProperties
desc: Add additional properties associated with the node.

name: hitTestBehavior
desc: How to behave during hit testing.

name: onEnter
desc: Triggered when a mouse pointer has entered this widget.

name: onExit
desc:
Triggered when a mouse pointer has exited this widget when the widget is
still mounted.

name: onHover
desc:
Triggered when a pointer moves into a position within this widget without
buttons pressed.

name: opaque
desc:
Whether this widget should prevent other MouseRegions visually behind it
from detecting the pointer.

name: updateRenderObject
desc:
Copies the configuration described by this RenderObjectWidget to the
given RenderObject, which will be of the same type as returned by this
object's createRenderObject.

name: MoveExitWidgetSelectionButtonBuilder
desc:
Signature for the builder callback used by
WidgetInspector.moveExitWidgetSelectionButtonBuilder.

name: MultiChildRenderObjectElement
desc: An Element that uses a MultiChildRenderObjectWidget as its configuration.

name: MultiChildRenderObjectElement.new
desc: Creates an element that uses the given widget as its configuration.

name: children
desc: The current list of children of this element.

name: forgetChild
desc:
Remove the given child from the element's child list, in preparation for
the child being reused elsewhere in the element tree.

name: inflateWidget
desc:
Create an element for the given widget and add it as a child of this
element in the given slot.

name: insertRenderObjectChild
desc: Insert the given child into renderObject at the given slot.

name: mount
desc: Add this element to the tree in the given slot of the given parent.

name: moveRenderObjectChild
desc: Move the given child from the given old slot to the given new slot.

name: removeRenderObjectChild
desc: Remove the given child from renderObject.

name: renderObject
desc: The underlying RenderObject for this element.

name: update
desc: Change the widget used to configure this element.

name: visitChildren
desc:
Calls the argument for each child. Must be overridden by subclasses that
support having children.

name: MultiChildRenderObjectWidget
desc:
A superclass for RenderObjectWidgets that configure RenderObject subclasses
that have a single list of children. (This superclass only provides the
storage for that child list, it doesn't actually provide the updating
logic.)

name: MultiChildRenderObjectWidget.new
desc: Initializes fields for subclasses.

name: children
desc: The widgets below this widget in the tree.

name: createElement
desc: RenderObjectWidgets always inflate to a RenderObjectElement subclass.

name: MultiSelectableSelectionContainerDelegate
desc:
A delegate that handles events and updates for multiple Selectable
children.

name: MultiSelectableSelectionContainerDelegate.new
desc: Creates an instance of MultiSelectableSelectionContainerDelegate.

name: add
desc: Adds the selectable into the registrar.

name: compareOrder
desc:
The compare function this delegate used for determining the selection
order of the selectables.

name: contentLength
desc: The total length of the content under this SelectionContainerDelegate.

name: currentSelectionEndIndex
desc: The current Selectable that contains the selection end edge.

name: currentSelectionStartIndex
desc: The current Selectable that contains the selection start edge.

name: didChangeSelectables
desc: Called when this delegate finishes updating the Selectables.

name: dispatchSelectionEvent
desc: Handles the SelectionEvent sent to this object.

name: dispatchSelectionEventToChild
desc: Dispatches a selection event to a specific Selectable.

name: dispose
desc: Discards any resources used by the object.

name: ensureChildUpdated
desc: Ensures the Selectable child has received up to date selection event.

name: getSelectedContent
desc: Copies the selected contents of all Selectables.

name: getSelection
desc:
Returns a SelectedContentRange considering the SelectedContentRange
from each Selectable child managed under this delegate.

name: getSelectionGeometry
desc: Gets the combined SelectionGeometry for child Selectables.

name: handleClearSelection
desc: Removes the selection of all Selectables this delegate manages.

name: handleDirectionallyExtendSelection
desc: Extend current selection in a certain TextGranularity.

name: handleGranularlyExtendSelection
desc: Extend current selection in a certain TextGranularity.

name: handleSelectAll
desc: Selects all contents of all Selectables.

name: handleSelectParagraph
desc:
Selects a paragraph in a Selectable at the location
SelectParagraphSelectionEvent.globalPosition.

name: handleSelectWord
desc:
Selects a word in a Selectable at the location
SelectWordSelectionEvent.globalPosition.

name: handleSelectionEdgeUpdate
desc: Updates the selection edges.

name: layoutDidChange
desc: Notifies this delegate that layout of the container has changed.

name: pushHandleLayers
desc:
Marks this handler to be responsible for pushing LeaderLayers for the
selection handles.

name: remove
desc: Removes the selectable from the registrar.

name: selectables
desc: Gets the list of Selectables this delegate is managing.

name: value
desc: The current value of the object.

name: NavigationMode
desc: Describes the navigation mode to be set by a MediaQuery widget.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: NavigationNotification
desc: A notification that a change in navigation has taken place.

name: NavigationNotification.new
desc: Creates a notification that some change in navigation has happened.

name: canHandlePop
desc:
Indicates that the originator of this Notification is capable of
handling a navigation pop.

name: toString
desc: A string representation of this object.

name: NavigationToolbar
desc:
NavigationToolbar is a layout helper to position 3 widgets or groups of
widgets along a horizontal axis that's sensible for an application's
navigation bar such as in Material Design and in iOS.

name: NavigationToolbar.new
desc:
Creates a widget that lays out its children in a manner suitable for a
toolbar.

name: build
desc: Describes the part of the user interface represented by this widget.

name: centerMiddle
desc:
Whether to align the middle widget to the center of this widget or
next to the leading widget when false.

name: kMiddleSpacing
desc: The default spacing around the middle widget in dp.

name: leading
desc: Widget to place at the start of the horizontal toolbar.

name: middle
desc:
Widget to place in the middle of the horizontal toolbar, occupying
as much remaining space as possible.

name: middleSpacing
desc: The spacing around the middle widget on horizontal axis.

name: trailing
desc: Widget to place at the end of the horizontal toolbar.

name: Navigator
desc: A widget that manages a set of child widgets with a stack discipline.

name: Navigator.new
desc: Creates a widget that maintains a stack-based history of child widgets.

name: canPop
desc:
Whether the navigator that most tightly encloses the given context can be
popped.

name: clipBehavior
desc: The content will be clipped (or not) according to this option.

name: createState
desc: Creates the mutable state for this widget at a given location in the tree.

name: defaultGenerateInitialRoutes
desc: Turn a route name into a set of Route objects.

name: defaultRouteName
desc: The name for the default route of the application.

name: initialRoute
desc: The name of the first route to show.

name: maybeOf
desc:
The state from the closest instance of this class that encloses the given
context, if any.

name: maybePop
desc:
Consults the current route's Route.popDisposition getter or
Route.willPop method, and acts accordingly, potentially popping the
route as a result; returns whether the pop request should be considered
handled.

name: observers
desc: A list of observers for this navigator.

name: of
desc:
The state from the closest instance of this class that encloses the given
context.

name: onDidRemovePage
desc:
Called when the Route associated with the given Page has been removed
from the Navigator.

name: onGenerateInitialRoutes
desc:
Called when the widget is created to generate the initial list of Route
objects if initialRoute is not null.

name: onGenerateRoute
desc: Called to generate a route for a given RouteSettings.

name: onPopPage
desc: This is deprecated and replaced by onDidRemovePage.

name: onUnknownRoute
desc: Called when onGenerateRoute fails to generate a route.

name: pages
desc: The list of pages with which to populate the history.

name: pop
desc:
Pop the top-most route off the navigator that most tightly encloses the
given context.

name: popAndPushNamed
desc:
Pop the current route off the navigator that most tightly encloses the
given context and push a named route in its place.

name: popUntil
desc:
Calls pop repeatedly on the navigator that most tightly encloses the
given context until the predicate returns true.

name: popUntilWithResult
desc:
Calls pop repeatedly on the navigator that most tightly encloses the
given context until the predicate returns true, returning the result to
the last popped route.

name: push
desc:
Push the given route onto the navigator that most tightly encloses the
given context.

name: pushAndRemoveUntil
desc:
Push the given route onto the navigator that most tightly encloses the
given context, and then remove all the previous routes until the
predicate returns true.

name: pushNamed
desc:
Push a named route onto the navigator that most tightly encloses the given
context.

name: pushNamedAndRemoveUntil
desc:
Push the route with the given name onto the navigator that most tightly
encloses the given context, and then remove all the previous routes until
the predicate returns true.

name: pushReplacement
desc:
Replace the current route of the navigator that most tightly encloses the
given context by pushing the given route and then disposing the previous
route once the new route has finished animating in.

name: pushReplacementNamed
desc:
Replace the current route of the navigator that most tightly encloses the
given context by pushing the route named routeName and then disposing
the previous route once the new route has finished animating in.

name: removeRoute
desc:
Immediately remove route from the navigator that most tightly encloses
the given context, and Route.dispose it.

name: removeRouteBelow
desc:
Immediately remove a route from the navigator that most tightly encloses
the given context, and Route.dispose it. The route to be removed is the
one below the given anchorRoute.

name: replace
desc:
Replaces a route on the navigator that most tightly encloses the given
context with a new route.

name: replaceRouteBelow
desc:
Replaces a route on the navigator that most tightly encloses the given
context with a new route. The route to be replaced is the one below the
given anchorRoute.

name: reportsRouteUpdateToEngine
desc:
Whether this navigator should report route update message back to the
engine when the top-most route changes.

name: requestFocus
desc:
Whether or not the navigator and it's new topmost route should request focus
when the new route is pushed onto the navigator.

name: restorablePopAndPushNamed
desc:
Pop the current route off the navigator that most tightly encloses the
given context and push a named route in its place.

name: restorablePush
desc:
Push a new route onto the navigator that most tightly encloses the
given context.

name: restorablePushAndRemoveUntil
desc:
Push a new route onto the navigator that most tightly encloses the
given context, and then remove all the previous routes until the
predicate returns true.

name: restorablePushNamed
desc:
Push a named route onto the navigator that most tightly encloses the given
context.

name: restorablePushNamedAndRemoveUntil
desc:
Push the route with the given name onto the navigator that most tightly
encloses the given context, and then remove all the previous routes until
the predicate returns true.

name: restorablePushReplacement
desc:
Replace the current route of the navigator that most tightly encloses the
given context by pushing a new route and then disposing the previous
route once the new route has finished animating in.

name: restorablePushReplacementNamed
desc:
Replace the current route of the navigator that most tightly encloses the
given context by pushing the route named routeName and then disposing
the previous route once the new route has finished animating in.

name: restorableReplace
desc:
Replaces a route on the navigator that most tightly encloses the given
context with a new route.

name: restorableReplaceRouteBelow
desc:
Replaces a route on the navigator that most tightly encloses the given
context with a new route. The route to be replaced is the one below the
given anchorRoute.

name: restorationScopeId
desc:
Restoration ID to save and restore the state of the navigator, including
its history.

name: routeDirectionalTraversalEdgeBehavior
desc:
Controls the directional transfer of focus beyond the first and the last
items of a focus scope that defines focus traversal of widgets within a route.

name: routeTraversalEdgeBehavior
desc:
Controls the transfer of focus beyond the first and the last items of a
focus scope that defines focus traversal of widgets within a route.

name: transitionDelegate
desc:
The delegate used for deciding how routes transition in or off the screen
